info.title: Convoy V3 API
info.description: # Convoy API — Front-end Guide One API serves every Convoy app. This file and [integration.md](integration.md) are shared; each app has its own folder with one document per menu, listing the screen actions and the API call behind each one. | App | Folder | | --- | --- | | Convoy OS (operator web app) | [`convoy-os/`](convoy-os/) — menus below, screen map in [convoy-os/screen-map.md](convoy-os/screen-map.md); changes the OS front-end must make: [convoy-os/fe-updates.md](convoy-os/fe-updates.md) | | Convoy Driver (drivers' phone app) | [`driver/`](driver/) — start with [driver/README.md](driver/README.md) | | Client Portal (people at Managed Clients, web) | [`client-portal/`](client-portal/) — start with [client-portal/README.md](client-portal/README.md) | ## Convoy OS | Menu | Document | | --- | --- | | Scheduler (rail icon `calendar_view_week`) and everything it opens | [scheduler.md](convoy-os/scheduler.md) | | Trips (rail icon `assignment`): Trips, Trip History, Notices, Bookings, Rate Cards | [trips.md](convoy-os/trips.md) | | Fleet (rail icon `directions_bus`): Vehicles, Drivers, Bus Attendants, External Vehicles, Fuel & Energy, Maintenance, Vehicle Types, and Transport Operators (Managed Operators, Operator Vehicles, Operator Drivers) | [fleet.md](convoy-os/fleet.md) | | Settings (rail footer icon `settings`): Company Settings, Users, Calendars, and the Profile dialog | [settings.md](convoy-os/settings.md) | | Clients (rail icon `corporate_fare`): Managed Clients, Client Users, and the Client Portal sign-in | [clients.md](convoy-os/clients.md) | | HR (rail icon `badge`): Drivers, Earnings, Pay Schemes, Rate Plans, Bonuses, Points, Rewards, Salary Simulator, Audit Log | [hr.md](convoy-os/hr.md) | | Convoy Admin (Convoy staff only): Transport Companies, Message Terms, Discover, Company Leads | [convoy-admin.md](convoy-os/convoy-admin.md) | | Dashboard (rail icon `dashboard`): the Company Dashboard (widgets, layout per user) | [dashboard.md](convoy-os/dashboard.md) | | Reports (rail icon `insert_chart`): the Shuttle Report for clients | [reports.md](convoy-os/reports.md) | | School Bus › Schools & Year Setup (rail icon `school`): schools, riders, academic years, holidays, levels, sessions, bus attendants | [school-bus-setup.md](convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md) | | School Bus › Fares, Policy, Payment Methods, Operator Pay (Year Setup money steps) | [school-bus-money.md](convoy-os/school-bus-money.md) | | School Bus › Stop Library & Stop Assignment | [school-bus-stops.md](convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md) | | School Bus › Route Plans & Feasibility Studies | [school-bus-routes.md](convoy-os/school-bus-routes.md) | | School Bus › Families & Riders, Bus Service Registration, Bus Service Requests, CCA Rides | [school-bus-parents.md](convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md) | | School Bus › School Finance: Collections (Family Bills), Documents, Operator Payments (school pay runs) | [school-bus-finance.md](convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md) | | School Bus › School Dashboard and Live Ops | [school-bus-live.md](convoy-os/school-bus-live.md) | | Ops Control (rail icon `desktop_windows`): runs in the next 2 hours checked against rules, alerts, Acknowledge, Alert Log | [ops-control.md](convoy-os/ops-control.md) | | Live Map (rail icon `map`): every bus now, its device, the run it is on, Trace and Replay | [live-map.md](convoy-os/live-map.md) | | Finance (rail icon `account_balance`): Client Invoices, Documents, Operator Payments, Vehicle Financials, Finance Settings | [finance.md](convoy-os/finance.md) | **Integrating the API (or asking an AI assistant to)?** Start with [integration.md](integration.md): it is the one file to read first, and it points to everything else. **Building a screen?** [screen-map.md](convoy-os/screen-map.md) maps every screen and button of the Convoy OS prototype to its API call and the section that explains it. Read the conventions below first; the menu documents do not repeat them. **Apidog / OpenAPI:** [`convoy-v3-api.openapi.json`](convoy-v3-api.openapi.json) lists every endpoint (OpenAPI 3.0), one folder per resource inside its menu, with the description of the section here that names it and request / response examples recorded from the specs and the seed data. Import it in Apidog (Import → OpenAPI). It is generated, do not edit it by hand: after an API change run `bin/rails api_docs:all` (specs + seed probe + build), or `bin/rails api_docs:openapi` to rebuild from the last recorded examples. --- ## Base URL and format - All endpoints live under `/api/v1`, for example `GET /api/v1/scheduler`. - Request and response bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), except file uploads (multipart, see below). - Keys are **snake_case**: `start_time`, `vehicle_id`, `trip_label`. - **PATCH vs PUT**: updates are documented as `PATCH` (Rails also accepts `PUT` on the same path). A call documented as `PUT` (whole-list saves such as `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar`, `PUT /vehicle_teams/bulk`) takes **only** `PUT`. - Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. Times of day are `"HH:MM"` (24-hour) in requests and responses. A trip that ends after midnight still returns its end as `"HH:MM"` and sets `ends_next_day: true`. - Timestamps (`starts_at`, `created_at`...) are ISO 8601 with the company's offset, for example `2026-11-02T07:45:00+08:00`. - **Money, decimals and coordinates come back as strings**: `"price": "76.19"`, `"lat": "1.2722"`. Send them as numbers or strings. Exception: live GPS (Live Map, Trace / Replay, the Driver app's positions, Ops Control `gps`) returns `lat` / `lng` / `speed_kmh` as **numbers** (`"lat": 1.2801`). Treat both forms as numbers on the front end (`Number(x)`). - Display formats (company Date Format / Time Format) are the front end's job. The only server-formatted text is human sentences such as warnings and summaries, which already follow the company's formats. ## Signing in (Bearer token) `POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request: ``` Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9... ``` - The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again. - Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token. - No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page); mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore. - Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port). | Action | Call | | --- | --- | | Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) | | Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` | | Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` | | Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` | `POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token: ```json { "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00", "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } } ``` `GET /session` response: ```json { "data": { "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg", "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true, "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 }, "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "code": "SD", "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null, "observed_holidays": "off", "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active" } } } ``` - `role`: `convoy_admin` (Convoy staff, see below), `admin` (every permission), `member` (only `permissions`). `owner` = Super Admin. Show `shown_name` (display name or name) in the top bar. Users and the Profile: [settings.md](convoy-os/settings.md). - `company` is `null` for a Convoy Admin until `PATCH /session` picks one (per token: a new sign-in starts with none); company data then answers `422 "Pick a company first"`. - **What a Convoy Admin may change.** Company operational data (trips, runs, vehicles, drivers, finance, school bus...) is **view only**: every write returns `403 "View only. Convoy Admin cannot change company data"` (saving a Dashboard layout returns `422` with the same message). A Convoy Admin **can** write: - the Convoy Admin pages: Transport Companies (`POST /companies`, `PATCH /companies/:id` for any company, including the Company Settings fields and the platform fields), Message Terms, Discover, Company Leads (company users get `403` there); - Vehicle Types (add / edit / remove; turning a type on or off stays with the company Admin); - approve / decline Vehicle Type Requests and Country Requests; - `PATCH /session` (pick a company), their own Profile and notification preferences. - Sample accounts (seed): `ops@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Admin), `dispatch@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Member, vehicles), `admin@convoy.sg` / `Convoy123!` (Convoy Admin). ## Responses Success: ```json { "data": { "...": "..." } } ``` Lists are paged: ```json { "data": [ "..." ], "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "count": 132, "pages": 3 } } ``` - Paging: `?page=2&limit=100` (default limit 50, max 500). - Some lists add more to `meta` (counts for filter chips and so on); each endpoint says so. - Small lists (vehicle types, teams, holidays...) return every row without paging: `{ "data": [...], "meta": {} }`. - Text filters on lists use ransack keys: `?q[name_i_cont]=goo` (case-insensitive "contains"). Each endpoint lists its filters. ## Errors ```json { "error": { "code": "invalid", "message": "Enter the drop-off point", "details": { "base": ["Enter the drop-off point"] } } } ``` | Status | `code` | When | | --- | --- | --- | | 400 | `bad_request` | A required parameter is missing (`message` names it) | | 401 | `unauthorized` | No / bad / expired / signed-out token (`"Sign in to continue"`), or wrong email / password | | 403 | `forbidden` | Not allowed. Convoy Admin writing company data gets `"View only. Convoy Admin cannot change company data"` | | 404 | `not_found` | The record does not exist or belongs to another company | | 409 | `conflict` | Someone else changed the record (see `lock_version`) | | 410 | `gone` | A public tracking link has closed | | 422 | `invalid` / `unprocessable_content` | Validation failed or a business rule was broken; `message` is a sentence to show the user as is; `details` lists field errors | | 429 | `too_many_requests` | Too many requests from one IP (or for one email on sign-in). See Rate limits below | Show `error.message` in the toast. It is written for end users and matches the wording of the Convoy OS prototype. ### Rate limits A refused request answers `429` with a `Retry-After` header (seconds) and the usual error object: ```json { "error": { "code": "too_many_requests", "message": "Too many tries. Try again in 42 seconds", "details": { "retry_after": 42 } } } ``` Show the message, and keep the button disabled for `retry_after` seconds (counting down if you like). | What | Limit | | --- | --- | | Staff sign-in `POST /session` | 10 a minute per IP, 5 a minute per email | | Client Portal email step: `POST /portal/session/lookup`, `POST /portal/session/code` | 30 a minute per IP (and 5 codes an hour per account, a `422`) | | Client Portal password step: `POST /portal/session`, `POST /portal/session/verify`, `POST /portal/password` | 10 a minute per IP, 5 a minute per email (not for `/portal/password`) | | Share Form answers `POST /public/share_forms/:token` | 10 an hour per IP | | Everything else under `/api` | 300 a minute per IP | The limits count fixed one-minute (or one-hour) windows, so the wait is at most the length of the window. ## Optimistic locking (`lock_version`) Trips and runs carry `lock_version`. Send back the value you loaded when saving (`PATCH /trips/:id`, run actions); if someone else saved in between, the API answers `409` and the screen should reload. Leaving it out skips the check. ## Files (uploads and downloads) - Upload with `multipart/form-data`. Nested fields use bracket names, for example `vehicle[photo]`, `trip[stops_attributes][0][photos_attributes][0][photo]`. - Multipart has no `null`: send an empty value (`""`) for an empty field, and the API reads it as `null` (cleared). A field that is never `null` in the response treats empty as "not given" (its default, or unchanged on edit; the menu document says which). An empty required field answers `422` with the field in `details`, never `500`. - Files are private. Any file in a response looks like: ```json { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJfcmFpbHMi...", "thumb_url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "hiace.png", "size": 9273, "content_type": "image/png" } ``` - `url` / `thumb_url` are signed links valid for **1 hour** that open the file on their own (no `Authorization` header, like a pre-signed URL); use them directly in `` or open them in a new tab. They are paths: put the API host in front (`https://convoy-api-staging.convoy.sg` + `url`). Reload the record to get fresh links. Do not share them. - Images are resized to 1280 px; `thumb_url` is a 320 px square. Documents accept PDF, images, xlsx / xls, csv, doc / docx, txt (10 MB max). ## Reading documents with Claude (background reads) Log cards, insurance papers, workshop invoices, route lists and pasted trip messages are read by Claude in the background: 1. `POST /document_reads` with `kind` and a `file` (multipart) or `input_text` → **202** `{ "data": { "id": 7, "status": "pending", ... } }`. 2. Poll `GET /document_reads/:id` every 2–3 s until `status` is `done` (use `result`) or `failed` (show `error`). 3. When saving the form, send `document_read_id` so the server attaches the same file; there is no second upload. | `kind` | Used by | | --- | --- | | `log_card` | Edit Vehicle > Log Card | | `insurance` | Edit Vehicle > Insurance | | `maintenance_invoice` | Maintenance > Record the Work | | `route_list` | Trip form (School Run) > Import Route List | | `trip_message` | Trip form > Fill from Message (`input_text`) | | `fuel_receipt` | Fuel > Drop a Receipt ([fleet § 8.3](convoy-os/fleet.md#83-reading-a-receipt)) | | `vehicle_loan_schedule` | Vehicle Financials > Upload the lender's schedule ([finance § 6](convoy-os/finance.md#6-vehicle-financials-purchase-and-loan)) | ```json { "data": { "id": 7, "kind": "log_card", "status": "done", "error": null, "result": { "plate": "PD3318K", "make": "Toyota" }, "file": { "url": "...", "name": "card.pdf" }, "created_at": "...", "finished_at": "..." } } ``` Only the user who started a read can see it. Without an Anthropic key on the server, reads end `failed` with `"Reading with Claude is not set up (API key missing or not allowed)"`. ## Runs ("occurrences") The Scheduler works on **runs**: one row per trip (or School Bus route) per date, per shuttle timing, per vehicle slot. They are already resolved (times, bus, driver, price), so the screens only display them. - Runs exist up to **`meta.horizon` = today + 120 days**. Later dates have no runs yet: the server adds one date each night. Do not let users browse or act past the horizon (grey out those days, stop the › button there). - Changes made for the future are rules, not runs, so they reach later dates on their own as the horizon moves: an assignment From This Date On, Driver Away / Vehicle Down on a date range, Every Run From Today, Change a Day, public holidays, default driver changes, trip edits. Their date pickers may go past the horizon. - `id` identifies a run; `key` is a stable name for the same run across re-syncs: `t||||` or `r||0|1|1`.

tags.name: Common / Banks
tags.description:
Singapore banks for payment details (Managed Operators): the bank picker with branches, and the branch of an
account number as it is typed.

tags.name: Common / Document Reads
tags.description: Read a file or a message with Claude in the background: POST returns 202 with the read; poll GET until done or failed.

tags.name: Common / Downloads
tags.description: Serves private CarrierWave files behind a signed, expiring token (see Download); the link needs no Bearer header.

tags.name: Common / Sessions
tags.description: Sign in (Bearer token), sign out, who am I, and (Convoy Admin) which company to look at.

tags.name: Dashboard / Dashboard
tags.description:
Dashboard (Company Dashboard): the widgets this user may see, their layout (saved per user, Reset to the default) and
the figures of each widget for a period.

tags.name: Ops Control / Ops Control
tags.description:
Ops Control: the board of runs with a first pick-up in the next 2 hours (checked now, alerts kept in step), the Alert Log
of today, and Acknowledge on a run.

tags.name: Live Map / Live Map
tags.description:
Live Map: every bus now (state, position, device, driver, the run it is on), one bus with its device and the stops of
its run, the runs of a bus on a day (Replay) and a run's GPS points (Trace and Replay).

tags.name: Scheduler / Occurrences
tags.description:
Runs for drivers and admins (today, tomorrow, a date or a range; by driver, vehicle, trip, status), the drawer
detail, and what can be done to one run.

tags.name: Scheduler / Public Tracking
tags.description: Trip Tracking page (public, no sign-in): the run a shared link shows, while it is open.

tags.name: Scheduler / Replacements
tags.description:
Replacements: the Replace form (trip drawer: occurrence_id), Driver Away / Vehicle Down (vehicle panel: a date range
on original_vehicle_id), the Replacements list, and a preview of what a replacement would do before saving.

tags.name: Scheduler / Scheduler
tags.description:
The Scheduler grid for a date range (Day or Week): the vehicles (with the Scheduler's filters and sort), every run in
the range (runs exist up to meta.horizon; later dates are empty), the unassigned runs, and the nearest dates with unassigned runs
before and after the range.

tags.name: Scheduler / Trip Assignments
tags.description: Assign page of a trip: every run x vehicle slot with who runs it as of a date, the history, and give or take back.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Attachments
tags.description: Files on a booking (passenger list, itinerary), up to 10.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Cancel Requests
tags.description: A client's request to cancel a booking or one trip: recorded on their behalf, then accepted or declined.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Notifications
tags.description:
The bell for bookings: events of the last 14 days the user wants (new bookings from the Portal or the App, client
approval done or declined, changes accepted, cancellation requests), newest first, and how many are unseen.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Trips
tags.description:
One trip of a booking: Approve & Convert to Trip (or Approve Without Waiting), Reject, and the client's steps
recorded on their behalf (Client Acknowledged, client approval done / declined). Each returns the whole booking.

tags.name: Trips / Bookings
tags.description:
Trips > Bookings: tabs Pending, Approved, Rejected, Completed with search; booking details; Record Booking / Save
Changes; the estimate of a trip while the form is open.

tags.name: Trips / Notice Templates
tags.description: Notices > Templates: the usual wording, picked in the Notice form ({min} and {time} are filled in there).

tags.name: Trips / Notices
tags.description:
Notices page and Send Notice (trip drawer): tabs Active, Scheduled, Ended with search; End Now (active), Edit (scheduled),
Duplicate, Delete (not active).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Card Assignments
tags.description: Trips > Rate Cards > Client Rate Cards: which card each client is priced by (assigned, else the default card).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Cards
tags.description:
Trips > Rate Cards: list, view, new (the standard starting card), create, edit, Make Default, Archive / Unarchive,
warnings while editing; and Price From Rate Card (Corporate Shuttle in the trip form).

tags.name: Trips / Route Lists
tags.description:
Import Route List (School Run trip form): review a read list, apply it onto a saved School Run, the Earlier Lists,
and the Next 12 Months bill.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Attachments
tags.description: Attachments of a trip.

tags.name: Trips / Trip History
tags.description: Trips > Trip History: every run that ran, was cancelled or skipped, with filters, the record of one run and notes.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Run Groups
tags.description: Runs That Move Together (trip drawer): group run slots, or ungroup.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Stop Photos
tags.description: Stop photos from the trip drawer (up to 3 per stop, resized to 1280 px); the same photos the trip form shows.

tags.name: Trips / Trips
tags.description:
Trips (trip templates). Filters: kind, client_id, vehicle_id, from / to (trips that may run in the range), q (title,
client, label or a Trip ID).

tags.name: School Bus / Academic Years
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Terms & Semesters: a school's academic years, New Academic Year, a year's calendar (terms,
CCA periods, holidays, special days), Save Calendar (locks it), Unlock to Edit and Delete Year.

tags.name: School Bus / Bus Requests
tags.description:
School Bus › Bus Service Requests: a school's requests (New Service by academic year, Change of Address / Service, Stop
Service), a request with its history, Add Application, opening one (Under Review), Acknowledge / Move Answer Date for
mid-year requests, Waitlist / Decline and Message (one or many).

tags.name: School Bus / Bus Sessions
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Sessions of an academic year: the list, a copy of another year's as a draft, and
Save & Lock (Unlock: POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "sessions" }).

tags.name: School Bus / Cca Rides
tags.description:
School Bus › CCA Rides of a school: settings (charged per ride, price, days, seats), a week of CCA bus days with the
rides booked in the Convoy App and its figures, and Bus Not Running (each ride that day becomes credit).

tags.name: School Bus / Extra Charges
tags.description:
School Bus › Bus Fares › Extra Charges of an academic year: this year's charges and the ones carried over from earlier
years, add / edit / delete (while Scheduled), Set End (while Active), and a preview of the next 4 bills.

tags.name: School Bus / Families
tags.description:
School Bus › Families & Riders: a school's families (search, unlinked riders), a family with its guardians and riders
(service, where they ride now), add / rename / delete, guardians, link / unlink riders (with the riders it could
take), and the CSV import / export.

tags.name: School Bus / Fare Tables
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Fares of an academic year: the table (as the wizard sends it), its billing periods and
the fares worked out per tier and bill; Save & Lock; a draft worked out before saving; another year's table as a draft.
Unlock: POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "fares" }.

tags.name: School Bus / Feasibility Studies
tags.description:
School Bus › Feasibility Studies: studies (school or prospect, pick-up, walk, bus prices, fare tiers), students pasted by
postal code (each found on OneMap in the background; Check Again), scenarios (add / copy / change / delete / run in the
background) with their cost and fares, Use Suggested Fares, and a school's real fare table as tiers.

tags.name: School Bus / Rider Assignments
tags.description:
School Bus › Stop Assignment › assigned PUDO points: Set as assigned (by hand), Unassign, Move All Riders Here (a point
takes the riders assigned to the other points of its stop), and Notify (parents told their assigned PUDO; recorded only).

tags.name: School Bus / Rider Datasets
tags.description:
School Bus › school › Rider Data: the uploaded rider lists (state on a date), a check of a file before importing it,
Import (homes placed by OneMap in the background) and Delete.

tags.name: School Bus / Route Money
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans › route drawer money and bus: the regular bus from a date, the operator's price history, and
Route Charges (school pays per bus): the runs with their bus rate and extra, add a change, remove a scheduled one, and
confirm / move / drop the charges carried to a new plan.

tags.name: School Bus / Routing
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans: the engine's parameters (defaults from the routing service and the company's overrides),
Run Routing for a school's session (a background run: poll it), and a run's state.

tags.name: School Bus / School Attendant Policies
tags.description: School Bus › Year Setup › Bus Attendants: which buses need one and who provides them; Save & Lock.

tags.name: School Bus / School Bills
tags.description:
School Bus › School Finance › Collections: the Family Bills card (draft, issue, settings), the school's bills worked out
for today (filter, search, totals, CSV), one bill with its history, and money on bills: payments with a receipt (one
bill or many), late fees waived, credit and debit notes; billing differences against today's riders and fares.

tags.name: School Bus / School Dashboard
tags.description:
School Bus › Dashboard of a school: Operations for everyone who can open the school; Finance (a month) for users with
finance or finview.

tags.name: School Bus / School Documents
tags.description:
School Bus › School Finance › Documents: a school's invoices, credit / debit notes and receipts (filter by type, payer,
search), one document with what to print, Void a receipt, and a payer's Statement of Account.

tags.name: School Bus / School Levels
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › School Levels: the levels (or suggestions from rider data) with rider counts, grades in
rider data that are not levels, the sections, and Save & Lock.

tags.name: School Bus / School Live
tags.description:
School Bus › Live Ops: a school's buses for a session of a day (KPIs, what needs attention, a row per run with its line
and bus position) and one run in detail (alert, crew, log, stops with their children). GPS points of a run: Live Map's
`GET /live_map/runs/:id/track`.

tags.name: School Bus / School Operator Pays
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Operator Pay of a school: settings and default prices per bus size, Save & Lock (Unlock:
POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: "operator_pay" }), and the Break Month Calculator.

tags.name: School Bus / School Payment Methods
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Payment Methods of a school: how parents may pay in the Convoy App, admin fees, and the
account that receives the money (the company's from Finance Settings, or the school's own).

tags.name: School Bus / School Payouts
tags.description:
School Bus › School Finance › Operator Payments: a school's month of operator pay runs (routes, route pay, lines, status,
totals), and the pay run of one operator: lines (with files), invoice number, Send to Finance, Recall, Send Back,
Approve, Reopen, Pay, and the Payment Voucher to print.

tags.name: School Bus / School Plans
tags.description:
School Bus › Route Plans: a school's plans of a session, one plan, Draw Routes (an empty plan to draw by hand), rename
/ dates, delete a draft, comments, and Compare Plans (routing service /diff).

tags.name: School Bus / School Policies
tags.description:
School Bus › Year Setup › Payment & Refund Policy of a school: every version (Scheduled / In Use / Replaced), the

get.description:
GET /api/v1/session

The account menu's **Profile** dialog. Every signed-in user (Convoy Admin too) edits only their own profile.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /profile` |
| Save Profile | `PATCH /profile` (multipart when a picture is sent) |

```
profile[display_name]   optional; empty = use the name
profile[mobile]         optional; "9123 4567" or "+65 9123 4567", saved as +6591234567
profile[avatar]         image file (JPG, PNG, WebP)
profile[remove_avatar]  true to remove the picture
```

The response (also `data.user` of `GET /session`) has `name`, `email` (read only: "set by an Admin in Users"),
`display_name`, `shown_name` (display name or name: use it in the top bar), `initials`, `mobile`, `mobile_display`,
`avatar { url, thumb_url }`, `role_label` (the line under the title, for example "Planner"). `422` when the mobile is not a
possible phone number.

_Source: `convoy-os/settings.md` § 2. Profile_

patch.description:
PATCH /api/v1/session { company_id } — Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this sign-in).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List | `GET /companies` (`q[name_i_cont]`) |
| New Company → Create Company | `POST /companies { company: { name, code? }, admin: { name, email, password } }` |
| External Vehicles limit, School Run / Route List Import switches | `PATCH /companies/:id { company: { external_vehicle_cap, school_run_enabled, route_list_import_enabled } }` |
| Open (work inside a company) | `PATCH /session { company_id }` |

Row (Convoy Admin view): the company fields plus `admin { name, email }`, `schools_count`, `users_count`, `created_at`,
`external_vehicle_cap`, `school_run_enabled`, `route_list_import_enabled`, `is_current` (the company opened for this
sign-in: badge Open). The new company's admin is its Super Admin with every permission ("<name> created. Its admin can sign in
with <email>"). `code` is made from the name when left out. `422`: "Password needs at least 8 characters", "Enter the admin's
name", `details.email` "Email is already used by another user".

`POST /companies` → **201** and `PATCH /companies/:id` → **200** return the same row as the list:

```json
{ "data": { "id": 4, "name": "Lion City Coaches Pte Ltd", "short_name": null, "display_name": "Lion City Coaches Pte Ltd", "code": "LCC",
            "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24",
            "observed_holidays": "off", "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active", "logo": null,
            "country_set_at": null, "ops_phone": null, "ops_hours": null, "ops_whatsapp": null, "ops_email": null, "depot_address": null,
            "country_locked": false, "country_set_by": null, "country_request": null, "can_edit": true,
            "school_run_enabled": false, "route_list_import_enabled": false, "external_vehicle_cap": null,
            "created_at": "2026-11-04T10:12:00+08:00", "admin": { "name": "Daniel Ong", "email": "daniel@lioncity.sg" },
            "schools_count": 0, "users_count": 1, "is_current": false } }
```

A Convoy Admin may change **every** field of any company with `PATCH /companies/:id`: the Company Settings fields
(`name`, `short_name`, `theme_color`, `logo` / `remove_logo`, `timezone`, `date_format`, `time_format`, `observed_holidays`,
`business_units_enabled`, `ops_*`, `depot_address`) and the platform fields (`code`, `country`, `status`,
`school_run_enabled`, `route_list_import_enabled`, `external_vehicle_cap`). `can_edit` is therefore `true` for a Convoy Admin.

_Source: `convoy-os/convoy-admin.md` § 1. Transport Companies_

delete.description:
DELETE /api/v1/session — signs this token out (other devices stay signed in).

`POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request:

```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...
```

- The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again.
- Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token.
- No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page);
  mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore.
- Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) |
| Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` |
| Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` |
| Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` |

`POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token:

```json
{ "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00",
            "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } }
```

`GET /session` response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg",
              "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true,
              "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 },
    "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "code": "SD", "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore",
                 "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null, "observed_holidays": "off",
                 "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active" }
  }
}
```

- `role`: `convoy_admin` (Convoy staff, see below), `admin` (every permission), `member` (only `permissions`).
  `owner` = Super Admin. Show `shown_name` (display name or name) in the top bar. Users and the Profile: [settings.md](convoy-os/settings.md).
- `company` is `null` for a Convoy Admin until `PATCH /session` picks one (per token: a new sign-in starts with none);
  company data then answers `422 "Pick a company first"`.
- **What a Convoy Admin may change.** Company operational data (trips, runs, vehicles, drivers, finance, school bus...) is
  **view only**: every write returns `403 "View only. Convoy Admin cannot change company data"` (saving a Dashboard
  layout returns `422` with the same message). A Convoy Admin **can** write:
  - the Convoy Admin pages: Transport Companies (`POST /companies`, `PATCH /companies/:id` for any company, including the
    Company Settings fields and the platform fields), Message Terms, Discover, Company Leads (company users get `403` there);
  - Vehicle Types (add / edit / remove; turning a type on or off stays with the company Admin);
  - approve / decline Vehicle Type Requests and Country Requests;
  - `PATCH /session` (pick a company), their own Profile and notification preferences.
- Sample accounts (seed): `ops@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Admin), `dispatch@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Member, vehicles),
  `admin@convoy.sg` / `Convoy123!` (Convoy Admin).

_Source: `README.md` § Signing in (Bearer token)_

| Set Password and Sign In | `POST /portal/password { set_password_token, password, password_confirmation, device_name }` | Signed in (§ 2) |
| Account picker (several clients) | 🔒 `PATCH /portal/session { client_user_id }` | `current` set |

reset → "We sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it to set a new password."

code: show it like the prototype ("Sample: the code is 123456 until email sending is set up"). Production never sends it.

- "No client account for this email. Ask your transport company to add you under Managed Clients"

get.description:
GET /portal/me

```json
{ "data": {
  "account": { "id": 2, "email": "kenneth.ong@google.com", "name": "Kenneth Ong" },
  "client_user": {
    "client_user_id": 2, "name": "Kenneth Ong", "title": "Finance", "role": "fin", "role_label": "Finance Admin", "wide": true,
    "client": { "id": 2, "name": "Google Asia Pacific", "kind": "company" },
    "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null } },
  "all_sites": true,
  "sites": [ { "id": 2, "name": "Google Asia Pacific (Pasir Panjang)" }, { "id": 1, "name": "Mapletree Business City" } ],
  "can": { "book": false, "see_all": true, "approve": true, "step_in": false, "users": false, "rules": false, "brand": false, "billing": true },
  "menu": { "approvals": true, "shuttles": true, "school_buses": false, "invoices": true } } }
```

| Field | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `client_user` | Same shape as an account in the session. Top bar: `company` (logo, name) \| client name; person name; "`role_label` \| sites" |
| `all_sites` | `true`: the person covers every site (Super Admin, Admin, Finance Admin, or a client with no sites) → "All sites" |
| `sites` | The sites the person covers, by name (every site when `all_sites`). Empty for a site role whose sites were all removed: they see nothing tied to a site |
| `can` | What the role may do (below). Hide the buttons it does not allow; the API refuses them anyway (`403`) |
| `menu` | Rail items that depend on the person or the client. Home, Bookings, Map, Notices and Settings always show |

`can`:

| Key | Allows | Roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `book` | New Booking, Accept Changes | Super Admin, Admin, Site Super Admin, Site Admin, Member |
| `see_all` | Every booking of their sites (otherwise only their own) | all but Member |
| `approve` | Can be asked by an approval flow | all but Member |
| `step_in` | Decide any waiting step | Super Admin, Admin |
| `users` | Settings › Users (add, change, remove people) | Super Admin, Admin, Site Super Admin, Site Admin |
| `rules` | Settings › Approval Flows | Super Admin, Admin, Site Super Admin, Site Admin |
| `brand` | Settings › Logo and Colour, Teams | Super Admin, Admin |
| `billing` | Invoices, Settings › Billing Details | Super Admin, Admin, Finance Admin, Site Finance |

`menu`: `approvals` (roles that approve, or a person named in an approval flow step), `shuttles` (the client has corporate shuttle routes), `school_buses` (the client
is a school, or a site the person covers is one: Home tile School Buses Today and the AM / PM / CCA activities on the Map),
`invoices` (`can.billing`).

Sites and roles: Super Admin, Admin and Finance Admin cover every site, including sites added later. Site roles cover
only the sites picked for them. Something with no site (a booking the transport company made without one) is shown
to the organisation-wide roles only.

get.description:
GET /portal/roles

```json
{ "data": {
  "roles": [ { "key": "sa", "label": "Site Admin", "tag": "Like Site Super Admin, cannot remove one", "wide": false, "gives": ["sa", "sfin", "member"] } ],
  "features": [
    { "group": "Bookings", "features": [
      { "name": "Make a booking", "detail": "Request trips priced from your rate card. …", "roles": ["super", "adm", "ssa", "sa", "member"] } ] } ] } }
```

- `roles`: the seven roles in order (`super`, `adm`, `fin`, `ssa`, `sa`, `sfin`, `member`) with the one-line tag and
  `gives` (the roles this role may give in Settings › Users).
- `features`: the window's rows by group, as in the design (columns = `roles`; click a row for `detail`). Some rows
  describe things not built yet (ask to cancel, pay invoices, send a notice): shown as in the design.

_Source: `client-portal/shell.md` § 2. `GET /portal/roles` — Role Permissions_

`portal/roles#index`

features.name: Make a booking
features.detail: Request trips priced from your rate card. When the booking meets an approval rule, it goes to the approvers before the transport company sees it.

features.name: See bookings
features.detail: Organisation-wide roles see every booking. Site roles see the bookings for their sites. Members see the bookings they made.

features.name: Live Map
features.detail: Buses on your own trips only, from when the driver heads out until the driver ends the trip. Schools see their school buses once the bus is assigned.

features.name: Shuttle routes and timetables
features.detail: Routes by site with their stops and times, read only. Shown only when the organisation has shuttles.

get.description:
GET /portal/users

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List | `GET /portal/users` |
| Add User | `POST /portal/users { user: { name, email, role, site_ids: [], team_id, manager_id } }` → `201` |
| Edit (name and email stay) | `PATCH /portal/users/:id { user: { role, site_ids: [], team_id, manager_id } }` |
| Remove from Portal | `DELETE /portal/users/:id` → `204` |
| Role pills, "See what each role can do" | [`GET /portal/roles`](shell.md#2-get-portalroles--role-permissions) (`gives` of the viewer's role) |

User:

```json
{ "id": 12, "name": "Mei Ling", "email": "meiling@google.com", "role": "sa", "role_label": "Site Admin", "wide": false,
  "sites": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Mapletree Business City" } ], "team": { "id": 1, "name": "Workplace" }, "manager": null,
  "signed_in": false, "last_sign_in_at": null, "me": false, "can_edit": true, "can_remove": true }
```

- **Who is listed**: people who cannot manage users see only themselves. Super Admins and Admins see everyone; Site Super
  Admins and Site Admins see people who share one of their sites (not the organisation-wide roles).
- `can_edit` / `can_remove`: show the Edit icon and Remove from Portal. An Admin cannot change or remove a Super Admin; a site
  manager changes only people whose sites are all theirs and whose role they may give; nobody removes themselves.
- `signed_in: false` → "Not signed in yet" (they get a one-time code at first sign-in; no password is set here).
- `wide: true` → "All sites" and hide Site Access ("covers every site, including sites added later"). Site roles need at
  least one site, and only the editor's own sites can be given (organisation-wide editors: any site).
- Role pills: only the roles in the viewer's `gives` (default Member).
- Team and Manager are optional. Manager: anyone listed but the person (label the empty choice "Team manager (<name>)"
  when their team has one). A manager is the Their Manager step in approval flows: their own manager, else the team's.
- Removing someone takes them off as manager of others and of teams.

`422` messages: "You cannot give this role", "You can only give your own sites", "Pick at least one site for a <role>",
"Keep at least one Super Admin for <client>", "<email> belongs to a Convoy OS user of your company", "Email is already a
user of this client", "Manager can't be themselves"; `403` for people the viewer does not manage.

_Source: `client-portal/settings.md` § 1. Users_

get.description:
GET /portal/bookings/form — what New Booking offers this person.

| Step | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open the form | `GET /portal/bookings/form` |
| Live estimate and approval preview (on every change, debounced) | `POST /portal/bookings/estimate { booking }` (nothing saved) |
| Service For › Add New Customer (main contractors) | `POST /portal/end_customers { name }` → `{ id, name }` (the same name, any case, is reused) |
| Submit for Approval / Send to <company> | `POST /portal/bookings { booking }` → `201`, the booking (§ 3) + `approval` |

Only `can.book` roles (not Finance roles). `GET /portal/bookings/form`:

```json
{ "coordinator": { "name": "Priya Raman", "email": "priya.raman@google.com" }, "site_required": true,
  "sites": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Mapletree Business City", "address": "…", "lat": 1.2747, "lng": 103.7993,
               "billed_to": { "name": "Google Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd.", "uen": "200817984R", "own": false } } ],
  "main_contractor": false, "end_customers": [],
  "vehicle_types": [ { "id": 3, "name": "13-seater", "seats": 13 } ],
  "rate_card": { "id": 1, "name": "Standard Rates" }, "company": { "name": "SimpleDrive", "country": "SG" },
  "limits": { "days": 10, "span_days": 10, "trips_a_day": 10, "vehicles_a_trip": 10, "stops": 5, "files": 10, "file_mb": 5 } }
```

- Site: only `sites` (pre-pick when there is one); hint "Billed to <name> | UEN". Required when `site_required`.
- Changi terminals T1–T4 only when `company.country` is `SG`. Vehicle sizes: only `vehicle_types` (the client's
  Bookable Vehicles). `rate_card: null` → "No rate card yet. <company> prices this booking."

`booking` (same trip fields as Convoy OS, [trips § Bookings](../convoy-os/trips.md); no `client_id`, no standby):

```json
{ "client_site_id": 1, "client_end_customer_id": null, "service_for": null, "coordinator_name": "Priya Raman",
  "coordinator_email": "…", "coordinator_phone": "…", "po_number": "PO-1", "cost_centre": null, "notes": null,
  "days": [ { "date": "2026-11-13", "trips": [
    { "kind": "one_way", "label": "WEN", "start_time": "09:00", "pax": 10,
      "points": [ { "name": "Changi Airport T3", "use": "pu", "lat": 1.355, "lng": 103.987, "note": "Wait at Gate B" },
                  { "name": "Marina Bay Sands", "use": "do" } ],
      "vehicles": [ { "vehicle_type_id": 3, "count": 1 } ], "contact_name": null, "contact_phone": null, "note": null } ] } ] }
```

With files: send multipart, `booking` = that JSON as a string, `files[]` = up to 10 files of 5 MB each.

Estimate answer: `{ trips: [{ date, kind, amount, lines, without_rate }], total, rate_card, billed_to, approval }`;
`approval` is the [Try a Booking](approval-flows.md#3-try-a-booking) shape for this booking (site, the person, trip types,
total, days ahead): `need: true` → "Rule: <name>", the steps with names ("No one else is on this step, so it goes to the
Admins" when `fallback`), "Then it goes to <company>", button **Submit for Approval**; `need: false` → "Goes straight to
<company>", button **Send to <company>**.

Rules (`422`, as in Convoy OS plus the portal's): "Pick the site this booking is for", "Pick one of your sites", "The first
day can't be in the past", "Days must be no more than 10 days apart", "No more than 10 trips a day", "<date>: enter the number
of passengers", "<date>: 20 passengers but 13 seats. Add a vehicle or pick a bigger one", "<date>: pick vehicle types the
company offers", "<date>: up to 5 stops", "<date>: no more than 10 vehicles a trip", "<file> is over 5 MB".

On Submit the booking gets its number (e.g. `SD26000008`) and its `approval` ([approvals § 4](approvals.md#4-the-approval-on-a-booking)). Needs approval → its trips are `awaiting_approval` (toast
"Booking <no> submitted. <first step names> approves it first", open the Awaiting Approval tab); else `sent` (toast
"Booking <no> sent to <company>") and the transport company is told.

_Source: `client-portal/bookings.md` § 4. New Booking_

post.description:
POST /portal/bookings { booking: {...} } (JSON), or multipart: booking (the same as a JSON string) + files[]

| Step | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open the form | `GET /portal/bookings/form` |
| Live estimate and approval preview (on every change, debounced) | `POST /portal/bookings/estimate { booking }` (nothing saved) |
| Service For › Add New Customer (main contractors) | `POST /portal/end_customers { name }` → `{ id, name }` (the same name, any case, is reused) |
| Submit for Approval / Send to <company> | `POST /portal/bookings { booking }` → `201`, the booking (§ 3) + `approval` |

Only `can.book` roles (not Finance roles). `GET /portal/bookings/form`:

```json
{ "coordinator": { "name": "Priya Raman", "email": "priya.raman@google.com" }, "site_required": true,
  "sites": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Mapletree Business City", "address": "…", "lat": 1.2747, "lng": 103.7993,
               "billed_to": { "name": "Google Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd.", "uen": "200817984R", "own": false } } ],
  "main_contractor": false, "end_customers": [],
  "vehicle_types": [ { "id": 3, "name": "13-seater", "seats": 13 } ],
  "rate_card": { "id": 1, "name": "Standard Rates" }, "company": { "name": "SimpleDrive", "country": "SG" },
  "limits": { "days": 10, "span_days": 10, "trips_a_day": 10, "vehicles_a_trip": 10, "stops": 5, "files": 10, "file_mb": 5 } }
```

- Site: only `sites` (pre-pick when there is one); hint "Billed to <name> | UEN". Required when `site_required`.
- Changi terminals T1–T4 only when `company.country` is `SG`. Vehicle sizes: only `vehicle_types` (the client's
  Bookable Vehicles). `rate_card: null` → "No rate card yet. <company> prices this booking."

`booking` (same trip fields as Convoy OS, [trips § Bookings](../convoy-os/trips.md); no `client_id`, no standby):

```json
{ "client_site_id": 1, "client_end_customer_id": null, "service_for": null, "coordinator_name": "Priya Raman",
  "coordinator_email": "…", "coordinator_phone": "…", "po_number": "PO-1", "cost_centre": null, "notes": null,
  "days": [ { "date": "2026-11-13", "trips": [
    { "kind": "one_way", "label": "WEN", "start_time": "09:00", "pax": 10,
      "points": [ { "name": "Changi Airport T3", "use": "pu", "lat": 1.355, "lng": 103.987, "note": "Wait at Gate B" },
                  { "name": "Marina Bay Sands", "use": "do" } ],
      "vehicles": [ { "vehicle_type_id": 3, "count": 1 } ], "contact_name": null, "contact_phone": null, "note": null } ] } ] }
```

With files: send multipart, `booking` = that JSON as a string, `files[]` = up to 10 files of 5 MB each.

Estimate answer: `{ trips: [{ date, kind, amount, lines, without_rate }], total, rate_card, billed_to, approval }`;
`approval` is the [Try a Booking](approval-flows.md#3-try-a-booking) shape for this booking (site, the person, trip types,
total, days ahead): `need: true` → "Rule: <name>", the steps with names ("No one else is on this step, so it goes to the
Admins" when `fallback`), "Then it goes to <company>", button **Submit for Approval**; `need: false` → "Goes straight to
<company>", button **Send to <company>**.

Rules (`422`, as in Convoy OS plus the portal's): "Pick the site this booking is for", "Pick one of your sites", "The first
day can't be in the past", "Days must be no more than 10 days apart", "No more than 10 trips a day", "<date>: enter the number
of passengers", "<date>: 20 passengers but 13 seats. Add a vehicle or pick a bigger one", "<date>: pick vehicle types the
company offers", "<date>: up to 5 stops", "<date>: no more than 10 vehicles a trip", "<file> is over 5 MB".

On Submit the booking gets its number (e.g. `SD26000008`) and its `approval` ([approvals § 4](approvals.md#4-the-approval-on-a-booking)). Needs approval → its trips are `awaiting_approval` (toast
"Booking <no> submitted. <first step names> approves it first", open the Awaiting Approval tab); else `sent` (toast
"Booking <no> sent to <company>") and the transport company is told.

_Source: `client-portal/bookings.md` § 4. New Booking_

GET /portal/map?activity=am|pm|asa|bookings|shuttles&site_id=

```json
{ "data": {
  "date": "2026-11-04", "now": "2026-11-04T07:20:00+08:00", "site": null,
  "sites": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Punggol", "lat": 1.4043, "lng": 103.902 } ],
  "activities": [ { "key": "am", "label": "AM", "count": 3, "on_road": 1 }, { "key": "shuttles", "label": "Shuttles", "count": 13, "on_road": 2 } ],
  "activity": "am",
  "schools": [ { "id": 2, "name": "Bright Steps (Punggol)", "lat": 1.4043, "lng": 103.902 } ],
  "counts": { "scheduled": 7, "on_the_way": 1, "started": 1, "ended": 4 },
```

- **Site** pills (when `sites` has more than one): All Sites, or `site_id` = one site (its trips, its school).
- **Activities** pills (when more than one): `am` AM, `pm` PM, `asa` CCA (school bus sessions of the schools linked to the
  client or the person's sites), `bookings` Bookings (the client's one-off trips; Members see only trips from their own
  bookings), `shuttles` Shuttles. Without `activity`: the one with buses on the road, else the next to start, else the first.
- **Trip States** counters filter the list: Started, On the way, Scheduled, Ended (`state` of each run).

A run (Bookings, Shuttles):

```json
{ "id": 901, "date": "2026-11-04", "kind": "corporate_shuttle", "title": "Staff Shuttle", "label": "S-08", "site": { "id": 1, "name": "Punggol" },

  "next_stop": { "name": "Blk 101 Punggol Field", "planned_at": "…", "eta_at": "…" },
  "position": { "lat": 1.3984, "lng": 103.9072, "speed_kmh": 25, "heading": 90, "recorded_at": "…" },
```

`end_at`, `line`, `position` while on the road) plus `id`, `kind: "school_bus"`, `title`, `school`, `bus { plate }`,

Row text: time range, state badge, title, "site | kind | booking number | plate | N students", then "Next: <stop>,

patch.description:
PATCH /portal/approval_flows/:for/otherwise { rule: { steps: [{ who: [], people_ids: [], need }], same_person } }

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Approvals On / Own Flow for <site> | `PATCH /portal/approval_flows/:for { on: true \| false }` |
| Add Rule (turns the flow on) | `POST /portal/approval_flows/:for/rules { rule }` → `201` |
| Edit Rule | `PATCH /portal/approval_flows/:for/rules/:id { rule }` |
| Delete Rule (confirm) | `DELETE /portal/approval_flows/:for/rules/:id` |
| Move up / down | `POST /portal/approval_flows/:for/rules/:id/move { direction: "up" \| "down" }` |
| Edit Otherwise (steps and same person only) | `PATCH /portal/approval_flows/:for/otherwise { rule: { steps, same_person } }` |

Every call answers the whole flow (§ 1 shape).

`rule`:

```json
{ "name": "Large bookings",
  "when": { "site_ids": [1], "booker_ids": [12], "team_ids": [2], "kinds": ["airport"], "over": 2000, "lead_days": 3 },
  "steps": [ { "who": ["site", "fin"], "need": "all" }, { "who": ["people"], "people_ids": [14], "need": "any" } ],
  "same_person": "once" }
```

| Field | Rule editor |
| --- | --- |
| `name` | Rule Name (required: "Name the rule, e.g. Large bookings") |

get.description:
GET /portal/approval_flows → the flows the person sets (Flow For pills: Whole Organisation, then their sites)

`GET /portal/approval_flows` → the Flow For pills, in order: "Whole Organisation" (organisation-wide roles only) then each
site the person covers ("<site> (own flow)" when `on`).

```json
{ "data": [ {
  "for": "organisation", "site": null, "on": true,
  "rules": [
    { "id": 2, "name": "Large bookings", "position": 1, "same_person": "other", "approved_automatically": false,
      "when": { "site_ids": [], "booker_ids": [], "team_ids": [], "kinds": [], "over": 2000.0, "lead_days": null },
      "when_text": ["Estimate over S$2,000"],
      "steps": [ { "id": 1, "who": ["fin"], "need": "any", "people": [], "text": "Finance, any one" },
                 { "id": 2, "who": ["admins"], "need": "any", "people": [], "text": "Admins, any one" } ] } ],
  "otherwise": { "id": 1, "name": "Otherwise", "same_person": "once", "approved_automatically": false,
                 "when_text": ["Every other booking"],
                 "steps": [ { "id": 4, "who": ["site"], "need": "any", "people": [], "text": "Site Admins, any one" } ] } } ] }
```

- `for`: `"organisation"` or the site id: use it in every call below (`/portal/approval_flows/:for/...`).
- Drawing: Start "Booking Submitted" → each rule "Checked 1st / 2nd…" (`name`, When = `when_text` lines, Then = each step's
  `text`, or "Approved automatically") → "Otherwise / Every other booking" → End "Sent to <transport company> — They
  confirm, change or decline each trip".
- `same_person` (shown under the steps): `once` "If the same person is on two steps, their approval counts for both",
  `other` "… the later step needs someone else".
- A rule that names a site, person or team removed since shows "a removed site" / "a removed person or team" in
  `when_text` and matches no booking until it is edited.
- A flow never saved shows `on: false`, no rules and an empty Otherwise (`id: null`).

get.description:
GET /portal/settings/billing

`GET /portal/settings/billing` → the entities the person may edit: **the organisation** (organisation-wide roles only)
and each **site billed as its own entity** they cover ("<site>, its own entity"). Sites are made their own entity by the
transport company.

```json
[ { "kind": "organisation", "site_id": null, "site_name": null, "legal_name": "Google Asia Pacific Pte. Ltd.", "uen": "200817984R",
    "billing_address": "70 Pasir Panjang Road, Singapore 117371", "billing_email": "ap@google.com", "attention": "Priya Raman",
    "changed": { "by": "Kenneth Ong", "at": "2026-11-04T10:00:00+08:00", "in_portal": true } } ]
```

| Save | Call |
| --- | --- |
| The organisation | `PATCH /portal/settings/billing/organisation { billing: { legal_name, uen, billing_email, attention, billing_address } }` |
| A site | `PATCH /portal/settings/billing/sites/:site_id { billing: { … same } }` |

- Answer: the entity again. `changed` → "Changed by <by> in the portal, <date>" (`in_portal: false`: by the transport company).
- Legal Name, Billing Email and Billing Address are required; UEN optional (Singapore format, saved upper case); Attention
  optional. `422`: "Enter the legal name", "Enter the billing email", "Check the billing email", "Enter the billing address",
  "Check the UEN".
- The transport company keeps a list of people who get the invoices; Billing Email is the first one invoices go To and
  Attention the person named under Attention. Changing them here changes only those two; anyone else on the list stays.
- "<transport company> sees the change at once and uses it on the next invoice."

post.description:
POST /driver/runs/:id/geofence { position, event: enter | exit, at } — the phone's geofence alert

`{ position, event: "enter" | "exit", at }` — at once, when the phone's geofence fires for a point of the trip on the road
(also start the app's 10-second Arrive countdown). → `{ position, entered_at, exited_at, arrived_at }`.

- `enter`: the server starts its 15-second clock for the point, and arrives at once when the bus's last report is slow
  (5 km/h or less) — `arrived_at` is then set.
- `exit` before arriving = drove past: the clock is cleared.
- The driver's Arrive ([driving.md § 3](driving.md#3-arrive-at-a-point-post-driverrunsidarrive)) still records the
  arrival; send it after the countdown as usual (the first arrival time is kept).
- `422` code `not_started` when the trip is not on the road; "event must be enter or exit".

cards, [vehicle.md § 2](vehicle.md#2-the-switch-vehicle-card-on-drive)). A card:

```json
{ "id": 812, "date": "2026-11-03", "start_time": "06:30", "end_time": "07:20",
  "starts_at": "2026-11-03T06:30:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-11-03T07:20:00+08:00",
  "trip_label": "TID260921", "title": "SSS AM 1", "label": "AM 1",
  "kind": "school", "kind_label": "School Bus", "direction": "To School",
  "client": { "name": "St. Stephen's School", "via": null },
  "status": "scheduled", "status_label": "Scheduled", "seen": false, "started_at": null, "ended_at": null,
  "points_count": 4, "first_point": "Blk 123 Tampines St 11", "last_point": "St. Stephen's School",
  "expected_pax": 13, "requires": "attendance", "vehicle": { "id": 7, "plate": "PD997M" }, "replaced_by": null }
```

- `seen: false` → the New badge (until Trip Details is opened, § 5; it comes back when the run's time, bus or driver changes).
- `client.via`: on a sub-contracted trip, the main contractor ("Google Asia Pacific · via ABC Transport").

- `status: "replaced"` → `replaced_by: { driver_name, vehicle_plate }` ("Replaced by Siti · PD4472H"); the run is read-only.

The card fields plus:

```json
{ "data": {
  "...": "the card fields",
  "trip_value": "1.5",
  "notes": "Wait at the lobby",
  "airport": { "direction": "arrival", "flight_number": "SQ 231", "flight_time": "20:40", "terminal": "T3", "wait_minutes": 60,
               "meet_and_greet": true, "signboard_name": "GOOGLE · MS CHEN",
               "luggage": { "cabin": 2, "medium": 0, "large": 4, "extra_large": 0, "oversized": 0 } },
  "disposal": { "hours": 4.0, "suggested_start_odometer": 45252, "record": null },
  "series": { "day": 2, "of": 3, "title": "SD26000123" },
  "standby": { "location": "Expo loading bay", "address": "10 Bayfront Ave", "lat": 1.284, "lng": 103.8607, "minutes": 15,
               "report_time": "11:45", "note": "Report to the coordinator", "street_view_url": null, "photos": [] },
  "attachments": [ { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "Route 3 rider list.pdf", "size": 48211, "content_type": "application/pdf" } ],
  "contacts": [ { "role": "requestor", "name": "Priya", "phone": "+6591110000" }, { "role": "guest", "name": "Mr Chen", "phone": "+6592220000" } ],
  "contractor": { "name": "ABC Transport", "requires_app": true },
  "replacement": null,
  "points": [
    { "position": 0, "number": 1, "name": "Jurong East MRT", "address": "10 Jurong East St 12", "lat": 1.333, "lng": 103.742,
      "planned_time": "08:00", "note": "Point B", "pickup": true, "dropoff": false, "waypoint": false, "school": false,
      "photos": [ { "url": "...", "thumb_url": "..." } ], "street_view_url": null, "vias": [ { "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.75 } ],
      "pickups": 0, "dropoffs": 0,
      "record": { "arrived_at": "2026-11-03T07:58:00+08:00", "departed_at": "2026-11-03T08:02:00+08:00", "skipped": false, "boarded": 7, "alighted": 0 } }
  ],
  "passengers": [
    { "id": "S-1", "name": "Aaron Lee", "gender": "M", "level": "P3", "address": "Blk 123 Tampines St 11 #08-21",
      "parent_name": "Jason Lee", "parent_phone": "+6598224417", "note": "Allergic to peanuts",
      "pickup_position": 0, "dropoff_position": 5, "state": "expected", "reason": null, "qr_code": "CVR1-S-1-3f9a0c1b2d4e",
      "boarded_at": null, "board_method": null, "alighted_at": null, "alight_method": null, "marked_by": null }
  ],
  "before_you_go": { "not_riding": [ { "id": "S-2", "name": "Emma Lim", "point": "Blk 201 Tampines St 21", "state": "bus_not_required",
                                       "reason": "Unwell. Fever" } ], "skipped_points": [] }
} }
```

- `trip_value`: the driver pay multiplier, shown for **own drivers only**; null for managed drivers, disposals and replaced runs.
- `airport`, `disposal`, `series` (Day `day` of `of` for a booking over several days), `standby`, `contractor`, `replacement`:
  null when they do not apply. `disposal.record` and the actions: [disposal.md](disposal.md).
- `contractor.requires_app: true` = the main contractor wants this run done in its own driver app ("Continue on
  `name`'s app"); the trip form has no app name yet. The handover flow in the app is not built on the server yet.
- `contacts` = Point of Contact; the company's Operations line is on [`GET /driver/company`](profile.md#5-transport-company-get-drivercompany).
- `replacement` (when this run's driver or bus was replaced): `{ kind, reason, driver_name, vehicle_plate, original_vehicle_plate }`.

**Points** (map pins and the stop stepper), in driving order:

- `number` 1, 2, 3… for the stepper; `position` names the point in the [driving actions](driving.md).
- `pickup` / `dropoff`: the arrow; `waypoint: true` = a "Via" row (drive through, nobody boards; no number pin needed);
  `vias` = road pins set between this point and the next (diamonds on the route line).
- `school: true` (School Bus): the school, last in the morning and first in the afternoon.
- `photos`, `street_view_url`: the company's stop photos (trips), or the Stop Library's photo and Street View of the point
  (School Bus). Empty when there is none.
- `planned_time` may be null for middle points of a trip without stop times.
- `pickups` / `dropoffs`: how many names board / alight here (before the trip: "pick-up 2 children").
- `record`: what was recorded (null before the bus gets there): arrival, departure, skipped, boarded and alighted counts.

**Passengers** (School Bus and School Run only; `[]` for other runs): every name with their pick-up and drop-off point
(`position`), `state` (§ 6) and, on School Bus, `qr_code` = the child's boarding pass (match a scanned code with it;
"Not on this trip" otherwise). `reason`: why Bus Not Required. `parent_phone` for Call Parent. `boarded_at`, `board_method`,
`alighted_at`, `alight_method`, `marked_by`: what was recorded (All Passengers).

**Before You Go**: `not_riding` = children not riding today (Bus Not Required from the parent, or marked not boarding) at
their own stop; `skipped_points` = points that will be skipped ([Edit Route](driving.md#8-edit-route-patch-driverrunsidroute)).

post.description:
POST /driver/positions { points: [{ at, lat, lng, speed_kmh, heading, accuracy_m, battery_pct, gsm_bars }] }

`{ points: [ { at, lat, lng, speed_kmh, heading, accuracy_m, battery_pct, gsm_bars } ] }` → `{ recorded, run_id, vehicle, arrived }`.

```json
{ "data": { "recorded": 12, "run_id": 812, "vehicle": { "id": 7, "plate": "PD997M" }, "arrived": [0] } }
```

- Send in batches (every 15–30 s while driving is fine; up to `max_points` points), oldest first or in any order.
  When offline, keep the points and send them when back: late points go into the trip's trace and do not move the bus
  back on the map.
- `at` ISO 8601 (required), `lat` / `lng` (required), `speed_kmh`, `heading` (degrees), `accuracy_m` (the phone's
  accuracy: shown to the office as GPS Good / Fair / Poor), `battery_pct`, `gsm_bars` (0–4). Points older than 48 hours
  are dropped; times in the future count as now.
- The points go to the trip the driver has on the road (or the bus's run at that time) and to the bus the driver is on
  (`vehicle`). A driver on no bus today: `recorded: 0, vehicle: null` (nothing stored).
- `arrived`: positions of points the server just marked as arrived from these points (§ 4) — refresh Trip Details.
- `422` "Each point needs at (ISO 8601), lat and lng", "Send 500 points at most".

_Source: `driver/gps.md` § 2. Send positions: `POST /driver/positions`_

get.description:
GET /driver/config

Read on sign-in and after Switch Company:

```json
{ "data": {
  "gps": { "accuracy": "best", "interval_seconds": 5, "distance_filter_m": 10, "heartbeat_seconds": 300, "geofence_radius_m": 30,
           "arrive_countdown_seconds": 10, "leave_countdown_seconds": 10, "after_trip_minutes": 15, "max_points": 500 },
  "start_early_minutes": 60, "late_warning_minutes": 30,
  "reasons": { "skip_stop": ["No Passengers", "..."], "skip_trip": ["Traffic Congestion", "..."], "force_end": ["Vehicle breakdown", "..."] },
  "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24"
} }
```

- `gps` is the same for every company (no per-company settings): best accuracy (iOS `kCLLocationAccuracyBest`, Android
  `PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY`), a point every `interval_seconds` **and** at least `distance_filter_m` moved (nothing while
  stopped at a light), a forced point every `heartbeat_seconds` when not moving, a native geofence of
  `geofence_radius_m` around each point, and positions for `after_trip_minutes` after the trip ends.
- `start_early_minutes` / `late_warning_minutes`: Swipe to start opens 60 minutes before; more than 30 minutes late shows
  the warning. `reasons`: the lists for Skip, Skip Trip and Force End ([driving.md § 12](driving.md#12-errors-and-reasons)).
- `date_format` (`dmy`, `mdy`, `ymd`, `dmon`) and `time_format` (`24`, `12`): the company's defaults for the Configurations
  screen (the driver may change them on the phone).

_Source: `driver/gps.md` § 1. App settings: `GET /driver/config`_

`driver_app/config#show`

GET /api/v1/companies — Convoy Admin: every company; others: their own.

Endpoints that existed before the Settings menu and now behave differently. Check the screens that use them.

| Endpoint | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATCH /companies/:id` | Admin / Super Admin could save | Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `company[name]` is ignored for company users. `country` only while `country_locked` is `false`. New: `remove_logo` |
| `GET /companies/:id`, `GET /companies` | Company fields | Also `can_edit`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by`, `country_request` |
| `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` on `/calendars`, `/calendars/:id/days`, `/public_holidays` (incl. `import`) | Any company user | Needs the `vehicles` or `finance` permission (`403` otherwise). Reading is unchanged. Change a Day on the Scheduler is affected too |
| `POST /public_holidays` | Added one holiday | A Sunday holiday also adds the Monday after as observed; the response has `meta.observed` (or `null`). Duplicate date message: `Date is already a public holiday` |
| `GET /public_holidays?year=` | `meta: {}` | `meta: { year, count, weekdays, preset_available, preset_missing }` |
| `GET /calendars` | Calendar fields | Also `trips_count` |
| `GET /calendars/:id` | Every day | `?year=` keeps only the days touching that year (no `year` = every day, as before) |
| `POST` / `PATCH /calendars` | | `422` for a duplicate name (any case), the name "Public Holidays", or a changed `kind` |
| `GET /session` (`data.user`) | User fields | Also `display_name`, `shown_name`, `mobile_display`, `role_label`; `initials` come from `shown_name` |
| `POST /session` | | A deleted user cannot sign in |
| Passwords | At least 6 characters | At least 8 characters |

_Source: `convoy-os/settings.md` § 6. Changes to existing endpoints (02/11/2026)_

post.description:
POST /companies { company: {...}, admin: { name, email, password } } — Convoy Admin.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List | `GET /companies` (`q[name_i_cont]`) |
| New Company → Create Company | `POST /companies { company: { name, code? }, admin: { name, email, password } }` |
| External Vehicles limit, School Run / Route List Import switches | `PATCH /companies/:id { company: { external_vehicle_cap, school_run_enabled, route_list_import_enabled } }` |
| Open (work inside a company) | `PATCH /session { company_id }` |

Row (Convoy Admin view): the company fields plus `admin { name, email }`, `schools_count`, `users_count`, `created_at`,
`external_vehicle_cap`, `school_run_enabled`, `route_list_import_enabled`, `is_current` (the company opened for this
sign-in: badge Open). The new company's admin is its Super Admin with every permission ("<name> created. Its admin can sign in
with <email>"). `code` is made from the name when left out. `422`: "Password needs at least 8 characters", "Enter the admin's
name", `details.email` "Email is already used by another user".

`POST /companies` → **201** and `PATCH /companies/:id` → **200** return the same row as the list:

```json
{ "data": { "id": 4, "name": "Lion City Coaches Pte Ltd", "short_name": null, "display_name": "Lion City Coaches Pte Ltd", "code": "LCC",
            "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24",
            "observed_holidays": "off", "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active", "logo": null,
            "country_set_at": null, "ops_phone": null, "ops_hours": null, "ops_whatsapp": null, "ops_email": null, "depot_address": null,
            "country_locked": false, "country_set_by": null, "country_request": null, "can_edit": true,
            "school_run_enabled": false, "route_list_import_enabled": false, "external_vehicle_cap": null,
            "created_at": "2026-11-04T10:12:00+08:00", "admin": { "name": "Daniel Ong", "email": "daniel@lioncity.sg" },
            "schools_count": 0, "users_count": 1, "is_current": false } }
```

A Convoy Admin may change **every** field of any company with `PATCH /companies/:id`: the Company Settings fields
(`name`, `short_name`, `theme_color`, `logo` / `remove_logo`, `timezone`, `date_format`, `time_format`, `observed_holidays`,
`business_units_enabled`, `ops_*`, `depot_address`) and the platform fields (`code`, `country`, `status`,
`school_run_enabled`, `route_list_import_enabled`, `external_vehicle_cap`). `can_edit` is therefore `true` for a Convoy Admin.

_Source: `convoy-os/convoy-admin.md` § 1. Transport Companies_

get.description:
Open: `GET /companies/:id`. Save: `PATCH /companies/:id`. Use the company id from `GET /session` (`data.company.id`). The response (Company Settings view) has:

| Field | Card |
| --- | --- |
| `can_edit` | `false` → show the "View only. Users with the Users permission can change company settings" banner and disable the inputs |
| `name` | Company Name > Full Name (read only: set when Convoy opens the account) |
| `short_name` | Short Name (max 12) |
| `logo` | `{ url, thumb_url }` or `null` |
| `theme_color` | `#RRGGBB` or `null` (the default theme) |
| `timezone` | IANA name, for example `Asia/Singapore` |
| `date_format` | `dmy` (16/10/2026), `mdy` (10/16/2026), `ymd` (2026-10-16), `dmon` (16 Oct 2026) |
| `time_format` | `24` or `12` |
| `business_units_enabled` | Business Units and Projects switch |
| `country`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by { id, name }` | Country card: "Set on <date> by <name>" |
| `country_request` | The pending Request a Country Change (§ 3.3) or `null` |
| `ops_phone`, `ops_hours`, `ops_whatsapp`, `ops_email`, `depot_address` | Operations contacts drivers see in the Convoy Driver app (Contact Operations): phones in E.164, hours as text ("Mon–Sat 05:30–20:00"). No card in the prototype yet; send them like the other fields when one is added |

Save sends only what changed (Save Changes / Discard are front end):

```
PATCH /companies/:id   (multipart when a logo is sent)
company[short_name], company[theme_color], company[timezone], company[date_format], company[time_format],
company[business_units_enabled], company[logo] (PNG, JPG, SVG, WebP), company[remove_logo]=true,
company[country] (only while country_locked is false),
company[ops_phone], company[ops_hours], company[ops_whatsapp], company[ops_email], company[depot_address]
```

Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `name` is ignored for company users. `422` details per field
(for example `theme_color: ["Theme color is invalid"]`).

get.description:
Convoy's own space in the Convoy App (Home banners and the Discover tab). Views, taps and sales are counted by the app.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Advertisers card | `GET /discover/advertisers` |
| Add / Edit Advertiser | `POST /discover/advertisers` (**201**), `PATCH /discover/advertisers/:id` `{ advertiser: { name, kind, premier, country, listing_fee, commission_pct, email } }` |
| Remove Advertiser | `DELETE /discover/advertisers/:id` → `204`; `422` "<name> has placements. End or delete them first" while any placement is not ended (drafts and scheduled count too) |
| Tabs Live / Scheduled / Draft / Ended, search, KPIs | `GET /discover/placements?tab=live&q=` |
| New Placement / Edit (multipart with a picture) | `POST /discover/placements`, `PATCH /discover/placements/:id` `{ placement: {...} }` |
| Open | `GET /discover/placements/:id` |
| Pause / Resume / End now / Duplicate | `POST /discover/placements/:id/pause` · `/resume` · `/end` · `/duplicate` |
| Delete draft | `DELETE /discover/placements/:id` |

Advertiser: `{ id, name, kind (tc Transport Partner, attr Attraction, prog Programme Provider, brand Brand), kind_label, premier,
country, listing_fee (S$ a month), commission_pct, email, live_count }` (`live_count` = placements live or paused).
`GET /discover/advertisers` also returns `meta { kinds: { "tc": "Transport Partner", "attr": "Attraction", "prog": "Programme Provider", "brand": "Brand" } }`. `listing_fee` / `commission_pct` empty: 0 on a new
advertiser, unchanged on edit. `422` "Listing fee must be 0 or more", "Commission must be between 0 and 100%" (also on placements). Premier Partner: shown as "From <partner>", not Sponsored.

Placement (body = response):

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| What it is | `kind`: `trip` Bookable Trip, `prog` Programme or Event, `ad` Advert or Offer, `news` From Convoy (no advertiser); `discover_advertiser_id` |
| Banner | `kicker`, `title`, `subtitle`, `background` (#hex), `image` (file; `remove_image`), `cta` (button label) |
| What people get | trip: `price` (adult), `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `pickup_points`; prog: `price`, `event_on`, `bus_included`; ad: `link`, `promo_code`; `run_by_company_id` (runs the bus), `sold_to_public` |
| Where and who | `show_home`, `show_discover`, `push_once`, `slot` (`std` / `feat` Featured), `audiences[]` (`parents`, `staff`, `bookers`, `public`), `area` (`all`, `east`, `west`, `north`, `ne`, `central`), `school_level` (`any`, `pre`, `primary`, `secondary`) |
| When | `starts_on`, `ends_on`; `status` `draft` (save as draft) or `live` (publish), `paused` |
| Money | `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` (always a number, never `null`), `commission` (price × sold × %), `views`, `taps`, `sold` |

Empty fields (multipart sends `""`):
- `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` left out or empty: on a new placement, or when `discover_advertiser_id` changes, they come
  from the advertiser (0 for `news`); otherwise they stay as they are. Send a number (e.g. `0`) to set them.
- `price`, `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `link`, `promo_code` and the banner texts empty → cleared (`null`).
- `cta` empty → "Book Now". `starts_on` / `ends_on` empty → `422` "Pick the start and end dates".

`state` (response) = `draft`, `scheduled` (published, not started), `live`, `paused` or `ended` (ended now or past `ends_on`).
Tabs: `live` holds `live` **and `paused`**; `scheduled`, `draft`, `ended` hold their own state. `meta.counts` = one count per tab.
The response also has `advertiser { id, name, premier }` (or `null` for `news`), `run_by_company { id, name }` (or `null`),
`image { url }` (or `null`), `kind_label`, `ended_at`, `created_at`. `POST` and `/duplicate` → **201**.

```json
{ "id": 9, "kind": "trip", "kind_label": "Bookable Trip", "discover_advertiser_id": 3,
  "advertiser": { "id": 3, "name": "Sentosa Leisure", "premier": false }, "run_by_company_id": 1, "run_by_company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive" },
  "kicker": "School holidays", "title": "Sentosa Day Out", "subtitle": "Return coach from 6 pick-up points", "background": "#0B6E6E", "cta": "Book Now",
  "image": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJ..." }, "price": "38.0", "child_price": "28.0", "seats": 40, "event_on": "2026-12-05",
  "pickup_points": "Tampines, Jurong East, Woodlands", "bus_included": false, "sold_to_public": true, "link": null, "promo_code": null,
  "show_home": true, "show_discover": true, "push_once": false, "slot": "feat", "audiences": ["parents", "public"], "area": "all", "school_level": "any",
  "starts_on": "2026-11-10", "ends_on": "2026-12-04", "status": "live", "state": "live", "listing_fee": "0.0", "commission_pct": "10.0",
  "commission": "114.0", "views": 1240, "taps": 96, "sold": 30, "ended_at": null, "created_at": "2026-11-02T11:00:00+08:00" }
```
`meta { tab, counts, kpis { live, scheduled, views, taps, tap_rate, sold, revenue, listing_fees, commission }, kinds, audiences, areas, levels }`.
`422` (`message`): "Pick the advertiser", "Enter the title", "Pick the start and end dates", "Check the dates: the end is before the start", "Show it on Home, the
