post.description:
Convoy's own space in the Convoy App (Home banners and the Discover tab). Views, taps and sales are counted by the app.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Advertisers card | `GET /discover/advertisers` |
| Add / Edit Advertiser | `POST /discover/advertisers` (**201**), `PATCH /discover/advertisers/:id` `{ advertiser: { name, kind, premier, country, listing_fee, commission_pct, email } }` |
| Remove Advertiser | `DELETE /discover/advertisers/:id` → `204`; `422` "<name> has placements. End or delete them first" while any placement is not ended (drafts and scheduled count too) |
| Tabs Live / Scheduled / Draft / Ended, search, KPIs | `GET /discover/placements?tab=live&q=` |
| New Placement / Edit (multipart with a picture) | `POST /discover/placements`, `PATCH /discover/placements/:id` `{ placement: {...} }` |
| Open | `GET /discover/placements/:id` |
| Pause / Resume / End now / Duplicate | `POST /discover/placements/:id/pause` · `/resume` · `/end` · `/duplicate` |
| Delete draft | `DELETE /discover/placements/:id` |

Advertiser: `{ id, name, kind (tc Transport Partner, attr Attraction, prog Programme Provider, brand Brand), kind_label, premier,
country, listing_fee (S$ a month), commission_pct, email, live_count }` (`live_count` = placements live or paused).
`GET /discover/advertisers` also returns `meta { kinds: { "tc": "Transport Partner", "attr": "Attraction", "prog": "Programme Provider", "brand": "Brand" } }`. `listing_fee` / `commission_pct` empty: 0 on a new
advertiser, unchanged on edit. `422` "Listing fee must be 0 or more", "Commission must be between 0 and 100%" (also on placements). Premier Partner: shown as "From <partner>", not Sponsored.

Placement (body = response):

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| What it is | `kind`: `trip` Bookable Trip, `prog` Programme or Event, `ad` Advert or Offer, `news` From Convoy (no advertiser); `discover_advertiser_id` |
| Banner | `kicker`, `title`, `subtitle`, `background` (#hex), `image` (file; `remove_image`), `cta` (button label) |
| What people get | trip: `price` (adult), `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `pickup_points`; prog: `price`, `event_on`, `bus_included`; ad: `link`, `promo_code`; `run_by_company_id` (runs the bus), `sold_to_public` |
| Where and who | `show_home`, `show_discover`, `push_once`, `slot` (`std` / `feat` Featured), `audiences[]` (`parents`, `staff`, `bookers`, `public`), `area` (`all`, `east`, `west`, `north`, `ne`, `central`), `school_level` (`any`, `pre`, `primary`, `secondary`) |
| When | `starts_on`, `ends_on`; `status` `draft` (save as draft) or `live` (publish), `paused` |
| Money | `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` (always a number, never `null`), `commission` (price × sold × %), `views`, `taps`, `sold` |

Empty fields (multipart sends `""`):
- `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` left out or empty: on a new placement, or when `discover_advertiser_id` changes, they come
  from the advertiser (0 for `news`); otherwise they stay as they are. Send a number (e.g. `0`) to set them.
- `price`, `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `link`, `promo_code` and the banner texts empty → cleared (`null`).
- `cta` empty → "Book Now". `starts_on` / `ends_on` empty → `422` "Pick the start and end dates".

`state` (response) = `draft`, `scheduled` (published, not started), `live`, `paused` or `ended` (ended now or past `ends_on`).
Tabs: `live` holds `live` **and `paused`**; `scheduled`, `draft`, `ended` hold their own state. `meta.counts` = one count per tab.
The response also has `advertiser { id, name, premier }` (or `null` for `news`), `run_by_company { id, name }` (or `null`),
`image { url }` (or `null`), `kind_label`, `ended_at`, `created_at`. `POST` and `/duplicate` → **201**.

```json

  "advertiser": { "id": 3, "name": "Sentosa Leisure", "premier": false }, "run_by_company_id": 1, "run_by_company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive" },
  "kicker": "School holidays", "title": "Sentosa Day Out", "subtitle": "Return coach from 6 pick-up points", "background": "#0B6E6E", "cta": "Book Now",
  "image": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJ..." }, "price": "38.0", "child_price": "28.0", "seats": 40, "event_on": "2026-12-05",
  "pickup_points": "Tampines, Jurong East, Woodlands", "bus_included": false, "sold_to_public": true, "link": null, "promo_code": null,
  "show_home": true, "show_discover": true, "push_once": false, "slot": "feat", "audiences": ["parents", "public"], "area": "all", "school_level": "any",
  "starts_on": "2026-11-10", "ends_on": "2026-12-04", "status": "live", "state": "live", "listing_fee": "0.0", "commission_pct": "10.0",
  "commission": "114.0", "views": 1240, "taps": 96, "sold": 30, "ended_at": null, "created_at": "2026-11-02T11:00:00+08:00" }
```

| What it is | `kind`: `trip` Bookable Trip, `prog` Programme or Event, `ad` Advert or Offer, `news` From Convoy (no advertiser); `discover_advertiser_id` |
| Banner | `kicker`, `title`, `subtitle`, `background` (#hex), `image` (file; `remove_image`), `cta` (button label) |
| What people get | trip: `price` (adult), `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `pickup_points`; prog: `price`, `event_on`, `bus_included`; ad: `link`, `promo_code`; `run_by_company_id` (runs the bus), `sold_to_public` |
| Where and who | `show_home`, `show_discover`, `push_once`, `slot` (`std` / `feat` Featured), `audiences[]` (`parents`, `staff`, `bookers`, `public`), `area` (`all`, `east`, `west`, `north`, `ne`, `central`), `school_level` (`any`, `pre`, `primary`, `secondary`) |
| When | `starts_on`, `ends_on`; `status` `draft` (save as draft) or `live` (publish), `paused` |
| Money | `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` (always a number, never `null`), `commission` (price × sold × %), `views`, `taps`, `sold` |

Empty fields (multipart sends `""`):
- `listing_fee`, `commission_pct` left out or empty: on a new placement, or when `discover_advertiser_id` changes, they come
  from the advertiser (0 for `news`); otherwise they stay as they are. Send a number (e.g. `0`) to set them.
- `price`, `child_price`, `seats`, `event_on`, `link`, `promo_code` and the banner texts empty → cleared (`null`).
- `cta` empty → "Book Now". `starts_on` / `ends_on` empty → `422` "Pick the start and end dates".

`state` (response) = `draft`, `scheduled` (published, not started), `live`, `paused` or `ended` (ended now or past `ends_on`).
Tabs: `live` holds `live` **and `paused`**; `scheduled`, `draft`, `ended` hold their own state. `meta.counts` = one count per tab.
The response also has `advertiser { id, name, premier }` (or `null` for `news`), `run_by_company { id, name }` (or `null`),
`image { url }` (or `null`), `kind_label`, `ended_at`, `created_at`. `POST` and `/duplicate` → **201**.

```json
{ "id": 9, "kind": "trip", "kind_label": "Bookable Trip", "discover_advertiser_id": 3,
  "advertiser": { "id": 3, "name": "Sentosa Leisure", "premier": false }, "run_by_company_id": 1, "run_by_company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive" },
  "kicker": "School holidays", "title": "Sentosa Day Out", "subtitle": "Return coach from 6 pick-up points", "background": "#0B6E6E", "cta": "Book Now",
  "image": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJ..." }, "price": "38.0", "child_price": "28.0", "seats": 40, "event_on": "2026-12-05",
  "pickup_points": "Tampines, Jurong East, Woodlands", "bus_included": false, "sold_to_public": true, "link": null, "promo_code": null,
  "show_home": true, "show_discover": true, "push_once": false, "slot": "feat", "audiences": ["parents", "public"], "area": "all", "school_level": "any",
  "starts_on": "2026-11-10", "ends_on": "2026-12-04", "status": "live", "state": "live", "listing_fee": "0.0", "commission_pct": "10.0",
  "commission": "114.0", "views": 1240, "taps": 96, "sold": 30, "ended_at": null, "created_at": "2026-11-02T11:00:00+08:00" }
```
`meta { tab, counts, kpis { live, scheduled, views, taps, tap_rate, sold, revenue, listing_fees, commission }, kinds, audiences, areas, levels }`.
`422` (`message`): "Pick the advertiser", "Enter the title", "Pick the start and end dates", "Check the dates: the end is before the start", "Show it on Home, the
Discover tab or both", "Pick who sees it"; when publishing also "Enter the price", "Pick the transport company that runs the bus",
"Add a link or a promo code". Delete: "Only drafts can be deleted. End it instead". Duplicate → a draft "<title> (copy)".

get.description:
GET /dashboard?period=today|d7|d30|month|last_month&widgets[]=otp — the figures of the widgets (all the user may see).

`GET /dashboard?period=today|d7|d30|month|last_month&widgets[]=otp&widgets[]=rev` (no `widgets` = every widget the user may see):

```json
{ "period": { "key": "today", "from": "2026-11-02", "to": "2026-11-02", "compare": "same day last week" },
  "widgets": { "otp": { "available": true, "value": 50.0, "runs": 2, "on_time": 1, "change": null, "allowance": 5, "series": [...] },
               "noshow": { "available": false, "reason": "No-shows are not recorded yet" } } }
```

`period`: `today`, `d7` (7 days), `d30` (30 days), `month` (month to date), `last_month`; `change` is against `compare`.
Widgets that look at now or ahead have a `note` ("Shows today, so the period does not change it", …): show it under the widget.
`available: false` → show the `reason` in an empty widget (only `noshow`: no-shows are not recorded anywhere yet).

| Widget | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| `otp` | `value` (% runs with no stop later than the company's on-time minutes), `runs`, `on_time`, `change`, `allowance`, `series [{ date, pct }]` |
| `late` | `count` (late runs), `missed_pickups` (stops skipped), `series [{ date, count }]` (late + missed a day), `list [{ occurrence_id, date, trip_label, client, plate, driver, late_minutes }]` |
| `today` | `total`, `completed`, `scheduled`, `cancelled`, `change` (runs), `running` (started, not ended), `still_to_run`, `average_a_day`, `busiest { date, count }`, `by_client [{ client_id, name, runs }]`, `series [{ date, count }]` — Today: "Right Now" Done / Running / Still to run; other periods: Summary + Busiest day |
| `unas` | `count`, `list [{ occurrence_id, date, start_time, trip_label, title, client, missing: bus \| driver \| both }]` — next 7 days: runs with no bus, or an own bus with no driver ("No bus" / "No driver" / "No bus or driver") |
| `alerts` | `count` (trips flagged now), `action`, `at_risk`, `note`, `list [{ occurrence_id, plate, title, message, severity: 2 Action \| 1 At Risk }]` — live, from [Ops Control](ops-control.md); `period { raised, escalated, avg_ack_seconds }` = "In the Period" (alerts raised in the period, escalated to the Ops Manager, average time to acknowledge; `null` when none was acknowledged) |
| `compl` | `count`, `change`, `list [{ occurrence_id, date, trip_label, reason }]` — runs in the period with an issue raised (Raise Issue on a run in the Scheduler drawer / Trip History; `reason` = its text), latest 5 |
| `util` | `value` (% hours on runs of hours available: 12 a day per own vehicle), `change`, `vehicles` (**a count**: own vehicles), `hours_a_day` (12), `series [{ date, pct }]` (one per day of the period) |
| `off` | `count`, `list [{ vehicle_id, plate, reason, kind, back_on }]` (maintenance today, vehicle down); `kind` = the maintenance kind (Service, Repair, Tyres, Inspection, Other) or "Replaced" (badge), `back_on` = "Back dd/mm" (the day after the visit / the replacement) |
| `docs` | `count`, `expired`, `list [{ vehicle_id, plate, document: COE \| Road Tax \| Insurance, expires_on }]` — next 60 days |
| `duty` | `active`, `driving_today`, `without_bus`, `pending_invites` |
| `rev` | `value` (client price of runs not cancelled), `change`, `change_pct`, `series [{ date, amount }]`, `month { revenue, cost, profit }` (this month from Vehicle Financials; `null` without `vehfin`) |
| `profit` | `revenue`, `cost`, `profit`, `margin`, `change` (on last month), `ytd` (profit of this year's months), `vehicles [{ vehicle_id, plate, profit }]` (By Vehicle, best first), `chart [{ month: "2026-10", revenue, cost, profit }]` (12 months to this month, oldest first) — this month, from Vehicle Financials |
| `topbot` | `top` (best 5), `bottom` (lowest 5, empty with 5 vehicles or fewer) `[{ vehicle_id, plate, profit, change }]` — this month vs last |
| `coll` | `bills`, `billed`, `collected`, `outstanding`, `not_paid` (bills not fully paid), `overdue` (amount), `overdue_bills`, `note` — School Bus bills of the schools the user may open, as of today (the `kpis` of [Finance › School Bus Collections](finance.md)); "Overdue" tile = `overdue` + "`overdue_bills` bills past due and grace" |
| `opp` | `waiting`, `waiting_items`, `waiting_operators` ("from N operators"), `approved_unpaid`, `approved_unpaid_batches` ("N batch"), `next_pay { date, number, amount }` |
| `loans` | `due`, `count`, `overdue`, `overdue_amount`, `list [{ vehicle_id, plate, lender, due_on, amount, overdue }]` — this month and overdue |
| `clotp` | `target: 95`, `clients [{ client_id, name, runs, on_time, change }]` (`change` = points on the period before: "+1.2 pts on …") — also the source for the `otp` widget's "By Client" list (`on_time` = % of `runs`) |
| `clrisk` | `count`, `list [{ client_id, name, reasons: ["On time 88.5% (-2.1 pts)", "On time 91.0% (+0.7 pts)", "S$1200.00 overdue"], on_time, change, badge: Below Target \| Falling \| Overdue }]` — below 95 %, falling 1 point or more on the period before, or with overdue invoices |

Clicking an item opens its page (`page` of the widget; runs: Trip History / Scheduler by `occurrence_id`).

_Source: `convoy-os/dashboard.md` § 2. Figures_

get.description:
GET /dashboard/widgets — sections and widgets (default sizes) the user may see.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| The widgets this user may see (tray, sections, default sizes) | `GET /dashboard/widgets` |
| The user's layout | `GET /dashboard/layout` |
| Save the layout (after editing) | `PUT /dashboard/layout { pages: [...] }` |
| Keep the period picked / the page open (no Edit Layout) | `PATCH /dashboard/layout { period, page }` |
| Reset to the default layout | `DELETE /dashboard/layout` |

Widgets: `{ sections [{ key, title }], widgets [{ key, section, title, icon, page, link, cols, rows }], cols: 8, max_pages: 6 }`.
`page` = the page id the widget's link opens (`opsctl`, `trips`, `scheduler`, `triphist`, `vehicles`, `drivers`, …: the same
ids as [integration.md](../integration.md)); `link` = the link's label ("Ops Control", "Trip History", "Vehicles", …).

| Key | Title | Who sees it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `otp`, `late`, `today`, `unas`, `alerts`, `compl` | On-Time Starts, Late Starts and Missed Pick-ups, Trips, Unassigned Trips, Open Ops Control Alerts, Complaints and Incidents | Everyone |
| `util`, `off`, `docs`, `duty`, `noshow` | Fleet Utilisation, Vehicles Off the Road, Documents Expiring, Drivers, Driver No-Shows | Everyone |
| `rev` | Revenue | `finance`, `finview` or `vehfin` |
| `profit`, `topbot`, `loans` | Fleet Profit, Vehicles by Profit, Loan Instalments | `vehfin` |
| `coll`, `opp` | Collections, Operator Payments | `finance` or `finview` |
| `clotp`, `clrisk` | On-Time Starts by Client, Clients at Risk | Everyone |

Layout: `{ pages: [{ name, items: [{ widget, x, y, cols, rows }] }], period, page, saved, updated_at }` — `period` (default `d7`,
as the prototype) is the period to open with, `page` the index of the page open last (0 = first); send them with `PATCH`
when the user picks a period or a page (`422` on an unknown period). `saved: false` = the default
(one "Overview" page with every widget the user may see); `saved: true` = a layout is stored for the user. The first `PATCH` (period / page) stores the default pages with it, so `saved` is also `true` after it; only `DELETE` resets it. `page` is an index (0 = first), not a widget id. Save sends the whole layout; widgets the user may not see are
dropped. `422` "Pages can be 1 to 6", "Page 1 needs a name", "Page 1 has a widget out of the grid" (x + cols ≤ 8, rows 1–6).

_Source: `convoy-os/dashboard.md` § 1. Widgets and layout_

post.description:
POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: levels | attendants }

Levels are set per school, not per year.

`GET /schools/:id/levels`:

```json
{ "saved": false,
  "levels": [ { "name": "P1", "section": "pri", "final": false, "riders": 0 }, { "name": "P6", "section": "pri", "final": true, "riders": 1 } ],
  "locked": null,
  "unknown": [ { "grade": "Pre-U", "riders": 1 } ],
  "sections": [ { "key": "pri", "name": "Primary", "group": null, "description": "P1 to P6", "levels": ["P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6"] } ] }
```

- Before levels are saved (`saved: false`), `levels` are suggestions from rider data. A whole section is suggested when a
  rider's grade matches one of its levels; otherwise the grades found are suggested. The last suggestion is marked final.
- `riders` counts today's riders whose grade matches, ignoring case.
- `unknown` lists grades in rider data that are not levels. Each has a one-click Add.
- `sections` are the "What the School Offers" cards, with their default levels.

**Save & Lock:** `PATCH /schools/:id/levels { levels: [{ name, section, final }] }` (send JSON, in order).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Add at least one level" | Empty list |
| "Every level needs a name" | A level has no name |
| "P1 is listed twice" | Duplicate name (ignoring case) |

**Unlock:** `POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: "levels" }` returns 204.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 5. School Levels_

`schools#unlock`

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/bus_attendants

`GET /schools/:id/bus_attendants`:

```json
{ "needs": "statutory", "sizes": [], "provided_by": "operator", "needed_sizes": ["LARGE_45","LARGE_40"], "saved": true,
  "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" },
  "bus_types": [ { "key": "LARGE_45", "label": "45-seater", "seats": 45, "required_by_law": true, "ba_operator": "300.0", "ba_us": "250.0" } ],
  "routes": [ { "id": 41, "label": "AM 1", "session": "am", "bus_type": "LARGE_45" } ] }
```

**Save & Lock:**

```
PATCH /schools/:id/bus_attendants { needs: statutory|all|selected, sizes: [...], provided_by: operator|us }
```

- An empty body is `422` "Send needs, sizes or provided_by" and nothing is saved or locked.
- `routes[].bus_type` is `null` for a route that has none (a hand-made route, old data): it needs no attendant. Routes from the routing engine always have one.
- With `selected`, at least one size is required, and the sizes required by law are always included.
- The price table (Their BA / Our BA): `bus_types[].ba_operator` / `ba_us` (S$ a month, from Operator Pay,
  [school-bus-money.md](school-bus-money.md); `null` = not priced).
- `routes`: the routes of the plans in use (current and scheduled). Count them against the settings being edited: "x of
  y routes in current plans need a BA with these settings" (a route needs one when its `bus_type` is required by the
  settings); "No routes in current plans yet" when empty.

**Unlock:** `POST /schools/:id/unlock { section: "attendants" }`.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 7. Bus Attendants_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/policy

The policy is set per school and published as versions. Each version applies from its `effective_on` date.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/policy` | The versions, the current and scheduled versions, a draft for "New Version", and this year's collection cycle |
| `POST /schools/:id/policy` | Publish (JSON) |

```json
{ "versions": [ { "version": 2, "effective_on": "2027-02-01", "state": "scheduled", "published_by": "…", "published_at": "…" },
                { "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02", "state": "in_use", … } ],
  "current": { …fields…, "version": 1, "effective_on": "2026-11-02" },
  "scheduled": { … } | null,
  "draft": { …fields…, "reminders": [...], "effective_on": "2027-02-01" },
  "collection": { "year": "2026", "cycle": "period", "months": [...], "payer": "parents", "bill_to_name": null, "bill_to_email": null } }
```

- `state` is `scheduled`, `in_use` or `replaced`.
- `draft` starts from the scheduled version if there is one, otherwise the current one, otherwise the Convoy defaults.
- "Collection cycle" and the school-pays banner ("Due dates, late fees and reminders apply to the school bill…") come from
  `collection`.

**Fields (publish body)**

| Group | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| Due | `due_rule`: `before` (`due_days_before`), `day` (`due_day`, 1–28) or `first` (first school day) |
| Late payment | `late_type`: `none`, `flat` (`late_flat`) or `pct` (`late_pct` per month, optional `late_cap`). Also `late_grace_days` and `late_flag_days` (flag the account for an Admin; service is never stopped automatically) |
| Reminders | `reminders: [{ timing: before\|on\|after, days, email, whatsapp, app, email_subject, email_body, whatsapp_body, app_title, app_body }]`. Tokens: `[Parent Name]`, `[Child Name]`, `[Amount]`, `[Due Date]`, `[Period]`, `[School]`, `[Pay Link]`, `[Late Charge]` |
| Withdrawal | `withdrawal_notice` + `withdrawal_unit` (`days`, `weeks`, `months`); `refund_basis` (`days`, `months`, `term`); `refund_method` (`credit`, `bank`, `parent`); `refund_within_days`; `withdrawal_fee` |
| Change of address | `address_notice_days`; `address_start` (`any`, `mon`, `first`); `address_max_days` (at least the notice) |
| Deposit and fees | `deposit_amount`; `deposit_return` (`offset`, `separate`); `registration_fee` |
| Acknowledgement | `ack_required`, `ack_reaccept`, `ack_text` |

Publishing rules:

- `effective_on` must be today or later.
- Publishing **replaces a version that has not started yet**; that version keeps its number. Otherwise the new version
  gets the next number.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "The effective date cannot be in the past" | `effective_on` before today |
| "Pick a due day from 1 to 28" | `due_day` out of range |
| "Enter the late fee" | `flat` late type without `late_flat` |
| "Keep at least one reminder" | No reminders |
| "3 days after due: pick a channel and fill in each message" | A reminder has no channel or an empty message |
| "Enter the acknowledgement text" | `ack_required` without `ack_text` |

Reminders are set up here only; they are not sent yet.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-money.md` § 4. Payment & Refund Policy_

`school_policies#show`

get.description:
This sets how parents pay a school's bills in the Convoy App.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/payment_methods` | The current methods and accounts |
| `PATCH /schools/:id/payment_methods { bank: { on, fee_kind, fee }, paynow: {…}, card: {…}, own_account, bank_id, account_number, account_name, paynow_id }` | Save |

```json
{ "saved": true, "bank": { "label": "Bank Transfer", "on": true, "fee_kind": "none", "fee": null },
  "paynow": { "label": "PayNow", "on": true, … }, "card": { "label": "Card", "on": true, "fee_kind": "pct", "fee": "3.0" },
  "own_account": false, "account_bank": null, "account_number": null, "account_name": null, "paynow_id": null,
  "updated_by": "…", "updated_at": "…",
  "company_account": { "bank": { "id": 2, "name": "DBS Bank", "code": "7171" }, "account_number": "…", "account_name": "…", "paynow": "…" } }
```

- Not saved yet means Bank Transfer and PayNow with no fee, paid into the company account. Show "Not saved yet. Parents
  see Bank Transfer and PayNow with no fee".
- `fee_kind` is `none`, `fixed` (S$) or `pct` (up to 10).
- `own_account: true` pays into the school's own account, using `bank_id` (from `GET /banks`), `account_number`,
  `account_name` and `paynow_id`. Otherwise the company's Finance Settings › Payment Details are used (`company_account`).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Turn on at least one way to pay" | Every method is off |
| "Enter the admin fee for Card" | A fee kind is set without a fee |
| "The admin fee for Card looks too high: use a percentage up to 10" | `pct` fee above 10 |
| "Bank Transfer needs the company's bank account: add it in Finance Settings, Payment Details, or use this school's own account" | Bank Transfer is on with no account |
| "PayNow needs the company's PayNow UEN…" | PayNow is on with no PayNow ID |

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-money.md` § 5. Payment Methods_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/operator_pay/calculator { academic_year_id, start_date, price }

This is set per school, and only finance users see it.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/operator_pay` | Settings and prices per bus size |
| `PATCH /schools/:id/operator_pay` | Save & Lock |
| `POST /schools/:id/operator_pay/calculator { academic_year_id, start_date, price }` | Break Month Calculator |

```json
{ "saved": true, "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" },
  "scheme": "some", "paid_months": [1,2,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,11], "part_pct": "50.0", "part_basis": "school",
  "break_months": [6, 12], "break_pay": "earned", "earn_by": "terms", "grace_start_days": 0, "deduct_days": 0,
  "rates": [ { "bus_type": "MEDIUM_23", "label": "23-seater", "seats": 23, "student_seats": 23, "ba_required": false,
               "fixed_on": true, "monthly": "3600.0", "rider_on": true, "base_price": "3000.0", "riders_included": 15, "per_rider": "60.0",
               "default_mode": "fixed", "ba_operator": null, "ba_us": null } ] }
```

The PATCH body has the same fields: `rates: [{ bus_type, fixed_on, monthly, rider_on, base_price, riders_included,
per_rider, default_mode, ba_operator, ba_us }]`.

**Settings**

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `scheme` | `all`: 12 months, full pay. `some`: the `paid_months` only. `part`: `paid_months` in full and the other months at `part_pct` % |
| `part_basis` | Part months count `school` days or `cal` (calendar) days |
| `break_months` | Months paid as a retainer |
| `break_pay` | `full`, or `earned` |
| `earn_by` (when earned) | `terms`: each term the route ran in counts equally; within one term, its halves count. `days`: school days run out of the term's school days, with `grace_start_days` (a start within this many days counts from day 1) and `deduct_days` |
| Prices per size | Fixed Monthly (`fixed_on`, `monthly`) and/or Fixed + Per Rider (`rider_on`, `base_price`, `riders_included`, `per_rider`). Keep at least one; `default_mode` chooses between them when both are on. The bus attendant add-ons are `ba_operator` ("their BA") and `ba_us` ("our BA"); `ba_required` follows the Bus Attendants step; `student_seats` is `seats` less the attendant's seat when `ba_required` |

The Bus Attendants page (`GET /schools/:id/bus_attendants`) shows `ba_operator` / `ba_us` for each bus type.

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one paid month" | `some` or `part` with no `paid_months` |
| "Enter a percentage from 0 to 100" | `part_pct` out of range |
| "13-seater: enter the base price, riders included and extra per rider" | Per Rider is partly filled |

**Break Month Calculator.** For each break month of the chosen year, it shows what a route starting on `start_date` at
`price` a month is paid. It uses the settings as they are saved. Part pay is multiplied by the retainer earned in the term
or terms before (terms less than 21 days apart count together).

```json
[ { "month": "2027-06", "label": "Jun 2027", "rate": "0.5", "earned": "0.5", "pct": 25, "amount": "500.0",
    "note": "Ran in 1 of 2 halves of the term, at 50% part pay" } ]
```

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-money.md` § 6. Operator Pay_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/stops/import { from_school_id, with_catchments }

Each school has its own catchment on a stop:

- postal codes;
- drawn areas, with optional exclude areas;
- points the school does not use (turned off).

A rider whose home is inside the catchment may use the stop's points.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/stops?attention=1` | The school's stops (the "School Stops N" / "Needs Attention N" chips) |
| `PATCH /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Add to School / Use Stop (links it if needed) and change the catchment |
| `DELETE /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Unlink: the school's hand links and the riders assigned to the stop's points go too (one transaction). Answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }`. The prototype only warns when riders use the stop; there is no block |
| `POST /schools/:id/stops/import { from_school_id, with_catchments }` | Import from Another School: links its stops that this school can see, with or without their catchments. Returns `{ data: { added: n } }` (no other field) |

```json
{ "data": [ { "stop": { …stop row… }, "postal_codes": ["460100"], "off_point_ids": [],
              "areas": [ { "name": "Blk 2xx", "latlngs": [[1.333, 103.933], …], "exclude": false, "how": "lasso" } ], "riders": 9 } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "school_stops": 8, "needs_attention": 0 }, "stops_changed_at": "2026-11-02T09:00:00+08:00" } }
```

`riders` counts today's riders inside the catchment.

The `PATCH` body is `{ postal_codes: [...] | "460101, 460102", areas: [{ name, latlngs, exclude, how: lasso|corners|lot }],
off_point_ids: [...] }`. Send only the parts that change. The response is the row plus:

- `meta.invalid`: tokens that are not 6-digit codes. Show "Not added: …" and keep them in the input.
- `meta.shared`: `[{ postal, stop_code }]` for codes another of the school's stops also covers. Show "Riders here are
  eligible for both stops' PUDOs. Routing assigns one."

An area needs at least 3 corners. A stop with a catchment needs a pick-up and a drop-off point.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 3. A school's stops and catchments_

`school_stops#import`

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/stops?attention=1

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stops?school_id=&q=&status=&not_linked=1&page=&limit=` | The list. With `school_id`, the stops as that school sees them; without it, the whole company library |
| `GET /stops/:id?school_id=` | One stop with the schools that use it and the coverage table |
| `POST /stops` | Add a stop |
| `PATCH /stops/:id` | Change a stop |
| `DELETE /stops/:id` | Archive |
| `GET /stops/nearby?lat=&lng=&school_id=` | "Nearby in Library": stops within 600 m that the school does not use yet, nearest first, with `metres` |

List parameters:

- `q` matches the stop name, the Stop ID, a PUDO ID (such as `0001c`) or an old ID; not postal codes (the prototype's
  search box is "Search name, Stop ID, PUDO ID or old ID").
- Paged as every list ([README § Responses](../README.md#responses)): `meta { page, limit, count, pages }`;
  each row carries its `subzone { code, name, planning_area }` (so do `GET /schools/:id/stops` and the `PUT` answer); default 50, `limit` up to 500.
- `status` is `approved`, `school` or `pending`.
- `not_linked=1` (with `school_id`) gives the stops that school does not use yet ("Browse Library").

```json
{ "id": 12, "code": "BDSZ03-0001", "name": "Blk 101 Bedok North", "subzone_code": "BDSZ03",
  "subzone": { "code": "BDSZ03", "name": "Bedok North", "planning_area": "Bedok" },
  "library_status": "approved", "owner_school": null, "requested_by": null, "requested_at": null, "former_codes": [],
  "points": [ { "id": 31, "suffix": "A", "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "description": "Bus bay beside Blk 101", "usage": "both",
                "sizes": ["S", "M", "L"], "primary": true, "lat": 1.3304, "lng": 103.9203, "subzone_code": "BDSZ03",
                "street_view_url": "https://www.google.com/maps/@…", "photo": { "url": "…", "thumb_url": "…", … } | null,
                "photo_original": {…} | null, "photo_annotations": [...] | null, "photo_credit": "Mrs Tan (parent)" | null } ],
  "used_by": 2, "linked": true, "needs_attention": false, "coverage_warnings": [], "archived": false }
```

- `linked` is only set when `school_id` is given.
- `used_by` is the number of schools using the stop: "used by N schools".
- `needs_attention` is true when the stop has no point, or the coverage has a gap ("Size gap" badge).

`GET /stops/:id` adds two fields:

```json
"coverage": [ { "usage": "pickup", "sizes": { "S": ["A"], "M": ["A"], "L": [] }, "any": true },
              { "usage": "dropoff", "sizes": { … }, "any": true } ],
"schools": [ { "id": 3, "name": "St. Stephen's School", "riders": 12 } ]
```

In `coverage`, each cell lists the point letters that serve that size; an empty list is a gap. `coverage_warnings` holds
messages such as "No point serves Large buses for pick-up".

**Add / change a stop:**

```
POST /stops   { stop: { name, points: [{ description, usage: pickup|dropoff|both, sizes: ["S","M","L"], primary, lat, lng, street_view_url }] },
                school_id, in_library }
PATCH /stops/:id { stop: { name, points: [{ id, … }] }, school_id, confirmed }
```

- Send the whole list of points. A point with `id` is changed. A point without `id` is new and gets the next free
  letter. A point left out is removed (retired).
- Exactly one point is primary. If none is marked, the first point is.
- `street_view_url` must be a Google Maps link.
- On the Library page, send no `school_id` (or `in_library: true`). The stop is then `approved`.
- From a school's screen, send `school_id` and `in_library: false`. The stop belongs to that school
  (`library_status: "school"`) and is linked to it. Then ask "Add to the Stop Library?" (§2).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Enter a stop name" | No name |
| "Add at least one PUDO point" | No points |
| "Point A needs at least one bus size" | A point has no size |
| "Stops with postal codes or areas need both pick-up and drop-off points" | A school has a catchment on the stop |
| "No URA subzone found for Point A. Move it inside Singapore" | The new stop's primary point is outside every subzone |

**Changing a stop other schools use.** When points of a stop that other schools use are moved, added or removed, or
their use or sizes change, the API answers 422 with `code: "confirm_required"`:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "confirm_required", "message": "BDSZ03-0001 is used by other schools. Confirm to change it for them too",
             "details": { "schools": [ { "id": 5, "name": "Opera Estate Primary", "riders": 8 } ] } } }
```

Show the dialog with those schools and their riders, then send the same request again with `confirmed: true`. Every
school using the stop gets its "Stops changed since routing" time updated (`stops_changed_at`, §3).

**Archive:** `DELETE /stops/:id` works only when no school uses the stop ("Unlink BDSZ03-0001 from every school first"). It answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }`: riders still assigned to the stop's points (left by an older unlink) are unassigned in the same transaction.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 1. Stops (Stop Library)_

PUT /schools/:school_id/stops/:id { postal_codes: [] | "460101, …", areas: [{ name, latlngs, exclude, how }], off_point_ids: [] }

Each school has its own catchment on a stop:

- postal codes;
- drawn areas, with optional exclude areas;
- points the school does not use (turned off).

A rider whose home is inside the catchment may use the stop's points.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/stops?attention=1` | The school's stops (the "School Stops N" / "Needs Attention N" chips) |
| `PATCH /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Add to School / Use Stop (links it if needed) and change the catchment |
| `DELETE /schools/:id/stops/:stop_id` | Unlink: the school's hand links and the riders assigned to the stop's points go too (one transaction). Answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }`. The prototype only warns when riders use the stop; there is no block |
| `POST /schools/:id/stops/import { from_school_id, with_catchments }` | Import from Another School: links its stops that this school can see, with or without their catchments. Returns `{ data: { added: n } }` (no other field) |

```json
{ "data": [ { "stop": { …stop row… }, "postal_codes": ["460100"], "off_point_ids": [],
              "areas": [ { "name": "Blk 2xx", "latlngs": [[1.333, 103.933], …], "exclude": false, "how": "lasso" } ], "riders": 9 } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "school_stops": 8, "needs_attention": 0 }, "stops_changed_at": "2026-11-02T09:00:00+08:00" } }
```

`riders` counts today's riders inside the catchment.

The `PATCH` body is `{ postal_codes: [...] | "460101, 460102", areas: [{ name, latlngs, exclude, how: lasso|corners|lot }],
off_point_ids: [...] }`. Send only the parts that change. The response is the row plus:

- `meta.invalid`: tokens that are not 6-digit codes. Show "Not added: …" and keep them in the input.
- `meta.shared`: `[{ postal, stop_code }]` for codes another of the school's stops also covers. Show "Riders here are
  eligible for both stops' PUDOs. Routing assigns one."

An area needs at least 3 corners. A stop with a catchment needs a pick-up and a drop-off point.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 3. A school's stops and catchments_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/stop_assignment?date=

`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment?date=` returns the riders on that date (the Plan For date) and the PUDO points each one
may use:

```json
{ "data": [ { "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Wei Ling", "grade": "P3", "postal": "460100", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.92,
              "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2, 4], "starts_on": null, "status": "one", "cut_point_ids": [ 33 ],
              "assigned": { "point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "manual": false, "plan_id": 5, "notified_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00" },
              "candidates": [ { "stop_id": 12, "stop_code": "BDSZ03-0001", "point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "usage": "both",
                                "how": "postal" | "area" | "manual", "manual": false, "metres": 52 } ] } ],
  "meta": { "date": "2026-11-02", "counts": { "riders": 65, "with_pudo": 65, "conflicts": 0, "no_stop": 0, "assigned": 60, "notified": 58 },
            "stops_changed_at": "…" } }
```

**Candidates.** A rider's candidate points are worked out like this, as in the prototype:

1. Start with every point of the school's stops whose catchment has the rider's home: by postal code, or inside an area
   and not in an exclude area.
2. Leave out the points turned off for the school.
3. Add the points linked to the rider or their postal code by hand (`how: "manual"`).
4. Leave out the points cut off from the rider (`cut_point_ids`: the hidden points; linking the rider to one again with
   `POST /schools/:id/rider_links` brings it back).

`assigned` is the point the rider is assigned to (from an adopted Route Plan, or set by hand: `manual: true`), or `null`;
`notified_at` is when **Notify** recorded it (`null` = not yet). `meta.counts.assigned` / `notified` count those riders.
Set as assigned, Move All Riders Here and Notify: [school-bus-routes § 5](school-bus-routes.md#5-adopt-plan-and-rider-assignments). Out of Date: `out_of_date` on a plan ([routes § 3](school-bus-routes.md#3-plans)).

Rider colours on the map follow `status`:

| `status` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `one` | Assigned: one stop |
| `conflict` | Points of more than one stop |
| `none` | No stop |

**Tools:**

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links { stop_point_id, rids: [...], postals: [...] }` | Select Riders (S): link the picked riders or postal codes to a point as an alternative |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links/remove { links: [{ rid, point_id }] }` | Select Links (L) › Remove: a hand link is deleted; a link from the catchment is cut off for that rider. A rider assigned to a removed point is unassigned. Answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }` |

Reload the assignment after either call.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 4. Stop Assignment_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }

`POST /schools/:id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }` returns **202** with the
run. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id` until `status` is `done` or `failed` (it takes up to the effort time: 15–120 s).

```json
{ "id": 9, "school_id": 3, "session": "am", "plan_date": "2026-11-02", "status": "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed",
  "error": null, "riders": 65, "stops": 7, "no_stop": [ { "rid": "S-1044", "name": "Tan Wei Ling" } ], "conflicts": [], "ms": 41250, "plan_id": 21,
  "progress": { "step": "solving", "frac": 0.42, "run": 2, "runs": 4, "elapsed": 18400, "left": 31600,
                "work": { "phase": "Swap and relocate pass", "i": 3, "n": 9, "extra": "Best 12,345 pts", "evals": 184230 },
                "log": [ { "run": 1, "phase": "Sweep start angle", "i": 24, "n": 24 } ] }, … }
```

**Loader** (poll about every second): `progress` while `running` (`null` when the routing service cannot tell, e.g.
restarted; keep polling), `{ step: "done", frac: 1, work: { evals } }` when done, `null` otherwise.

- `step`: `queued`, `matrix` → "Step 1 of 2 | Loading road travel times" (bar 4 %), `solving` → "Step 2 of 2 | Searching for
  the best routes | Run `run` of `runs` | `elapsed`/1000 s" (bar 10 + 90 × `frac` %).
- Time left: from `frac` > 0.04, min(elapsed / frac × (1 − frac), `left`) → "About N s left", "Almost done" at 1 s or less,
  else "Estimating time left" (ms values).
- "Route options checked: `work.evals`"; the current phase "`work.phase` `work.i` of `work.n`" + `work.extra`; `log` = the
  last 4 phases ("Run k | phase", "i of n").

**What the engine is given:**

- The riders on the Plan For `date` who ride the session (AM, PM, or CCA days for ASA).
- Each rider whose PUDO points all belong to **one stop** (from Stop Assignment), grouped by that stop with the stop's
  points the school uses.
- Riders with no stop are listed in `no_stop`; riders with more than one stop are listed in `conflicts`, both as
  `[{ rid, name }]`. Neither goes into the run; the plan lists each of them in `unassigned` (reason `RIDER_NO_STOP` /
  `RIDER_IN_CONFLICT`, `label` = the rider's name). Show "N riders need a stop" / "N riders have more than one stop".
- The current plan of the session, for "Keep Current".
- The company's parameters, the run's `params`, the session, and the school's bus attendant rule.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `done`, plan with no routes | No rider of the session has a stop: the run still goes (as the prototype) and every rider is in `unassigned` |
| `failed` with the engine's message | The engine refused, for example no road times |
| `failed` with "The routing service is not available…" | The routing service could not be reached |
| `done` | `plan_id` is the new **draft** plan |

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-routes.md` § 2. Run Routing_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/route_charges?date= — runs of the school's adopted plans with their bus rate and charges;
only when the school is billed per bus that day (locked Bus Fares, payer bus), else per_bus false and empty lists.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /routes/:id/vehicle { vehicle_id, from }` | The regular bus from a date (empty `vehicle_id` = no bus). The history is in route `vehicles`. Short-term replacement buses: the drawer's Replacement Buses (below), or drag the run on the Scheduler (`POST /occurrences/:id/move`, `scope: range`, [scheduler § 3.2](scheduler.md#32-confirm-post-occurrencesidmove)) |
| `GET /routes/:id/replacements` | Replacement Buses: `[{ id, starts_on, ends_on, vehicle { id, plate, seats }, company, arranged_by: operator\|us, daily_rate, deduct_from_operator, reason, school_days, by, created_at }]`, latest first |
| `POST /routes/:id/replacements { from, to, vehicle_id \| plate + (operator_id \| company), arranged_by: operator\|us, daily_rate, deduct, reason }` | Add Replacement → `201` the list. When the bus is the route's own regular bus nothing is added: the dates are cut out of any replacement there, so those days go back to the regular bus and the list can come back empty (not an error; the prototype says "Back on its regular bus"). "Bus not in our list": `plate` with a Transport Operator (`operator_id`: the bus joins its fleet) or a company typed in (`company`: added as an External Vehicle, within the external vehicle limit); a plate the company already has is that bus. `422`: "Pick the start date", "End date is before the start date", "Enter the replacement bus plate", "Enter the company that owns the bus", "Enter the cost per day" (arranged by us) |
| `DELETE /route_replacements/:id` | Remove a replacement (`204`); the regular bus comes back on runs not started yet |
| `PATCH /routes/:id/pay_setup { attendant_required, attendant_provided_by: operator\|us, attendant_price, pay_to: own\|operator\|"", pay_to_operator_id }` | The price card's Bus Attendant Required / BA Provided By / BA Price and, for a route with no bus, Paid To (plans or finance; `attendant_price` needs finance: `422` "Needs the Fares & Billing permission"). Returns `pay_setup` |
| `DELETE /routes/:route_id/vehicle_changes/:id` | Bus History "Remove this change" (not the first one: `422` "The first bus of the route cannot be removed. Change it instead"); returns `{ vehicles, prices }`, the runs follow |
| `DELETE /routes/:route_id/prices/:id` | Remove a price from the history (`finance`); returns `{ vehicles, prices }` |
| `POST /routes/:id/prices { effective_from, mode: fixed\|rider, monthly \| base_price + riders_included + per_rider }` | The operator's monthly price from a date (`finance`). The history is in route `prices`. With no price, the school's default for the bus size applies (Operator Pay) |
| `GET /schools/:id/route_charges?date=` | Route Charges: each AM / PM run of the adopted plans, only when the school is billed per bus on `date` (below) |
| `POST /routes/:id/charges { starts_on, kind: amt\|pct, value, reason, note }` | A charge change from a date (the 1st of this month or later; it can be mid-month). `value: 0` ends the charge. `reason`: Long route, Peak timing, ERP cover, Extra stop or Other. Only on a route of an AM / PM plan in use (`422` "Route Charges are for runs of an AM or PM plan in use") and when the school is billed per bus on `starts_on` (`422` "The school is not billed per bus") |
| `PATCH /route_charges/:id { school_route_id, status: "ok" }` | Confirm a carried charge (`status: "ok"`), or move it to another run: `school_route_id` = the **route `id`** (`runs[].route_id`) of an AM / PM plan in use (`422` "Pick a run of an AM or PM plan in use"), of the same session as the charge's run (`422` "Pick a run of the AM plan"). Both can go in one call. `422` "The school is not billed per bus" when not billed per bus on the charge's date |
| `DELETE /route_charges/:id` | Remove a change that has not started, or drop a carried charge |

`GET /schools/:id/route_charges` returns:

```json
{ "per_bus": true,
  "runs": [ { "route_id": 51, "plan_id": 21, "session": "am", "label": "AM 1", "bus_type": "MEDIUM_23", "rate": "1500.0", "extra": "150.0", "total": "1650.0",
              "now": { "id": 4, "starts_on": "2026-11-02", "kind": "amt", "value": "150.0", "reason": "Long route", "status": "ok", … } | null,
              "next": {…} | null, "history": [...] } ],
  "unmatched": [ …charges with no run… ], "to_check": 1 }
```

**Billed per bus** (prototype `F.locked && payer === 'bus'`): the academic year covering the date has its Bus Fares
saved and locked with `payer: "bus"`. `per_bus` is `true` then, even before any bus rate is set (`rate: null`). Otherwise
the answer is `{ "per_bus": false, "runs": [], "unmatched": [], "to_check": 0 }`: hide the Route Charges card.

When a new plan is adopted, each old run's charge moves to the new run that shares the most riders (then stops) with it,
with `status: "check"`. A charge with no match is listed in `unmatched` ("Charges With No Matching Run").

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-routes.md` § 6. Route bus and money_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/routes?date= — the routes of the plans in use that day (AM, PM, CCA): the route picker of
School route notices.

Send Notice in the drawer opens it prefilled with the trip (or the school) and the run's timing.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Templates | `GET /notice_templates` → `[{ id, name, message }]` (`{min}`, `{time}` to fill in) |
| Send | `POST /notices` (body below) |
| Lists (Active, Scheduled, Ended) | `GET /notices?state=active|scheduled|ended&trip_id=` (page and search: [trips.md § Notices](trips.md#2-notices-page)) |
| Edit (scheduled only) | `PATCH /notices/:id` |
| End Now (active only) | `PATCH /notices/:id/end_now` |
| Duplicate | `POST /notices/:id/duplicate` (starts now, same length) |
| Delete (not active) | `DELETE /notices/:id` |

```json
{ "notice": { "audience": "trip", "trip_id": 8, "to_riders": true, "to_parents": false, "banner": true, "push": true, "sms": false,
              "notice_template_id": 1, "message": "The bus is running about 10 minutes late because of heavy traffic." },
  "start": "now", "period_minutes": 15, "run_keys": ["d1r0"] }
```

- Start: `start: "now"` (Immediate) or `start: "at"` with `notice[starts_at]`. End: `period_minutes` (5, 15, 20, 25, 30 or any) or `notice[ends_at]`.
- Trip notices: `run_keys`: `["all"]` or the timings (`d1r0`...). School route notices: `audience: "school"`, `school_id`, `route_ids: ["all"]` or route ids.
- **School route picker**: `GET /schools/:id/routes?date=<the notice's start day>` (default today) → the routes of the plans in
  use that day, AM then PM then CCA, by route number:
  `{ "data": [ { "id": 51, "label": "AM 1", "session": "am", "plan_id": 21, "riders_count": 18, "start_time": "06:35", "end_time": "07:20", "vehicle_plate": "PD6604E" } ] }`.
  Chips = `label`; "All Routes" = `route_ids: ["all"]`; the audience line "N riders on M routes" adds up `riders_count`.
  An empty list = "No routes in use for this school". Schools for the picker: `GET /schools`.
- `route_ids` must be routes of plans in use while the notice runs: else `422` "Pick routes in use at this school".
- Refused: WhatsApp (`notice[whatsapp]`) "WhatsApp is not available yet"; `{min}` / `{time}` left in the message; no audience; no channel; end before start; editing an active or ended notice.
- Push and SMS are recorded in `sent` (sending comes with the apps).

---

_Source: `convoy-os/scheduler.md` § 12. Notice form_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/cca_rides/not_running { date, reason: school | weather | bus | other | no_school, note }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/cca_rides?week_of=YYYY-MM-DD` | Settings and one week. Any day picks its Monday; the default is the next week with rides |
| `PATCH /schools/:school_id/cca_rides` | `{ enabled, price, days: [1..5], seats }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/cca_rides/not_running` | `{ date, reason: school \| weather \| bus \| other \| no_school, note }`. Every ride booked that day becomes credit for its family, once per day |

**Settings.**

- Errors when on: `Enter the price per ride`, `Pick the days the CCA bus runs`, `Enter the seats per day`.
- `fares_price` is set when this year's Bus Fares has the CCA / ASA bus per trip at a fixed price. That price is then
  used, and the front end locks the field.

**Each day of the week** has:

- `date`, `label`, `phase` (`past`, `today`, `late` or `open`) and `status`, for example "Open until Sat 7 Nov, 23:59",
  "Closed · late adds while seats last", "Bus Not Running" or "No School".
- Seats: `riders`, `taken`, `seats`, `full`.
- Calendar: `off` (`{ reason, by, at, credit }`), `no_school` (not a school day, with the holiday name) and `calendar`
  (a special day: check the bus time).
- Actions: `can_not_running` → Bus Not Running (`POST …/cca_rides/not_running` with the reason picked), and `can_no_school_credit` → "No School credit" (give credit for rides booked before the calendar changed): the same call with `{ date, reason: "no_school" }`.
- `rows[]`: child, class, family, `paid_on`, `method`, `bill_id`, `late`, `not_riding`.

**Week figures (`kpis`).** `rides`, `collected`, `late`, `not_riding`, `credit_given`.

**Booking rules (Convoy App).**

- Parents book next week by Saturday 23:59 and pay to confirm. After that, a ride can be added only while seats are left.
- Paid rides cannot be removed. Not Riding frees the seat; the ride is still charged.
- Credit is used first at the family's next payment.
- Each payment is a School Bus bill (`kind: cca`), with lines per child and a credit line.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 7. CCA Rides_

| `PATCH /schools/:school_id/cca_rides` | `{ enabled, price, days: [1..5], seats }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/cca_rides/not_running` | `{ date, reason: school \| weather \| bus \| other \| no_school, note }`. Every ride booked that day becomes credit for its family, once per day |

**Settings.**

- Errors when on: `Enter the price per ride`, `Pick the days the CCA bus runs`, `Enter the seats per day`.
- `fares_price` is set when this year's Bus Fares has the CCA / ASA bus per trip at a fixed price. That price is then
  used, and the front end locks the field.

**Each day of the week** has:

- `date`, `label`, `phase` (`past`, `today`, `late` or `open`) and `status`, for example "Open until Sat 7 Nov, 23:59",
  "Closed · late adds while seats last", "Bus Not Running" or "No School".
- Seats: `riders`, `taken`, `seats`, `full`.
- Calendar: `off` (`{ reason, by, at, credit }`), `no_school` (not a school day, with the holiday name) and `calendar`
  (a special day: check the bus time).
- Actions: `can_not_running` → Bus Not Running (`POST …/cca_rides/not_running` with the reason picked), and `can_no_school_credit` → "No School credit" (give credit for rides booked before the calendar changed): the same call with `{ date, reason: "no_school" }`.
- `rows[]`: child, class, family, `paid_on`, `method`, `bill_id`, `late`, `not_riding`.

**Week figures (`kpis`).** `rides`, `collected`, `late`, `not_riding`, `credit_given`.

**Booking rules (Convoy App).**

- Parents book next week by Saturday 23:59 and pay to confirm. After that, a ride can be added only while seats are left.
- Paid rides cannot be removed. Not Riding frees the seat; the ride is still charged.
- Credit is used first at the family's next payment.
- Each payment is a School Bus bill (`kind: cca`), with lines per child and a credit line.

- Who and what: `id`, `number`, `kind` (`first`, `cca` or `period`), `payer`, `family_id`, `bill_to`, `bill_to_code`,
  `bill_to_email`, `children`, `lines_count`, `period`, `academic_year_id`, `period_index`.

- `counts` per status, plus `all`.
- `methods`: PayNow, Bank Transfer, GIRO, Cheque, Cash, Card.
- `kpis` for the bills in the chosen period:
  - `billed` (total plus debit notes) and `bills`.
  - `collected`.
  - `outstanding` and `not_paid`.
  - `overdue` and `overdue_bills`.
  - `credited`: credit notes taken off bills, plus waivers, plus late fees waived.

**Late fees.** Late fees are worked out live, from the Payment & Refund Policy in use today. Once a bill is past its due
date plus the grace days and money is still owed, the fee is one of:

- a flat amount, or
- a percentage of what is owed for every 30 days (at least one).

The fee is capped when the policy has a cap. It is never a document.

**Billing differences.** For every issued period bill, the call compares what it would come to now (today's riders and
fares) with what it billed, adjusted for the debit and credit notes since. A credit note counts here even when it was
refunded or carried to the next bill. Each row has:

- `bill_id`, `number`, `bill_to`, `period`.
- `was`, `now`, and `gap` (positive means more is due now).
- `suggest: { doc_type, description, amount, reason, credit_use }`, ready for the note form.

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/bill_runs?academic_year_id=&period_index=&q= — the Family Bills card.

Convoy drafts **one bill per payer per billing period**:

- **Parents pay:** one bill per family.
- **The school pays per rider or per bus:** one bill to the school.

Billing periods come from the year's locked Bus Fares: one per term or semester, or one per chosen month.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bill_runs?academic_year_id=&period_index=&q=` | The Family Bills card. See below |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs` | Draft Now / Draft Again: `{ academic_year_id, period_index }`. Bills already issued stay as they are; every other payer gets a fresh draft. `meta.drafted` = drafts now |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs/issue` | Issue: `{ academic_year_id, period_index, bill_ids: [] }`. Leave out `bill_ids` to issue every draft. `meta.issued` = count |
| `PATCH /school_bills/settings` | `{ draft_days, start_rule: prorate \| full \| half }`. These are company-wide and apply to the next drafts |

When `academic_year_id` is left out, the call uses the year covering today that has locked Bus Fares, or else the
latest year with locked Bus Fares. When `period_index` is left out, it uses the first period billed from next month, or
else from this month, or else the last period.

**The card (`data`):**

- `on`: false (with `error`) until the year's Bus Fares are locked.
- `payer`: `family`, `school` or `bus`.
- `periods`: `[{ index, label, month }]`. The label is `"Semester 1 | billed Jan 2027"`, or `"Jan 2027"` for monthly bills.
- `due_on`: the due date of the period's bills.
- `draft_on`: the day Convoy drafts them, `due_on` less `draft_days`.
- `bill_to`: for school bills, `{ managed_client: { id, name } | null, linked }`. A school bill can only be issued when the
  school is linked to a Managed Client. It then carries that client's name and its first Send Invoices To email.
- `run`: the last draft, or `null` before the first one:
  - `drafted_at`, and `by` (`"Convoy"` when the daily job drafted it, with `auto: true`).
  - `label` and `due_on`.
  - `skipped`: the notes on children left out, such as `"Lim Kai: this month is on the first invoice INV-…"` or
    `"…: service stopped 01/10/2026"`.
  - `unlinked`: riders with no family, so not billed. Ask the user to link them in Families & Riders.
- `counts`: `{ bills, drafts, issued, amount }`.
- `can_issue`, and `settings`: `{ draft_days, start_rule }`.
- `rows`: up to 150, drafts first. Each row has:
  - `id`, `status` (`draft` or `issued`), `number`, `bill_to`, `bill_to_code`, `children`.
  - `amount`: before GST for a draft, the total for an issued bill.
  - `part_charges`: how many lines are part charges.
  - `lines: [{ rid, child_name, description, note, amount }]`.
- `more`: the count of rows not shown.

**How a bill is worked out.**

- **The children billed.** Children on the AM / PM route plans in use when the period starts, plus children who join
  before it ends.
- **Each child's fare.**
  - The tier comes from the straight-line distance from the school: add 0.05 km, then round up to 0.1 km. For zones, the
    tier is the first zone whose postal sectors or drawn area hold the home.
  - 2-way, 1-way, or AM / PM fares follow the sessions the child rides.
  - A small bus or a bus-size column applies for the days the child's bus was that size.
  - The bill month's Extra Charges are added.
- **A child who joins mid-period** is charged by the start rule: prorated by school days, the full period, or half from
  the 16th. The line `note` says how, for example `"Joins 01/03/2027, 58 of 98 school days"`.
- **A child who stops** (a Stop Service request, or the rider's end date) pays up to that day. When the policy's refund
  basis is days, this is prorated by school days.
- **A month on a request's first invoice** is skipped.
- **When the school pays per bus,** the bill has one line per bus size (`"3 x LARGE_45 at S$4200.00"`). A further
  `"Route charges and changes during the period"` line covers Route Charges and plan changes within the month.

**Issuing.** Issuing gives the bill its INV number and GST. It also takes off the payer's credit notes that were waiting
for the next bill, each as a line `"Credit from CN-…"` with `credit_note: true`. Parents see their bills in the Convoy
App, and the school sees its bill in the Client Portal (when those apps come).

**Automatic drafting.** A daily job at 01:00 drafts the coming period of every school year with locked Bus Fares, once
`draft_on` has come. It does not draft a period twice.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 1. Family Bills: draft and issue_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/documents?type=inv|cn|dn|rcp&payer=family:<id>|school&q=

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/documents?type=&payer=&q=` | Invoices, credit notes, debit notes, receipts and payment vouchers, newest first (latest 300) |
| `GET /school_documents/:id` | A credit note, debit note or receipt to print |
| `POST /school_documents/:id/void` | `{ reason }`. Only a receipt can be made void. Its payments are voided too, so the bills it paid are owed again |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/statement?payer=` | Statement of Account |

**The list.**

- `type` is `inv`, `cn`, `dn`, `rcp` or `pv`.
- `payer` is `family:<id>`, `school` or `operator:<id>`. A receipt also shows under every payer whose bill it paid.
- Each row has:
  - `type`, `id`, `number`, `date`, `school_id`, `school`, `to`, `amount`.
  - `status`: the bill status; `Applied`, `Refunded` or `To Next Bill` for a credit note; `Issued`; `Received`;
    `Paid`; or `Void`.
  - `tone`.
  - `links`: for example `"Pays INV-…"`, `"For INV-…"`, or `"Paid S$…, RCP-…, CN-…"`.
  - `can_void`.

- A credit note, debit note or receipt opens with `GET /school_documents/:id`.

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/lines { kind, adj_on, route, amount, reason, paired_operator_id, files: [] }

There is one pay run per operator per school month. Route pay is worked out live until Ops sends the pay run to Finance.
From then on, the route pay, the routes and the replacement lines are kept.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/payouts?month=YYYY-MM` | The month (default: this month) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/lines` | Add a line (multipart for files): `{ month, kind, adj_on, route, amount, reason, paired_operator_id, files: [] }` |
| `DELETE /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/lines/:line_id?month=` | Remove a line. Lines added automatically, and lines on a pay run sent to Finance, cannot be removed |
| `PATCH /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id` | `{ month, invoice_number }`: the operator's invoice number |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/send` | Send to Finance. The prototype labels this button "Approve and Send to Finance" (month ended) or "Approve Early and Send to Finance" (month not ended): it is this call, shown when `can.send`; it does not approve |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/recall` | Recall, back to draft |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/send_back` | Send Back to Ops (an approver) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/approve` | Approve (an approver; the maker-checker rule applies) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/reopen` | Reopen an approved run that has no payment and is not in a batch |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id/payments` | Pay: `{ month, paid_on, amount, method, reference }`. Up to what is left. The first payment numbers the Payment Voucher |
| `GET /school_payouts/:id/voucher` | The Payment Voucher to print |

Every action returns the whole month again, like `GET`.

**The month (`data`).**

- `month`, `month_label`, `future`, and `month_text`, which is shown when the month has not ended.
- `rights: { prepare, approve, set_up, maker }` and `rights_text`.
- `kpis: { net_payable, paid, still_to_pay, operators_to_pay }`.
- `kinds: [{ kind, sign }]`, `methods`, and `routes` (labels for the line form).
- `rows`, one per operator. Each row has:
  - Who: `key` (the operator id, `own` or `none`), `operator`, `name`, `payable`, `id`, `routes_count`.
  - Money: `base` (route pay), `additions`, `deductions`, `net`, `paid`, `balance`.
  - Status:
    - `status`: `No Operator` (routes with no bus), `Our Buses` (the company's own buses, nothing to pay), `Paid`,
      `Part Paid`, `Approved`, `With Finance`, `To Check` (the month has ended) or `Open`.
    - `tone`.
  - Documents: `invoice_number`, `voucher: { number, on }`, and `batch: { number, pay_date, notice_number }` when the
    pay run is in an Operator Payments batch.
  - `routes`: `[{ route, session, plan, bus_type, plate, price, unpriced, days, of, break_month, earned, rate, from, to, amount, note, attendant }]`.
    `attendant { amount, by: operator | us }` (or `null`): the monthly bus attendant price inside `price` → "Incl. S$`amount` BA
    (theirs)" when `by` is `operator`, "(ours)" when `us`. Which sizes need one follows Bus Attendants (statutory / all / selected sizes).
    For example, `days` 11 `of` 21 with the `note` `"Took over from Beta Coaches on 16/11/2026"`.
  - `lines`: `[{ id, kind, sign, adj_on, route, amount, reason, auto, paired_with, by, can_remove, files: [{ id, name, url, size, content_type }] }]`.
  - `history`: newest first: sent, sent back, approved, paid.
  - `can: { edit, send, recall, send_back, approve, reopen, pay, need_other }`.
  - `note`: shown for `own` and `none`.

**Route pay.** Each school day a route runs earns that day's price, spread over the month's school days:

- **The price** is the route's own price history, or else the school's default for the bus size (Operator Pay). It is
  either fixed monthly, or a base for some riders plus a rate for each rider above them. The bus attendant is added
  when the policy needs one.
- **Calendar days** are used instead of school days in a break month, or when part months go by calendar days.
- **The Operator Pay scheme** sets the share of the month that is paid, and the retainer earned applies in a break
  month.
- **A route split between operators.** When the route's regular bus moves to another operator mid-month, each operator
  gets their own days.

**Lines.**

- **Kinds that deduct:** Taxi claim, Replacement bus we arranged, Penalty / late arrival, Damage, Other deduction.
- **Kinds that add:** Covered another route, Extra trips, ERP / parking claim, Other addition.
- **Covered another route.** With `paired_operator_id`, the call also deducts the same amount from that operator, as
  "Route covered by …". The other pay run must still be open.
- **Replacement buses.** A replacement bus we arranged at a daily rate is added automatically (`auto: true`). It is
  deducted from the regular operator and added to the replacement's operator.

**Paying.** There are two ways to pay, as in Convoy OS:

- **Here.** Record the payment on the pay run, which gives it a Payment Voucher.
- **In a batch.** An approved pay run appears in Finance › Operator Payments › Payment Requests. Once it is in a batch,
  it is paid there with a Payment Notice, and this page shows `batch` with its paid share.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 5. Operator Payments (pay runs)_

**The month (`data`).**

- `month`, `month_label`, `future`, and `month_text`, which is shown when the month has not ended.
- `rights: { prepare, approve, set_up, maker }` and `rights_text`.
- `kpis: { net_payable, paid, still_to_pay, operators_to_pay }`.
- `kinds: [{ kind, sign }]`, `methods`, and `routes` (labels for the line form).
- `rows`, one per operator. Each row has:
  - Who: `key` (the operator id, `own` or `none`), `operator`, `name`, `payable`, `id`, `routes_count`.
  - Money: `base` (route pay), `additions`, `deductions`, `net`, `paid`, `balance`.
  - Status:
    - `status`: `No Operator` (routes with no bus), `Our Buses` (the company's own buses, nothing to pay), `Paid`,
      `Part Paid`, `Approved`, `With Finance`, `To Check` (the month has ended) or `Open`.
    - `tone`.
  - Documents: `invoice_number`, `voucher: { number, on }`, and `batch: { number, pay_date, notice_number }` when the
    pay run is in an Operator Payments batch.
  - `routes`: `[{ route, session, plan, bus_type, plate, price, unpriced, days, of, break_month, earned, rate, from, to, amount, note, attendant }]`.

    (theirs)" when `by` is `operator`, "(ours)" when `us`. Which sizes need one follows Bus Attendants (statutory / all / selected sizes).
    For example, `days` 11 `of` 21 with the `note` `"Took over from Beta Coaches on 16/11/2026"`.

  - `history`: newest first: sent, sent back, approved, paid.
  - `can: { edit, send, recall, send_back, approve, reopen, pay, need_other }`.
  - `note`: shown for `own` and `none`.

  month.

  gets their own days.

- **Kinds that deduct:** Taxi claim, Replacement bus we arranged, Penalty / late arrival, Damage, Other deduction.

  "Route covered by …". The other pay run must still be open.
- **Replacement buses.** A replacement bus we arranged at a daily rate is added automatically (`auto: true`). It is
  deducted from the regular operator and added to the replacement's operator.

- **Here.** Record the payment on the pay run, which gives it a Payment Voucher.

    `attendant { amount, by: operator | us }` (or `null`): the monthly bus attendant price inside `price` → "Incl. S$`amount` BA
    (theirs)" when `by` is `operator`, "(ours)" when `us`. Which sizes need one follows Bus Attendants (statutory / all / selected sizes).
    For example, `days` 11 `of` 21 with the `note` `"Took over from Beta Coaches on 16/11/2026"`.
  - `lines`: `[{ id, kind, sign, adj_on, route, amount, reason, auto, paired_with, by, can_remove, files: [{ id, name, url, size, content_type }] }]`.
  - `history`: newest first: sent, sent back, approved, paid.
  - `can: { edit, send, recall, send_back, approve, reopen, pay, need_other }`.
  - `note`: shown for `own` and `none`.

**Route pay.** Each school day a route runs earns that day's price, spread over the month's school days:

- **The price** is the route's own price history, or else the school's default for the bus size (Operator Pay). It is
  either fixed monthly, or a base for some riders plus a rate for each rider above them. The bus attendant is added
  when the policy needs one.
- **Calendar days** are used instead of school days in a break month, or when part months go by calendar days.
- **The Operator Pay scheme** sets the share of the month that is paid, and the retainer earned applies in a break
  month.
- **A route split between operators.** When the route's regular bus moves to another operator mid-month, each operator
  gets their own days.

**Lines.**

- **Kinds that deduct:** Taxi claim, Replacement bus we arranged, Penalty / late arrival, Damage, Other deduction.
- **Kinds that add:** Covered another route, Extra trips, ERP / parking claim, Other addition.
- **Covered another route.** With `paired_operator_id`, the call also deducts the same amount from that operator, as
  "Route covered by …". The other pay run must still be open.
- **Replacement buses.** A replacement bus we arranged at a daily rate is added automatically (`auto: true`). It is
  deducted from the regular operator and added to the replacement's operator.

**Paying.** There are two ways to pay, as in Convoy OS:

- **Here.** Record the payment on the pay run, which gives it a Payment Voucher.
- **In a batch.** An approved pay run appears in Finance › Operator Payments › Payment Requests. Once it is in a batch,
  it is paid there with a Payment Notice, and this page shows `batch` with its paid share.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 5. Operator Payments (pay runs)_

PATCH /schools/:school_id/payouts/:operator_id { month, invoice_number }

There is one pay run per operator per school month. Route pay is worked out live until Ops sends the pay run to Finance.
From then on, the route pay, the routes and the replacement lines are kept.

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/statement?payer=family:<id>|school

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/documents?type=&payer=&q=` | Invoices, credit notes, debit notes, receipts and payment vouchers, newest first (latest 300) |
| `GET /school_documents/:id` | A credit note, debit note or receipt to print |
| `POST /school_documents/:id/void` | `{ reason }`. Only a receipt can be made void. Its payments are voided too, so the bills it paid are owed again |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/statement?payer=` | Statement of Account |

**The list.**

- `type` is `inv`, `cn`, `dn`, `rcp` or `pv`.
- `payer` is `family:<id>`, `school` or `operator:<id>`. A receipt also shows under every payer whose bill it paid.
- Each row has:
  - `type`, `id`, `number`, `date`, `school_id`, `school`, `to`, `amount`.
  - `status`: the bill status; `Applied`, `Refunded` or `To Next Bill` for a credit note; `Issued`; `Received`;
    `Paid`; or `Void`.
  - `tone`.
  - `links`: for example `"Pays INV-…"`, `"For INV-…"`, or `"Paid S$…, RCP-…, CN-…"`.
  - `can_void`.
- `meta` has `counts` (per type, plus `all`), `payers: [{ key, name }]`, `types`, `count` and `shown`.

To open each type:

- An invoice opens with `GET /school_bills/:id`.
- A credit note, debit note or receipt opens with `GET /school_documents/:id`.
- A payment voucher opens with `GET /school_payouts/:id/voucher`.

**A credit note, debit note or receipt (`data`).** Every type has:

- `type`, `title` (`Credit Note`, `Debit Note` or `Official Receipt`), `number`, `date`, `to`, `to_code`, `status`,
  `total`, `reason`, `by`.
- `void`: `{ at, reason, by }`, or null.

A receipt also has `method`, `reference`, `can_void` and `applied: [{ bill_id, number, amount }]`.

A credit or debit note also has:

- `bill`.
- `lines: [{ description, amount }]` and `subtotal`.
- `gst`.
- `credit_use` and `use_text`, for example `"Taken off INV-…"` or `"Will be taken off the next bill"`.
- `refund`.

**Statement (`data`).** It covers every bill issued, debit note, credit taken off a bill, payment, and the late fee to
date, oldest first:

- `payer`, `name`, `as_of`, `balance`.
- `lines: [{ date, details, charge, credit, balance }]`.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 4. Documents and statements_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/live?date=&session=am|pm|asa&filter=all|road|late|done

`GET /schools/:school_id/live?date=&session=&filter=`

| Param | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `date` | `YYYY-MM-DD`. Default today |
| `session` | `am` (Morning Pick-up), `pm` (Afternoon Drop-off) or `asa` (CCA Drop-off). Default: the session running now, else the next one to start, else the last of the day |
| `filter` | `all` (default), `road` (on the road), `late` (on the road and late, or GPS lost), `done` (arrived). Only `rows` is filtered |

Poll every 15 to 30 seconds while the page is open.

**`data`:**

- `school`: `{ id, name, lat, lng }`. This is the school pin on the map.
- `date`, `now`.
- `sessions`: `[{ value, label, starts_at, ends_at, runs }]`. These are the sessions with runs that day, for the session
  picker. When the chosen session has not started (`kpis.buses.not_started == kpis.buses.total` and `now < starts_at`),
  show "Morning Pick-up has not started. Buses for this session show here once the first trip starts at …".
- `session`: the session shown.
- `kpis`:
  - `points`, `points_done`: the stops of every run, with the school counted as one point per run. Progress = done / points.
  - `buses`: `{ on_road, arrived, not_started, total }`.
  - `riders`: a count for each child status below, plus `absent` (= `not_required` + `no_show`) and `total`.
  - `completion`: `{ at, planned_at, late_minutes }`. This is when the last run ends (its school ETA in the morning,
    its last drop-off in the afternoon), against plan.
  - `attention`: `{ runs, issues }`.
- `attention`: what needs attention, most severe first. Each item is `{ occurrence_id, route, severity, kind, title, … }`:

  | `kind` | Severity | Extra fields |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `gps_lost` | 4 | `last_ping`, `near` (the last stop reached) |
  | `late` | 4 when 10 min or more, else 3 | `late_minutes`, `school_eta`, `planned_at` |
  | `no_show` | 2 | `rider: { rid, name }`, `stop`, `marked_by` |

  A run is late from 4 minutes. GPS is lost when a run on the road has had no position for 3 minutes (as in Ops Control).
- `filters`: the count for each filter.
- `rows`: one per run:
  - `occurrence_id`, `route_id`, `label`, `plate`, `driver: { name, phone }`.
  - `status`: `{ key, label, tone }`. The keys are `not_started`, `on_time`, `late`, `gps_lost` and `arrived`. When the
    key is `arrived`, `status.at` is the time it arrived. In the afternoon the label is "Completed".
  - `late_minutes`, `points`, `points_done`, `counts` (children by status, and `total`).
  - `next_stop`: `{ name, at_stop, expected_at }`. This is null once the run is done. When `at_stop` is true, show
    "Boarding now"; otherwise show "ETA" with `expected_at`.
  - `end_at`, `end_planned_at`: the school ETA (morning) or the last drop-off (afternoon), and its plan.
  - `starts_at`.
  - `line`: `[[lat, lng], …]`, the stops in order with the school last (morning) or first (afternoon).
  - `position`: `{ lat, lng, speed_kmh, heading, recorded_at }` while the run is on the road, else null.

**Child status** (`counts`, and each child in § 2):

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| `waiting` | Nothing recorded yet |
| `on_board` | Boarded |
| `at_school` | Alighted at the school (morning) |
| `dropped_off` | Alighted at their stop (afternoon) |
| `not_required` | Bus Not Required from the parent for that trip (`marked_by: "Parent"`), or marked "not boarding today" in the app |
| `no_show` | Marked "not boarded": the child was not at the stop |

**Lateness.** A run's lateness is the worst of two things: how late it arrived at the last stop it reached, and its ETA
at the next stop against plan. The ETA is a straight line from the bus's last position at 30 km/h, as on Live Map. A run
that is done shows how late it arrived at the school. The ETAs that follow add the lateness to their planned times.

The map's traffic layer, weather card and road incidents are not built (see § 5).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-live.md` § 1. Live Ops: the session_
