get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/live/runs/:id

`GET /schools/:school_id/live/runs/:id` (`id` = `occurrence_id`)

- `occurrence_id`, `route_id`, `label`, `session`, `date`.
- `bus`: `{ plate, type, seats, operator }`. `type` is the label of the bus size (for example `"40-seater"`); `operator`
  is `"Own fleet"` for our buses.
- `status`, `alert`, `late_minutes`, `points`, `points_done`, `counts`, `on_board`, `stops_count`, `next_stop`
  (`{ index, name, at_stop, expected_at }`).
- `alert`: null, or `{ kind: gps_lost, tone, title, last_ping }`, or `{ kind: late, tone, title, school_eta, planned_at }`.
  Show it as the banner.
- `end`: `{ planned_at, at, done }`. This is the last row of the timeline (the school, or the last drop-off).
- `methods`: how the children who boarded did it: `{ tick, qr, card, palm }`. `tick` = marked by hand ("Manual").
- `crew`: `[{ role: "Driver" | "Bus Attendant", name, phone }]`. "Call" opens `tel:`.
- `log`: `[{ at, kind, text }]`, newest first, with only what has happened so far. The kinds are `started`, `arrived`,
  `boarded` / `dropped_off` (per stop), `no_show`, `manual` (a child marked present by hand), `alert_<kind>` /
  `cleared_<kind>` (Ops Control alerts on the run) and `at_school`.
- `school`: `{ name, lat, lng }`, and `position` (as in § 1).
- `stops`: one per stop:
  - `index`, `number`, `name`, `lat`, `lng`, `planned_at`.
  - `state`: `done`, `at` (at the stop now) or `todo`.
  - `arrived_at`, `departed_at`, `late_minutes` (once left).
  - `expected_at`: for a stop not reached yet.
  - `riders`: one per child:
    - `rid`, `name`, `level`, `status`.
    - `marked_by`: the attendant or driver, or "Parent".
    - `reason`: for Bus Not Required, for example "Unwell. Fever".
    - `boarded_at`, `board_method`.
    - `board`: `{ lat, lng, distance_m }`, where the pass was read and how far that was from the stop. Flag
      `distance_m > 50` as "check location".
    - `alighted_at`, `alight_method`.

The status filter and the search by name or `rid` on this view are done by the front end.

The bus's GPS track for the map comes from Live Map: `GET /live_map/runs/:id/track?since=` ([live-map.md](live-map.md)).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-live.md` § 2. Live Ops: one run_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/dashboard?bin=tier|1|2

`GET /schools/:school_id/dashboard?bin=tier|1|2`

`data`: `{ school, finance_allowed, operations }`.

**`operations`:**

- `date`, `academic_year` (key or null).
- `day`: `{ kind, title, detail, runs }`. The kinds are `school_day`, `special_day` (runs; for example "Early Dismissal
  at 11:30 | Prize Giving Day"), `no_service` (not an operating day), `public_holiday`, `school_holiday`,
  `between_terms` and `no_year`.
- `sessions`: today's Bus Sessions, on a day the buses run. Each is:
  - `name`, `direction`, `cca`.
  - `different_today`: today has its own times; show "Different timing today".
  - `arrive_from`, `arrive_to` (to school) or `depart` (to home).
  - `routes`, `buses`, `riders`, `seats`, `seats_used_pct`, `without_bus`.

  The routes come from the plans running today: AM for to-school sessions, PM for to-home sessions, CCA for CCA sessions.
- `sessions_note`: on a day the buses run with no sessions: "Bus Sessions are not set up for this year", or "No sessions
  run on Tue".
- `today`: `{ routes_running, buses_assigned, routes, on_time_pct }`. `on_time_pct` is null for now (shown as N/A,
  "Shown once trips are tracked").
- `attention`: `[{ kind, title, detail, step? }]`:
  - `setup`: Year Setup steps not done, except the money steps, which are on Finance. `step` = the first step's key.
  - `no_bus`: trips without a bus. Opens Route Plans.
  - `stop_requests`: stops waiting for review. Opens the Stop Library.
- `upcoming`: up to 6 items in the next 3 months, each `{ date, kind, title, … }`. The kinds are `holiday` (with
  `ends_on`), `special_day` (with `time`, `detail`), `public_holiday` (on operating days), `term_start` and `term_end`.
- `ahead`: up to 8 items in the next 90 days, each `{ date, kind, title, … }`:
  - `plan_adopted`: with `routes`, and `replaces: { name, routes }`.
  - `plan_ends`.
  - `riders_start`: "Check they have a stop and a route".
  - `riders_leave`.
- `students` (the riders on the list today):
  - `total`, `on_route: { count, pct }`, `not_on_route` (when it is not 0, show "Check Stop Assignment").
  - `am_and_pm`, `am_only`, `pm_only`, `cca`: each `{ count, pct }`.
  - `distance`:
    - `bin`, and `bins` (the choices: `tier` when the fares go by distance tiers, `1`, `2`).
    - `histogram`: `[{ from, to, count, pct, cum, cum_pct }]`. `to: null` = "Over … km".
    - `average`, `median`, `furthest` (km), `located` (riders with a map location), `riders`.
    - Caption: "Straight-line, home to school, plus a 0.05 km buffer, rounded up to 0.1 km. Bills use the same distance."
  - `levels`: `[{ label, count }]` in the school's level order, with "Not given" last.

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/dashboard/finance?month=YYYY-MM

`GET /schools/:school_id/dashboard/finance?month=YYYY-MM` (default this month). `data`:

- `month`, `state`:
  - `closed`: a past month.
  - `in_progress`: "Actual to today, forecast for the rest of the month".
  - `forecast`: "From the plans, riders and charges dated for this month".
- `reference_day`: the day riders and seats are counted on. It is today for this month, else the month's first school day.
- `kpis`:
  - `revenue`: null with `revenue_note` when it cannot be worked out, for example "Bus Fares for AY 2026 not saved yet".
    Otherwise it is the fares expected in the month. Each billing period's fares are worked out as Family Bills would
    draft them, for every rider on the routes (whether linked to a family or not). Each period's share is its school
    days in the month; a monthly bill counts in full in its month. When the school pays per bus, the bus rates are used.
    `revenue_basis` is `rider` or `bus`; `revenue_riders` and `academic_year` go in the caption.
  - `operator_cost`: the route pay of the month, as on School Finance › Operator Payments.
  - `profit`, `margin_pct`.
  - `cost_per_rider`, `riders`.
  - `seats`: `{ riders, seats, routes, pct }`, the riders and seats of the routes running on `reference_day`.
- `collections`: `{ expected, billable, billed, bills, collected, overdue: { bills, owed } }`:
  - `billable`: the bills of the billing periods that start in the month, in full (`null` when `expected` is) → with no bill
    issued yet: "Expected bills: S$`billable`. Not raised yet".
  - `billed`: the bills issued for the month.
  - `collected`: payments received in the month.
  - `overdue`: the bills overdue today, past their due date with something owed.
- `route_costs`: Finance › Route Costs and By Transport Operator for the month:
  `{ total, school_days, priced, routes, rows: [{ route, session, plan, bus_type, plate, operator, price, unpriced, days, of, amount, note, attendant }],
  by_operator: [{ key, operator_id, name, routes, amount }] }` (the same figures as School Finance › Operator Payments; `operator`
  "Our buses" / "Not assigned" for own buses / no bus; `attendant { amount, by }` as there).

  - `route_charge`: `route`, `charge_kind`, `value`, `note`. When `value` is 0, the charge ends.
  - `extra_charge`: `charge_kind`, `value`.
  - `policy`: a Payment & Refund Policy version starts.
- `attention`:
  - `bus_rates`: bus sizes with no school rate.
  - `booked_runs`: more runs than booked.
  - `route_charges`: route charges to check (opens Bus Fares).
  - `setup`: the money steps not done, which are Bus Fares, Payment & Refund Policy and Operator Pay.
  - `unpriced`: routes not priced (opens Operator Pay).

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs/issue { academic_year_id, period_index, bill_ids: [] (none = every draft) }

Convoy drafts **one bill per payer per billing period**:

- **Parents pay:** one bill per family.
- **The school pays per rider or per bus:** one bill to the school.

Billing periods come from the year's locked Bus Fares: one per term or semester, or one per chosen month.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bill_runs?academic_year_id=&period_index=&q=` | The Family Bills card. See below |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs` | Draft Now / Draft Again: `{ academic_year_id, period_index }`. Bills already issued stay as they are; every other payer gets a fresh draft. `meta.drafted` = drafts now |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs/issue` | Issue: `{ academic_year_id, period_index, bill_ids: [] }`. Leave out `bill_ids` to issue every draft. `meta.issued` = count |
| `PATCH /school_bills/settings` | `{ draft_days, start_rule: prorate \| full \| half }`. These are company-wide and apply to the next drafts |

When `academic_year_id` is left out, the call uses the year covering today that has locked Bus Fares, or else the
latest year with locked Bus Fares. When `period_index` is left out, it uses the first period billed from next month, or
else from this month, or else the last period.

**The card (`data`):**

- `on`: false (with `error`) until the year's Bus Fares are locked.
- `payer`: `family`, `school` or `bus`.
- `periods`: `[{ index, label, month }]`. The label is `"Semester 1 | billed Jan 2027"`, or `"Jan 2027"` for monthly bills.
- `due_on`: the due date of the period's bills.
- `draft_on`: the day Convoy drafts them, `due_on` less `draft_days`.
- `bill_to`: for school bills, `{ managed_client: { id, name } | null, linked }`. A school bill can only be issued when the
  school is linked to a Managed Client. It then carries that client's name and its first Send Invoices To email.
- `run`: the last draft, or `null` before the first one:
  - `drafted_at`, and `by` (`"Convoy"` when the daily job drafted it, with `auto: true`).
  - `label` and `due_on`.
  - `skipped`: the notes on children left out, such as `"Lim Kai: this month is on the first invoice INV-…"` or
    `"…: service stopped 01/10/2026"`.
  - `unlinked`: riders with no family, so not billed. Ask the user to link them in Families & Riders.
- `counts`: `{ bills, drafts, issued, amount }`.
- `can_issue`, and `settings`: `{ draft_days, start_rule }`.
- `rows`: up to 150, drafts first. Each row has:
  - `id`, `status` (`draft` or `issued`), `number`, `bill_to`, `bill_to_code`, `children`.
  - `amount`: before GST for a draft, the total for an issued bill.
  - `part_charges`: how many lines are part charges.
  - `lines: [{ rid, child_name, description, note, amount }]`.
- `more`: the count of rows not shown.

**How a bill is worked out.**

- **The children billed.** Children on the AM / PM route plans in use when the period starts, plus children who join
  before it ends.
- **Each child's fare.**
  - The tier comes from the straight-line distance from the school: add 0.05 km, then round up to 0.1 km. For zones, the
    tier is the first zone whose postal sectors or drawn area hold the home.
  - 2-way, 1-way, or AM / PM fares follow the sessions the child rides.
  - A small bus or a bus-size column applies for the days the child's bus was that size.
  - The bill month's Extra Charges are added.
- **A child who joins mid-period** is charged by the start rule: prorated by school days, the full period, or half from
  the 16th. The line `note` says how, for example `"Joins 01/03/2027, 58 of 98 school days"`.
- **A child who stops** (a Stop Service request, or the rider's end date) pays up to that day. When the policy's refund
  basis is days, this is prorated by school days.
- **A month on a request's first invoice** is skipped.
- **When the school pays per bus,** the bill has one line per bus size (`"3 x LARGE_45 at S$4200.00"`). A further
  `"Route charges and changes during the period"` line covers Route Charges and plan changes within the month.

**Issuing.** Issuing gives the bill its INV number and GST. It also takes off the payer's credit notes that were waiting
for the next bill, each as a line `"Credit from CN-…"` with `credit_note: true`. Parents see their bills in the Convoy
App, and the school sees its bill in the Client Portal (when those apps come).

**Automatic drafting.** A daily job at 01:00 drafts the coming period of every school year with locked Bus Fares, once
`draft_on` has come. It does not draft a period twice.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 1. Family Bills: draft and issue_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept { ids: [] } — accept many at their Bus Fares quotes.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | Add Application on a parent's behalf |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge` | Mid-year: `{ answer_by, note }`. Under Review; the parent sees the date and the note |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/move_answer` | `{ answer_by, reason }`. The reason is required; every move is kept |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/decide` | Waitlist or Decline one or many: `{ ids: [], to: Waitlisted \| Declined, reason, note }`. New Service: both. Change of Address / Service / Stop Service: **Decline only**, while Requested or Under Review. Follow the detail's `can.waitlist` / `can.decline` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests?kind=new&academic_year_id=&status=&tag=&level=&session=&deadline=&q=&page=&limit=

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | The Requests page (filters below) |
| `GET /bus_requests/:id` | One request with its history |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/open` | Opening it the first time: Requested → Under Review. A mid-year request waits for Acknowledge |

**Filters.**

- `kind`: `new` (default), `adr`, `svc` or `stop`.
- `academic_year_id`: New Service only. The default is the year after this one.
- `status`: a status, or `Accepted+` for Accepted and Active.
- `tag`, `level`, `session` (`AM` or `PM`).
- `deadline`: `over`, `soon` or `ok`.
- `check`: `covered`, `change`, `new` or `none`.
- `q`: child, parent, code, postal, email or address. Three or more digits also match the phone.
- `page`, `limit` (default 150, max 500).

**Order.**

- New Service: overdue mid-year first, then due soon, then other mid-year requests, then the rest. Renewals come first
  within each group, then the oldest.
- The other tabs: newest first.

**Statuses** use the app's words:

- `Requested`, `Under Review`, `Accepted`, `Active`, `Waitlisted`, `Declined`, `Withdrawn`, `Not Agreed`, `Stopping` and
  `Stopped` are stored.
- `Lapsed` is read, never stored: an accepted request not paid by `offer_by`.
- A `Stopping` request past its last day reads `Stopped`.
- `status_label` shows `Waiting for Parent` while a higher fare waits for the parent to agree.
- `tone` is one of `info`, `success`, `warning`, `danger` or `neutral`.

**Tags.**

- Stored on the request: `Renewing` and `Final Level`.
- Worked out on the server:
  - `New`: no current rider, or not a renewal.
  - `Mid-Year`: sent after the year's service started.
  - `Fixed Start`.
  - `From the App` or `Sample`.

**Row fields.**

- What the parent asked for: `code`, `kind`, `source` (`app`, `console` or `sample`), `child_name`, `level`, `am`, `pm`,
  `cca`, the parent fields, `submitted_at`, `start_text` (for example "From 16/11/2026, not earlier (moving house)").
- Where it stands: `status`, `status_label`, `tone`, `tags`, `reason`, `last_event`.
- `deadline` (mid-year only): `{ stage: ack | answer, by, left (working days), tone: ok | soon | over }`.
- `check`: Route Fit (section 4).
- The offer: `offer_by`, `hours_left`, `quote_amount`.
- Links: `rider` (`{ id, rid }`) and `family` (`{ id, code, name }`).
- Changes: `change` (section 5) and `end_action`.

The parent fields are `parent_name`, `parent_phone`, `parent_email`, `postal`. Also `renew`, `start_when`, `start_on`.
`last_event` = the latest history line `{ at, by, text }` (or `null`). A row:

```json
{ "id": 88, "code": "REQ-0088", "kind": "new", "source": "app", "status": "Under Review", "status_label": "Under Review", "tone": "info",
  "child_name": "Tan Jia Hui", "level": "P3", "am": true, "pm": true, "cca": false, "parent_name": "Tan Wei Ming",
  "parent_phone": "+65 9123 4567", "parent_email": "weiming.tan@example.com", "postal": "460101", "lat": "1.3305", "lng": "103.9373", "located": true,
  "submitted_at": "2026-10-20T19:50:00+08:00",
  "tags": ["New", "From the App"], "renew": false, "start_when": "date", "start_on": "2026-11-16",
  "start_text": "From 16/11/2026, not earlier (moving house)", "reason": null,
  "deadline": { "stage": "answer", "by": "2026-11-06", "left": 2, "tone": "soon" },
  "check": { "code": "covered", "kind": "fits", "label": "Fits", "tone": "success", "current": false, "free": 3, "summary": "AM fits AM 1 | PM fits PM 2" }, "offer_by": null, "quote_amount": null, "hours_left": null,
  "end_action": null, "change": null, "rider": null, "family": { "id": 7, "code": "FAM-0007", "name": "TAN FAMILY" },
  "last_event": { "at": "2026-10-21T09:00:00+08:00", "by": "Ops Admin", "text": "Opened" } }
```

Add Application takes only what the prototype's form has (child, parent, phone, email, level, address, postal, AM / PM,
start, fee). CCA, the fixed-start reason and the form answers come only from the Convoy App.

**Meta.**

- The tiles `[{ label, count, filter }]`. `filter` is the query to send when the tile is clicked, e.g.
  `{ "status": "Requested" }`, `{ "tag": "Mid-Year" }`, `{ "deadline": "over" }`; `null` = not clickable ("Not Yet Renewed").
  Mid-Year and Overdue appear only when there are any.
- `tabs` (`open` counts), `windows` (early and general window state), `years` and `levels`.
- `service_check`: `{ none: false, plan: "Term 4 AM (current)" }` → "Service check uses <plan>"; `{ none: true, plan: null }` →
  "No AM route plan with routes yet".
- Rows carry `lat`, `lng`, `located` (the applicant's home, for the map of applicant homes; `null` until placed). Home
  locations of children: show them only on that map, never in an export.
- `years`: `[{ "id": 2, "key": "2027", "tag": "Next Year", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-11-19", "to_review": 12, "requests": 40, "registration": "open" }]`;
  `tag` = `This Year`, `Next Year`, `Later` or `Past`; `registration` = the registration `state` (section 2) or `not_set_up`.
- `mid`: `ack_days`, `plan_weeks`, `service_starts_on`.
- `auto_accept` and `cover` (section 4).

**The detail** adds the following:

- The address and the form answers.
- `ack`: `{ at, by, answer_by, note, moves[] }`.
- `route_fit` per session, `quote`, `quote_default`, `places[]`, `first_bill` and `planned`:
  - `quote`: `{ amount, base, unit, note, by, at }` (or `null` before Accept).
  - `places[]`: the seats kept for the child `[{ session, route_id, route, kind: fits | new, stop, delta_minutes }]`.
  - `first_bill`: `{ id, number, period, subtotal, gst, total, status: open | paid, issued_on, due_at, paid_at, method }` (or `null`).

  `student_no`, `birth_date`, `medical`, `cca_days`, `fee_paid`, `policy_version`, `answer_default`.
- `events[]`, newest first.
- `can`: `{ acknowledge, move_answer, waitlist, decline, accept, reoffer, record_payment, confirm_change, confirm_stop, not_agreed, end_rider }`.

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests { academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address,
  postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests` | Add Application on a parent's behalf |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/acknowledge` | Mid-year: `{ answer_by, note }`. Under Review; the parent sees the date and the note |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/move_answer` | `{ answer_by, reason }`. The reason is required; every move is kept |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/decide` | Waitlist or Decline one or many: `{ ids: [], to: Waitlisted \| Declined, reason, note }`. New Service: both. Change of Address / Service / Stop Service: **Decline only**, while Requested or Under Review. Follow the detail's `can.waitlist` / `can.decline` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/message` | `{ ids: [], text }`. Logged on each request (parent accounts are not live) |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/accept` | Accept and Send Quote: `{ amount, start_on, note }` |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bus_requests/accept` | Accept many at their Bus Fares quotes: `{ ids: [] }`. Also used by the auto-accept and "can now be covered" banners |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/reoffer` | A lapsed offer again: the same quote and invoice number, new hours to pay |
| `POST /bus_requests/:id/record_payment` | Record First Invoice Paid: `{ method }`. The request becomes Active |

**Add Application.**

- Body: `{ academic_year_id, child_name, parent_name, parent_phone, parent_email, level, address, postal, am, pm, start_on, fee_paid }`.
- Errors: `Enter the child's name`, `Enter the parent's name`, `Enter a 6-digit postal code`, `Pick AM, PM or both`.
- The postal code is placed on the map with OneMap. `located: false` when OneMap does not know it.

**Reasons.**

- Waitlist: `Route full`, `New area`, `Awaiting bus`.
- Decline: `Outside service area`, `Not eligible`, `Duplicate application`, `Other`.
- An empty reason is allowed.

**Route Fit (`check`, `route_fit`).** Each session the request asks for is checked against the routes running on its
start date. That is the session's plan in use that day, or else the latest plan.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `fits` (Fits) | A child already rides from the same block on a route with a free seat |
| `new` (New Stop) | A route with a free seat can add a stop at the child's block, inside the arrival window (AM) and the max journey. `delta` is minutes added; `impact[]` is what changes for the other children; `alts[]` are other routes |
| `full` (Bus Full) | Routes can reach the child, but none has a free seat |
| `area` (New Area) | No route can reach the child |
| `none` (Not Checked) | The session has no route plan yet |

How the check is worked out:

- **Free seats.** Seats, less the riders, less the seats held for accepted requests not yet in the plan, plus riders
  who have left by then.
- **Limits.** The arrival window and max journey come from the year's Bus Sessions. Without them, the plan's own settings apply.
- **Worst session wins.** The row shows the worst session. The order from best to worst is Fits, New Stop, Not Checked,
  Bus Full, New Area. The label gets "(part)" when a session is Not Checked.
- **Other labels.** A renewal whose child already rides shows `Covered` (current route). An accepted request shows `Seat held`.

**Quote (`quote_default`).** This is the Bus Fares tier for the distance from the school.

- **Which table.** The year's locked table, or else the latest locked table before it.
- **Which amount.** The amount of the bill the start date falls in. Both sessions are charged two ways; AM only or PM
  only is charged one way.
- **Unit.** `month`, `term` or `semester`.
- **No table.** Without a table, the quote is the estimate the parent saw.
- **Text.** `text` has the Route Fit summary and how the fare was found.

**Accept checks.**

- `Enter the monthly fare` and `Pick the start date`.
- A fixed start cannot be earlier than the family asked: "The family needs the bus from …".
- A note is required when the fare differs from Bus Fares or the start is later than asked:
  `Add a note for the parent: …`.

**On accept.**

- The request becomes Accepted, with `offer_by` = now + the registration's confirm hours (48 by default).
- The seat is held where Route Fit placed the child (`places[]`).
- **First invoice (`first_bill`).** A real School Bus bill:
  - Numbered from Finance Settings (`INV-2026-000123`).
  - GST as in Finance Settings.
  - Covers the start's billing period, and is due at `offer_by`.
- **A new child** joins the rider list from the start date as Unpaid, and joins a family. The family is the school's
  family with a guardian of the same phone (last 8 digits) or email. Otherwise a new family `<LAST NAME> Family` is
  created, with the parent as guardian.

**After the offer.**

- Not paid by `offer_by`: the request reads `Lapsed`. Use Re-offer, or End Rider (section 5).
- Paid: Active, and the child joins the route plans from the start date (section 5, plan versions).

**Banners.**

- `meta.auto_accept` (`{ count, ids }`) lists the requests the scheduled registration's rules would take. These are
  renewals unchanged, renewing riders at the same address and sessions, siblings, and families nearby, with a seat
  beyond `seats_buffer` when the rule asks for one.
- `meta.cover` lists waitlisted requests that can now be covered.
- Both are accepted with the bulk call.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 4. New Service: review, accept, first invoice_

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/families/import { file | text }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families?q=&page=` | The list, with search and the count of riders not in a family (`meta.unlinked_riders`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families` | Add a family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode }, guardian: { first_name, last_name, relationship, phone, email } }` |
| `GET /families/:id` | One family, with its guardians and its riders (sessions, dates, the routes they ride) |
| `PATCH /families/:id` | Change the family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode } }` |
| `DELETE /families/:id` | Delete the family |
| `POST /families/:id/guardians` | Add a guardian: `{ guardian: { first_name, last_name, name_order: first\|last, relationship, phone, email } }` (→ the family) |
| `PATCH /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Change a guardian |
| `DELETE /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Remove a guardian |
| `POST /families/:id/riders` | Link riders: `{ school_id, rids: [] }` (a rider leaves any other family at the school) |
| `DELETE /families/:id/riders/:rid?school_id=` | Unlink a rider |
| `GET /families/:id/candidates?school_id=&q=` | Link Existing Rider: parent matches first, then the same last name (`match: parent \| last_name`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families/import` | CSV import (`file`, or `text`), with warnings |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families/export` | CSV export |

**List row** (`GET /schools/:school_id/families`, paged, `meta { page, limit, count, pages, unlinked_riders }`):

```json
{ "id": 7, "code": "FAM-0007", "name": "TAN FAMILY", "name_mode": "auto", "source": "app", "sample": true, "guardians": 2,
  "first_guardian": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "relationship": "Father", "phone": "+65 9123 4567" },
  "children": [ { "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Jia Hui" } ] }
```

**One family** (`GET /families/:id`):

```json
{ "id": 7, "code": "FAM-0007", "name": "TAN FAMILY", "name_mode": "auto", "source": "app", "sample": true,
  "address": "Blk 101 Bedok North Ave 4 #05-12", "postal": "460101", "registered_at": "2026-10-20T19:42:00+08:00", "school_id": 1,
  "guardians": [ { "id": 15, "first_name": "Wei Ming", "last_name": "Tan", "name_order": "last", "name": "Tan Wei Ming",
                   "relationship": "Father", "phone": "+65 9123 4567", "email": "weiming.tan@example.com",
                   "app_joined_at": "2026-10-20T19:42:00+08:00", "app_joined_how": "signup" } ],
  "riders": [ { "school_id": 1, "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Jia Hui", "grade": "P3", "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2],
                "starts_on": "2026-11-02", "ends_on": null, "on_list": true, "applied_at": "2026-10-20T19:50:00+08:00",
                "accepted_at": "2026-10-22T10:05:00+08:00",
                "rides": [ { "session": "am", "route": "AM 1", "stop": "Blk 101 Bedok North", "time": "06:35" } ],
                "unpaid": { "request_id": 31, "bill_number": "INV-2026-000041", "overdue": false },
                "leave": null } ] }
```

What the prototype's lines come from:

| Line in the prototype | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| "Sample" badge | `sample: true` |
| "Registered in the Convoy App by <name> on <date>" | `source: "app"`, `registered_at`; `<name>` = the guardian with `app_joined_how: "signup"` |
| Guardian "Signed up in the app" / "Joined by invite" | `app_joined_how`: `signup` / `invite` (`null` = not in the app), `app_joined_at` |
| Guardian "Name Shown As" (First Last / Last First) | `name_order`: `first` → "Wei Ming Tan", `last` → "Tan Wei Ming"; `name` = the result |
| Family home address | `address`, `postal` |
| Rider "Applied in the Convoy App …, accepted …" | `applied_at`, `accepted_at` |
| Rider route / stop / time | `rides[]` (plans in use today) |
| Rider "Unpaid: first invoice INV-… not paid yet" / "… is overdue. Remove the rider if the family is not going ahead" | `unpaid { request_id, bill_number, overdue }` (`null` when paid or none) |
| Rider leave line + End Rider / Remove from Rider List | `leave { request_id, button, label, text, ends_on }` (`null` = nothing to do) → "`label`. `text`", button `button` calls `POST /bus_requests/:request_id/end_rider` |
| `relationship` | `Parent`, `Mother`, `Father`, `Guardian`, `Grandparent`, `Relative`, `Helper`, `Other` |

"Reported Issues" (Reply) on the React family page is not in the prototype and has no API: leave it out.

How families work:

- **Codes.** Codes run `FAM-0001`, `FAM-0002` and so on.
- **Automatic names.** With `name_mode: auto`, the name comes from a guardian's last name: Father first, then Mother, then
  the first guardian, upper case. For example, `TAN FAMILY`.
- **Add Rider.** `POST /schools/:id/riders` accepts `family_id` to put the new rider in that family.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 1. Families & Riders_

POST /schools/:school_id/rider_assignments/remove { rids: [] } — Unassign: the riders lose their PUDO.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /plans/:id/adopt { from }` | Adopt the plan from a date |
| `POST /plans/:id/cancel_adoption` | A scheduled plan goes back to draft; the plan it would have replaced runs on |

**Adopt rules:**

- `from` must be the 1st of this month or later, and not before the current plan's start.
- The plan runs on the **Scheduler** from that date: `scheduled` before the date, `current` from it.
- The plan of the same session in use on that date ends the day before. A plan scheduled after the date is cancelled.
- From the very day the current plan started, the current plan is taken out of use as if it never ran: it goes back to
  `draft` (its Route Charges move to the new plan, its runs leave the Scheduler; runs already started stay).
- Runs are re-synced in the background.
- `DELETE /plans/:id` (draft) and deleting routes clean everything on the routes; a route with runs on the Scheduler
  that started or have records (Driver app, notes, reports) cannot go: `422` "AM 1 has runs on the Scheduler that started
  or have records, so it cannot be removed".

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick a date from the 1st of this month" | `from` before the 1st of this month |
| "AM Plan 1 was only adopted on 2 Nov 2026. Pick that day or later" | `from` before the current plan's start |
| "The plan has no routes" | Empty plan |
| "This plan is already adopted" | Plan already in use |

**Rider assignments.** An **AM** plan assigns each of its riders the PUDO point they use **when it starts** (prototype
`promotePlan`): at once when adopted from today or an earlier day, else on its start day (the daily job, about 01:30).
Scheduling a plan for a later date changes nothing yet, so Cancel has nothing to undo; moving a scheduled plan's start to
today with `PATCH /plans/:id` assigns at once. Stop Assignment (`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment`) then shows `assigned`
for each rider, and `meta.counts.assigned` / `notified`. Riders set by hand keep their point.

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments { rids: [], stop_point_id }` | Set as assigned (by hand) |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/remove { rids: [] }` | Unassign: the riders lose their PUDO. Returns `{ removed }`; `422` "None of these riders have a PUDO" |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/move { stop_point_id }` | Move All Riders Here: the riders assigned to the other points of that stop move to this one. Returns `{ moved }` |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_assignments/notify` | Notify: returns `{ notified: n }`. Show "Assigned PUDO sent to N riders". Recorded only; sending comes with the app |

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-routes.md` § 5. Adopt Plan and rider assignments_

GET /schools/:school_id/plans?session=am

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/plans?session=am` | The plan list, newest first |
| `GET /plans/:id` | One plan (fields below) |
| `GET /schools/:id/routes?date=` | The routes of the plans in use that day (default today), AM / PM / CCA by number: `[{ id, label, session, plan_id, riders_count, start_time, end_time, vehicle_plate }]`. A light list for pickers (School route notices, [scheduler.md § 12](scheduler.md#12-notice-form)) |
| `POST /schools/:id/plans { session, date }` | **Draw Routes** (prototype `createManualPlan`): an empty plan (`source: "manual"`) for the Plan For `date` (default today, `effective_from`). Every rider of the session is in `unassigned`: riders at a stop by stop (`NOT_ROUTED`, `label` = stop code), riders with no stop / more than one on their own (`RIDER_NO_STOP` / `RIDER_IN_CONFLICT`, `label` = name). `summary` (no routes, all riders unassigned) and `params` (engine defaults + the company's + session) are set. `422` "Date must look like 2026-11-02" |
| `PATCH /plans/:id { plan: { name, effective_from, effective_to } }` | Rename, or change the run dates |
| `DELETE /plans/:id` | Delete a draft (only drafts) |
| `POST /plans/:id/comments { body }` / `DELETE /plans/:id/comments/:comment_id` | Comments |
| `GET /plans/:id/compare?with=:other_id` | Compare Plans: the engine's comparison, with names `a` (this plan) / `b` (`with`) |

**Compare Plans** response. Pairs are `[a, b]` (this plan, the other one):

```json
{ "data": { "a": "AM Plan 3", "b": "AM Plan 2",
            "byType": [ { "type": "MEDIUM_23", "a": 3, "b": 4 }, { "type": "SMALL_13", "a": 1, "b": 0 } ],
            "routes": [4, 4], "avg": [38.2, 41.0], "max": [52.4, 55.1], "cost": [412.6, 430.0], "fill": [0.71, 0.66], "unassigned": [0, 2],
            "moved": 6, "shifted": 11, "movedList": ["S-1001", "S-1014"] } }
```

`avg` / `max` = journey minutes, `cost` = the engine's cost figure, `fill` = average fill (0–1), `moved` = riders on another
stop, `shifted` = riders whose time changes by more than 5 minutes. `503`-like `422` "The routing service is not available (…)".

**State badges:**

| `state` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `draft` | Not adopted |
| `scheduled` | Adopted from a later date |
| `current` | In use now |
| `replaced` | A later plan took over |

**Other badges and figures:**

- `out_of_date: true` means the school's stops or catchments changed after the plan was made. Show "Out of Date" and
  offer to run again.
- KPIs, the bus mix and slots come from `summary`, the same keys as the engine's (also after hand edits, Route Again and
  Draw Routes): `riders`, `assigned`, `unassigned`, `routes`, `byType`, `avgJourney` / `maxJourney` (min), `avgFill`
  (0–1), the optimisation score by part `fixed` (buses), `run` (running), `overtime`, `floor` (below min fill),
  `stability`, `total` = fixed + run + overtime + floor ("Optimisation score N pts"), and `slots` = buses per 5-minute
  slot (`"HH:MM"`: arrival at school for AM, departure for PM / CCA).
- The Students list: each route's `stops[].riders` (rider IDs) with the stop and time.
- The Unassigned list is `unassigned`: `[{ gid, riders: [rid], n, reason, label }]`. `reason` is a code; label it as the
  prototype (`REASONS`): `NOT_ROUTED` "Not on a route yet", `ADMIN_REMOVED` "Removed by admin", `RIDER_NO_STOP` "No stop

post.description:
POST /schools/:school_id/rider_links { stop_point_id, rids: [], postals: [] } — Select Riders › link as an alternative.

`GET /schools/:id/stop_assignment?date=` returns the riders on that date (the Plan For date) and the PUDO points each one
may use:

```json
{ "data": [ { "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Wei Ling", "grade": "P3", "postal": "460100", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.92,
              "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2, 4], "starts_on": null, "status": "one", "cut_point_ids": [ 33 ],
              "assigned": { "point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "manual": false, "plan_id": 5, "notified_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00" },
              "candidates": [ { "stop_id": 12, "stop_code": "BDSZ03-0001", "point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "usage": "both",
                                "how": "postal" | "area" | "manual", "manual": false, "metres": 52 } ] } ],
  "meta": { "date": "2026-11-02", "counts": { "riders": 65, "with_pudo": 65, "conflicts": 0, "no_stop": 0, "assigned": 60, "notified": 58 },
            "stops_changed_at": "…" } }
```

**Candidates.** A rider's candidate points are worked out like this, as in the prototype:

1. Start with every point of the school's stops whose catchment has the rider's home: by postal code, or inside an area
   and not in an exclude area.
2. Leave out the points turned off for the school.
3. Add the points linked to the rider or their postal code by hand (`how: "manual"`).
4. Leave out the points cut off from the rider (`cut_point_ids`: the hidden points; linking the rider to one again with
   `POST /schools/:id/rider_links` brings it back).

`assigned` is the point the rider is assigned to (from an adopted Route Plan, or set by hand: `manual: true`), or `null`;
`notified_at` is when **Notify** recorded it (`null` = not yet). `meta.counts.assigned` / `notified` count those riders.
Set as assigned, Move All Riders Here and Notify: [school-bus-routes § 5](school-bus-routes.md#5-adopt-plan-and-rider-assignments). Out of Date: `out_of_date` on a plan ([routes § 3](school-bus-routes.md#3-plans)).

Rider colours on the map follow `status`:

| `status` | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `one` | Assigned: one stop |
| `conflict` | Points of more than one stop |
| `none` | No stop |

**Tools:**

| Call | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links { stop_point_id, rids: [...], postals: [...] }` | Select Riders (S): link the picked riders or postal codes to a point as an alternative |
| `POST /schools/:id/rider_links/remove { links: [{ rid, point_id }] }` | Select Links (L) › Remove: a hand link is deleted; a link from the catchment is cut off for that rider. A rider assigned to a removed point is unassigned. Answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }` |

Reload the assignment after either call.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 4. Stop Assignment_

POST /schools/:school_id/rider_datasets/preview (multipart file)

`GET /schools/:id/rider_datasets?date=` returns the lists (oldest first):

```json
{ "id": 7, "effective_from": "2026-01-02", "file_name": "SSS riders 2026.csv", "riders_count": 65, "checked_count": 65, "unlocated_count": 0,
  "status": "ready", "state": "in_use", "uploaded_by": "Ops Admin", "created_at": "…",
  "file": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/<token>", "name": "SSS_riders_2026.csv", "size": 4210, "content_type": "text/csv" } }
```

- `state` is `in_use`, `scheduled` or `replaced`.
- `status` is `locating` while homes are being placed on the map, then `ready`. While locating, poll the list and show
  "Finding addresses on OneMap: `checked_count` of `riders_count`".
- `unlocated_count` is the number of riders OneMap did not find (No Location).

**Check a file before importing:** `POST /schools/:id/rider_datasets/preview` (multipart, `file` = CSV or XLSX).

```json
{ "riders": 3, "problems": 3, "errors": [ { "line": 4, "message": "Row 4: no student name" } ], "sample": [ { "rid": "S-1", "name": "…" } ] }
```

Show "N riders ready to import | M problems (those rows are skipped)" and the first errors.

Columns are found by name, in any order, as in the prototype's template:

| Column | Also accepted |
| --- | --- |
| `student_id` | Student ID / ID |
| `student_name` (required) | Name |
| `gender` | |
| `grade_class` | Grade / Class / Level |
| `address` (required) | |
| `postal_code` (required) | Postal / Postcode |
| `am` | |
| `pm` | |
| `cca_days` | |
| `start_date` | |
| `end_date` | |
| `parent_name` | |
| `parent_contact` | |
| `remarks` | |

Value rules:

- `am` / `pm`: `Y` / `Yes` / `1` / `x`. If the column is missing, everyone rides that session.
- `cca_days`: days such as `Mon;Wed`.
- Dates: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `DD/MM/YYYY`.
- An empty student ID becomes `S-<row number>`.
- A student ID used twice keeps only its first row.
- Postal codes shorter than 6 digits are padded with leading zeros.

**Import:** `POST /schools/:id/rider_datasets` (multipart `file`, `effective_from`).

- The response (201) is the new list (`status: "locating"`), plus `meta.skipped` (up to 50) and `meta.skipped_count`.
- Homes are placed in the background. Poll the list until `status` is `ready`.
- Show "N addresses not found; they show as No Location" from `unlocated_count`.
- Rows with a problem are **skipped** (listed in `meta.skipped`, counted in `meta.skipped_count`); the good rows are
  imported. `422` only when no row can be imported (the message lists the problems), with no file, or with no Effective From date.

**Delete:** `DELETE /schools/:id/rider_datasets/:dataset_id`. Ask for confirmation first: "Riders from it will no longer
be planned".

The CSV and XLSX templates are built by the FE, as in the prototype.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 2.1 Rider Data tab_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/rider_events?date= — the Plan For calendar: joining / leaving / service change / new rider
list by date, and how many changes come in the 30 days after the date.

`GET /schools/:id/rider_events?date=2026-11-02` (`date` = the Plan For date) feeds the Plan For date picker of the School
Bus header:

```json
{ "data": [ { "date": "2026-10-01", "kind": "list", "rid": null, "name": "SSS riders Oct.csv", "service": null },
            { "date": "2026-11-20", "kind": "leave", "rid": "S-2", "name": "Lim Jia Hui", "service": "AM" },
            { "date": "2027-01-02", "kind": "join", "rid": "S-0002", "name": "New Kid", "service": "AM + PM" } ],
  "meta": { "date": "2026-11-02", "soon": 1 } }
```

- `kind`: `join` (green dot, Joining), `leave` (red, Leaving), `change` (orange, Service change), `list` (teal, New rider
  list: `name` is the file name). By date; one event per date, kind and rider.
- How they are worked out (as the prototype): each rider list starts on its `effective_from` (`list`); against the list
  before it, a rider new to the list joins (on its start date when later), a rider whose service (`service`: "AM + PM +
  CCA" or "No service") changed is a `change`, a rider no longer on it leaves; a rider's end date is a `leave`. Riders
  added by hand join on their start date and leave on their end date.
- `meta.soon` = changes (not lists) in the 30 days after `date`: the badge "N rider changes in the next 30 days".
- Day tip: "<date>: 3 joining, 1 leaving, 2 changing service, 1 new rider list"; This Month groups the names by day
  ("Name (AM + PM), … +k more", 4 names at most).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 2.3 Plan For calendar (rider changes)_

{ "data": [ { "id": 41, "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Wei Ling", "first_name": null, "last_name": null, "name_order": "last",
              "gender": "F", "grade": "P3", "address": "…", "postal": "460100", "lat": 1.32, "lng": 103.92, "located": true,

POST /schools/:school_id/riders { rider: { first_name, last_name, name_order, rid, gender, grade, address, postal, am, pm,
  cca_days, starts_on, ends_on, parent_name, parent_contact, remarks }, family_id }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families?q=&page=` | The list, with search and the count of riders not in a family (`meta.unlinked_riders`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families` | Add a family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode }, guardian: { first_name, last_name, relationship, phone, email } }` |
| `GET /families/:id` | One family, with its guardians and its riders (sessions, dates, the routes they ride) |
| `PATCH /families/:id` | Change the family: `{ family: { code, name, name_mode } }` |
| `DELETE /families/:id` | Delete the family |
| `POST /families/:id/guardians` | Add a guardian: `{ guardian: { first_name, last_name, name_order: first\|last, relationship, phone, email } }` (→ the family) |
| `PATCH /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Change a guardian |
| `DELETE /families/:id/guardians/:guardian_id` | Remove a guardian |
| `POST /families/:id/riders` | Link riders: `{ school_id, rids: [] }` (a rider leaves any other family at the school) |
| `DELETE /families/:id/riders/:rid?school_id=` | Unlink a rider |
| `GET /families/:id/candidates?school_id=&q=` | Link Existing Rider: parent matches first, then the same last name (`match: parent \| last_name`) |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/families/import` | CSV import (`file`, or `text`), with warnings |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/families/export` | CSV export |

**List row** (`GET /schools/:school_id/families`, paged, `meta { page, limit, count, pages, unlinked_riders }`):

```json
{ "id": 7, "code": "FAM-0007", "name": "TAN FAMILY", "name_mode": "auto", "source": "app", "sample": true, "guardians": 2,
  "first_guardian": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "relationship": "Father", "phone": "+65 9123 4567" },
  "children": [ { "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Jia Hui" } ] }
```

**One family** (`GET /families/:id`):

```json
{ "id": 7, "code": "FAM-0007", "name": "TAN FAMILY", "name_mode": "auto", "source": "app", "sample": true,
  "address": "Blk 101 Bedok North Ave 4 #05-12", "postal": "460101", "registered_at": "2026-10-20T19:42:00+08:00", "school_id": 1,
  "guardians": [ { "id": 15, "first_name": "Wei Ming", "last_name": "Tan", "name_order": "last", "name": "Tan Wei Ming",
                   "relationship": "Father", "phone": "+65 9123 4567", "email": "weiming.tan@example.com",
                   "app_joined_at": "2026-10-20T19:42:00+08:00", "app_joined_how": "signup" } ],
  "riders": [ { "school_id": 1, "rid": "S-1001", "name": "Tan Jia Hui", "grade": "P3", "am": true, "pm": true, "cca_days": [2],
                "starts_on": "2026-11-02", "ends_on": null, "on_list": true, "applied_at": "2026-10-20T19:50:00+08:00",
                "accepted_at": "2026-10-22T10:05:00+08:00",
                "rides": [ { "session": "am", "route": "AM 1", "stop": "Blk 101 Bedok North", "time": "06:35" } ],
                "unpaid": { "request_id": 31, "bill_number": "INV-2026-000041", "overdue": false },
                "leave": null } ] }
```

What the prototype's lines come from:

| Line in the prototype | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| "Sample" badge | `sample: true` |
| "Registered in the Convoy App by <name> on <date>" | `source: "app"`, `registered_at`; `<name>` = the guardian with `app_joined_how: "signup"` |
| Guardian "Signed up in the app" / "Joined by invite" | `app_joined_how`: `signup` / `invite` (`null` = not in the app), `app_joined_at` |
| Guardian "Name Shown As" (First Last / Last First) | `name_order`: `first` → "Wei Ming Tan", `last` → "Tan Wei Ming"; `name` = the result |
| Family home address | `address`, `postal` |
| Rider "Applied in the Convoy App …, accepted …" | `applied_at`, `accepted_at` |
| Rider route / stop / time | `rides[]` (plans in use today) |
| Rider "Unpaid: first invoice INV-… not paid yet" / "… is overdue. Remove the rider if the family is not going ahead" | `unpaid { request_id, bill_number, overdue }` (`null` when paid or none) |
| Rider leave line + End Rider / Remove from Rider List | `leave { request_id, button, label, text, ends_on }` (`null` = nothing to do) → "`label`. `text`", button `button` calls `POST /bus_requests/:request_id/end_rider` |
| `relationship` | `Parent`, `Mother`, `Father`, `Guardian`, `Grandparent`, `Relative`, `Helper`, `Other` |

"Reported Issues" (Reply) on the React family page is not in the prototype and has no API: leave it out.

How families work:

- **Codes.** Codes run `FAM-0001`, `FAM-0002` and so on.
- **Automatic names.** With `name_mode: auto`, the name comes from a guardian's last name: Father first, then Mother, then
  the first guardian, upper case. For example, `TAN FAMILY`.
- **Add Rider.** `POST /schools/:id/riders` accepts `family_id` to put the new rider in that family.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 1. Families & Riders_

get.description:
GET /schools/:school_id/academic_years

An academic year runs for 12 months from its start month.

- Its `key` is `"2026"` when it starts in January, otherwise `"2026/27"`.
- Its calendar has operating days and either 2 Semesters or 3–4 Terms.
- Each term has a CCA / ASA period: the term's own dates when `cca_same_as_terms`, otherwise its own dates.
- A **school day** is an operating day, inside a term, and not a holiday.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/academic_years` | The years, oldest first (the year selector) |
| `POST /schools/:id/academic_years { start_year, start_month, copy_from_id }` | New Academic Year (see below) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id` | One year with its terms, holidays and special days |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "public_holiday_id": 12, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "public_holiday_id": 12, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Templates | `GET /notice_templates` → `[{ id, name, message }]` (`{min}`, `{time}` to fill in) |
| Send | `POST /notices` (body below) |
| Lists (Active, Scheduled, Ended) | `GET /notices?state=active|scheduled|ended&trip_id=` (page and search: [trips.md § Notices](trips.md#2-notices-page)) |
| Edit (scheduled only) | `PATCH /notices/:id` |
| End Now (active only) | `PATCH /notices/:id/end_now` |
| Duplicate | `POST /notices/:id/duplicate` (starts now, same length) |
| Delete (not active) | `DELETE /notices/:id` |

```json
{ "notice": { "audience": "trip", "trip_id": 8, "to_riders": true, "to_parents": false, "banner": true, "push": true, "sms": false,
              "notice_template_id": 1, "message": "The bus is running about 10 minutes late because of heavy traffic." },
  "start": "now", "period_minutes": 15, "run_keys": ["d1r0"] }
```

- Start: `start: "now"` (Immediate) or `start: "at"` with `notice[starts_at]`. End: `period_minutes` (5, 15, 20, 25, 30 or any) or `notice[ends_at]`.
- Trip notices: `run_keys`: `["all"]` or the timings (`d1r0`...). School route notices: `audience: "school"`, `school_id`, `route_ids: ["all"]` or route ids.
- **School route picker**: `GET /schools/:id/routes?date=<the notice's start day>` (default today) → the routes of the plans in
  use that day, AM then PM then CCA, by route number:
  `{ "data": [ { "id": 51, "label": "AM 1", "session": "am", "plan_id": 21, "riders_count": 18, "start_time": "06:35", "end_time": "07:20", "vehicle_plate": "PD6604E" } ] }`.
  Chips = `label`; "All Routes" = `route_ids: ["all"]`; the audience line "N riders on M routes" adds up `riders_count`.
  An empty list = "No routes in use for this school". Schools for the picker: `GET /schools`.
- `route_ids` must be routes of plans in use while the notice runs: else `422` "Pick routes in use at this school".
- Refused: WhatsApp (`notice[whatsapp]`) "WhatsApp is not available yet"; `{min}` / `{time}` left in the message; no audience; no channel; end before start; editing an active or ended notice.
- Push and SMS are recorded in `sent` (sending comes with the apps).

get.description:
GET /routing_runs/:id

`POST /schools/:id/routing_runs { session: am|pm|asa, date, params: { preset, effort, … } }` returns **202** with the
run. Poll `GET /routing_runs/:id` until `status` is `done` or `failed` (it takes up to the effort time: 15–120 s).

```json
{ "id": 9, "school_id": 3, "session": "am", "plan_date": "2026-11-02", "status": "queued" | "running" | "done" | "failed",
  "error": null, "riders": 65, "stops": 7, "no_stop": [ { "rid": "S-1044", "name": "Tan Wei Ling" } ], "conflicts": [], "ms": 41250, "plan_id": 21,
  "progress": { "step": "solving", "frac": 0.42, "run": 2, "runs": 4, "elapsed": 18400, "left": 31600,
                "work": { "phase": "Swap and relocate pass", "i": 3, "n": 9, "extra": "Best 12,345 pts", "evals": 184230 },
                "log": [ { "run": 1, "phase": "Sweep start angle", "i": 24, "n": 24 } ] }, … }
```

**Loader** (poll about every second): `progress` while `running` (`null` when the routing service cannot tell, e.g.
restarted; keep polling), `{ step: "done", frac: 1, work: { evals } }` when done, `null` otherwise.

- `step`: `queued`, `matrix` → "Step 1 of 2 | Loading road travel times" (bar 4 %), `solving` → "Step 2 of 2 | Searching for
  the best routes | Run `run` of `runs` | `elapsed`/1000 s" (bar 10 + 90 × `frac` %).
- Time left: from `frac` > 0.04, min(elapsed / frac × (1 − frac), `left`) → "About N s left", "Almost done" at 1 s or less,
  else "Estimating time left" (ms values).
- "Route options checked: `work.evals`"; the current phase "`work.phase` `work.i` of `work.n`" + `work.extra`; `log` = the
  last 4 phases ("Run k | phase", "i of n").

**What the engine is given:**

- The riders on the Plan For `date` who ride the session (AM, PM, or CCA days for ASA).
- Each rider whose PUDO points all belong to **one stop** (from Stop Assignment), grouped by that stop with the stop's
  points the school uses.
- Riders with no stop are listed in `no_stop`; riders with more than one stop are listed in `conflicts`, both as
  `[{ rid, name }]`. Neither goes into the run; the plan lists each of them in `unassigned` (reason `RIDER_NO_STOP` /
  `RIDER_IN_CONFLICT`, `label` = the rider's name). Show "N riders need a stop" / "N riders have more than one stop".
- The current plan of the session, for "Keep Current".
- The company's parameters, the run's `params`, the session, and the school's bus attendant rule.

| Result | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `done`, plan with no routes | No rider of the session has a stop: the run still goes (as the prototype) and every rider is in `unassigned` |
| `failed` with the engine's message | The engine refused, for example no road times |
| `failed` with "The routing service is not available…" | The routing service could not be reached |
| `done` | `plan_id` is the new **draft** plan |

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-routes.md` § 2. Run Routing_

patch.description:
PATCH /school_bills/settings { draft_days, start_rule: prorate|full|half }

Convoy drafts **one bill per payer per billing period**:

- **Parents pay:** one bill per family.
- **The school pays per rider or per bus:** one bill to the school.

Billing periods come from the year's locked Bus Fares: one per term or semester, or one per chosen month.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/bill_runs?academic_year_id=&period_index=&q=` | The Family Bills card. See below |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs` | Draft Now / Draft Again: `{ academic_year_id, period_index }`. Bills already issued stay as they are; every other payer gets a fresh draft. `meta.drafted` = drafts now |
| `POST /schools/:school_id/bill_runs/issue` | Issue: `{ academic_year_id, period_index, bill_ids: [] }`. Leave out `bill_ids` to issue every draft. `meta.issued` = count |
| `PATCH /school_bills/settings` | `{ draft_days, start_rule: prorate \| full \| half }`. These are company-wide and apply to the next drafts |

When `academic_year_id` is left out, the call uses the year covering today that has locked Bus Fares, or else the
latest year with locked Bus Fares. When `period_index` is left out, it uses the first period billed from next month, or
else from this month, or else the last period.

**The card (`data`):**

- `on`: false (with `error`) until the year's Bus Fares are locked.
- `payer`: `family`, `school` or `bus`.
- `periods`: `[{ index, label, month }]`. The label is `"Semester 1 | billed Jan 2027"`, or `"Jan 2027"` for monthly bills.
- `due_on`: the due date of the period's bills.
- `draft_on`: the day Convoy drafts them, `due_on` less `draft_days`.
- `bill_to`: for school bills, `{ managed_client: { id, name } | null, linked }`. A school bill can only be issued when the
  school is linked to a Managed Client. It then carries that client's name and its first Send Invoices To email.
- `run`: the last draft, or `null` before the first one:
  - `drafted_at`, and `by` (`"Convoy"` when the daily job drafted it, with `auto: true`).
  - `label` and `due_on`.
  - `skipped`: the notes on children left out, such as `"Lim Kai: this month is on the first invoice INV-…"` or
    `"…: service stopped 01/10/2026"`.
  - `unlinked`: riders with no family, so not billed. Ask the user to link them in Families & Riders.
- `counts`: `{ bills, drafts, issued, amount }`.
- `can_issue`, and `settings`: `{ draft_days, start_rule }`.
- `rows`: up to 150, drafts first. Each row has:
  - `id`, `status` (`draft` or `issued`), `number`, `bill_to`, `bill_to_code`, `children`.
  - `amount`: before GST for a draft, the total for an issued bill.
  - `part_charges`: how many lines are part charges.
  - `lines: [{ rid, child_name, description, note, amount }]`.
- `more`: the count of rows not shown.

**How a bill is worked out.**

- **The children billed.** Children on the AM / PM route plans in use when the period starts, plus children who join
  before it ends.
- **Each child's fare.**
  - The tier comes from the straight-line distance from the school: add 0.05 km, then round up to 0.1 km. For zones, the
    tier is the first zone whose postal sectors or drawn area hold the home.
  - 2-way, 1-way, or AM / PM fares follow the sessions the child rides.
  - A small bus or a bus-size column applies for the days the child's bus was that size.
  - The bill month's Extra Charges are added.
- **A child who joins mid-period** is charged by the start rule: prorated by school days, the full period, or half from
  the 16th. The line `note` says how, for example `"Joins 01/03/2027, 58 of 98 school days"`.
- **A child who stops** (a Stop Service request, or the rider's end date) pays up to that day. When the policy's refund
  basis is days, this is prorated by school days.
- **A month on a request's first invoice** is skipped.
- **When the school pays per bus,** the bill has one line per bus size (`"3 x LARGE_45 at S$4200.00"`). A further
  `"Route charges and changes during the period"` line covers Route Charges and plan changes within the month.

**Issuing.** Issuing gives the bill its INV number and GST. It also takes off the payer's credit notes that were waiting
for the next bill, each as a line `"Credit from CN-…"` with `credit_note: true`. Parents see their bills in the Convoy
App, and the school sees its bill in the Client Portal (when those apps come).

**Automatic drafting.** A daily job at 01:00 drafts the coming period of every school year with locked Bus Fares, once
`draft_on` has come. It does not draft a period twice.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 1. Family Bills: draft and issue_

get.description:
GET /school_payouts/:id/voucher — the Payment Voucher to print (brand: GET /finance/documents/brand).

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/documents?type=&payer=&q=` | Invoices, credit notes, debit notes, receipts and payment vouchers, newest first (latest 300) |
| `GET /school_documents/:id` | A credit note, debit note or receipt to print |
| `POST /school_documents/:id/void` | `{ reason }`. Only a receipt can be made void. Its payments are voided too, so the bills it paid are owed again |
| `GET /schools/:school_id/statement?payer=` | Statement of Account |

**The list.**

- `type` is `inv`, `cn`, `dn`, `rcp` or `pv`.
- `payer` is `family:<id>`, `school` or `operator:<id>`. A receipt also shows under every payer whose bill it paid.
- Each row has:
  - `type`, `id`, `number`, `date`, `school_id`, `school`, `to`, `amount`.
  - `status`: the bill status; `Applied`, `Refunded` or `To Next Bill` for a credit note; `Issued`; `Received`;
    `Paid`; or `Void`.
  - `tone`.
  - `links`: for example `"Pays INV-…"`, `"For INV-…"`, or `"Paid S$…, RCP-…, CN-…"`.
  - `can_void`.
- `meta` has `counts` (per type, plus `all`), `payers: [{ key, name }]`, `types`, `count` and `shown`.

To open each type:

- An invoice opens with `GET /school_bills/:id`.
- A credit note, debit note or receipt opens with `GET /school_documents/:id`.
- A payment voucher opens with `GET /school_payouts/:id/voucher`.

**A credit note, debit note or receipt (`data`).** Every type has:

- `type`, `title` (`Credit Note`, `Debit Note` or `Official Receipt`), `number`, `date`, `to`, `to_code`, `status`,
  `total`, `reason`, `by`.
- `void`: `{ at, reason, by }`, or null.

A receipt also has `method`, `reference`, `can_void` and `applied: [{ bill_id, number, amount }]`.

A credit or debit note also has:

- `bill`.
- `lines: [{ description, amount }]` and `subtotal`.
- `gst`.
- `credit_use` and `use_text`, for example `"Taken off INV-…"` or `"Will be taken off the next bill"`.
- `refund`.

**Statement (`data`).** It covers every bill issued, debit note, credit taken off a bill, payment, and the late fee to
date, oldest first:

- `payer`, `name`, `as_of`, `balance`.
- `lines: [{ date, details, charge, credit, balance }]`.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 4. Documents and statements_

  - `status`: the bill status; `Applied`, `Refunded` or `To Next Bill` for a credit note; `Issued`; `Received`;
    `Paid`; or `Void`.
  - `tone`.
  - `links`: for example `"Pays INV-…"`, `"For INV-…"`, or `"Paid S$…, RCP-…, CN-…"`.
  - `can_void`.
- `meta` has `counts` (per type, plus `all`), `payers: [{ key, name }]`, `types`, `count` and `shown`.

To open each type:

- An invoice opens with `GET /school_bills/:id`.
- A credit note, debit note or receipt opens with `GET /school_documents/:id`.
- A payment voucher opens with `GET /school_payouts/:id/voucher`.

**A credit note, debit note or receipt (`data`).** Every type has:

- `type`, `title` (`Credit Note`, `Debit Note` or `Official Receipt`), `number`, `date`, `to`, `to_code`, `status`,
  `total`, `reason`, `by`.
- `void`: `{ at, reason, by }`, or null.

A receipt also has `method`, `reference`, `can_void` and `applied: [{ bill_id, number, amount }]`.

A credit or debit note also has:

- `bill`.
- `lines: [{ description, amount }]` and `subtotal`.
- `gst`.
- `credit_use` and `use_text`, for example `"Taken off INV-…"` or `"Will be taken off the next bill"`.
- `refund`.

**Statement (`data`).** It covers every bill issued, debit note, credit taken off a bill, payment, and the late fee to
date, oldest first:

- `payer`, `name`, `as_of`, `balance`.
- `lines: [{ date, details, charge, credit, balance }]`.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-finance.md` § 4. Documents and statements_

post.description:
POST /school_bills/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /school_bills/:id` | The bill (see below) |
| `POST /school_bills/:id/payments` | `{ paid_on, amount, method, reference }`. One receipt; cannot be more than is owed today. `meta.receipt` = its number |
| `POST /school_bills/:id/waive_late` | `{ amount, reason }`. Up to the late fee owed |
| `POST /school_bills/:id/notes` | `{ doc_type: cn \| dn, description, amount, reason, credit_use, issued_on, method, reference }`. `meta.number` |

**Credit and debit notes.**

- A credit note's `credit_use` is one of:
  - `reduce`: taken off this bill. It cannot be more than is owed.
  - `refund`: refunded to the payer. Give `method` and `reference`.
  - `carry`: taken off the payer's next bill when it is issued.
- A debit note adds to the bill.
- The amount is entered before or with GST, as Finance Settings say. The note keeps `subtotal`, `gst` and `total`.

**The bill (`data`)** is the Collections row plus:

- `lines: [{ id, rid, child_name, description, note, amount, credit_note }]`.
- `subtotal`, and `gst` (`{ rate, amount, mode }`, or null).
- `late_fee_raw` (before waivers) and `net`.
- `drafted_at`, `issued_at`, `issued_by`.
- `history`: newest first. Each entry has a `kind`:
  - `payment`: with its receipt, method, reference and source (`console` or `app`).
  - `cn` or `dn`: with `number`, `credit_use` and `reason`.
  - `waiver`.
- `can: { pay, waive_late, notes }`.

For printing, the title is `Tax Invoice` when GST is on, and `Invoice` otherwise.

**First invoices.** Record First Invoice Paid in Bus Service Requests now writes a receipt and a payment the same way.

GET /bus_requests/alerts — the bell and the strip: requests that need someone across the schools the user opens.

The Convoy OS "Requests" banner above Ops Control (School Bus applications) is fed by `GET /bus_requests/alerts`
([school-bus-parents § 6](school-bus-parents.md#6-alerts-and-the-0800-email)).

get.description:
GET /bus_requests/digest — the 08:00 email to School Bus admins as it would go today (recorded, not sent).

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /bus_requests/alerts` | The bell and the strip (Ops Control, School Live Ops): requests that need someone, across the user's schools, most urgent first |
| `GET /bus_requests/digest` | The 08:00 email as it would go today: `{ to: [names], subject, groups: [{ school, rows: [{ who, text, tone }] }] }` |

**Alert items.** Each item has:

- `request_id`, `code`, `child_name`, `level`, `school`.
- `tab`: the Requests tab to open.
- `kind`: `new`, `adr`, `svc`, `stop` or `end`.
- `what`: for example "New bus request", "Answer due", "Renewal", "Change of address", "Leaving" or "Offer lapsed".
- `text`: for example "Acknowledge was due Fri 23/10", or "Moves Mon 16/11. Not opened yet".
- `tone`: `over`, `soon` or `ok`.
- `rank`, `by` and `deadline`.

**Meta.**

- The counts: `count`, `overdue`, `to_acknowledge`, `answers_due`, `changes`, `to_end`.
- `parts[]`, and `text` (the strip subtitle).

**The email** goes to the owner, Admins, and users with the Schools permission who open those schools. It goes at 08:00
only on days with requests waiting. It is recorded in notification emails and not sent until email sending exists.
`GET /bus_requests/digest` is a preview with no sent time: show the prototype's fixed "Sent · Today 08:00" text.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 6. Alerts and the 08:00 email_
