POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/close

**A point's photo:**

```
POST /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo   (multipart: photo = the image to show, with arrows and crop applied by the FE;
                                           photo_original; photo_annotations = JSON of the arrows / crop; photo_credit)
DELETE /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo
```

Both return the point. Use `photo_annotations` with `photo_original` to reopen the editor.

**Photo requests** ask parents or drivers for a photo through the Convoy App. Until the app sends them, the office adds
the photos it received (Add Received Photos).

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stop_photo_requests?status=open\|review\|closed\|all` | The requests with their photos; tabs Open / To Review (requests with photos to review) / Closed, counts in `meta.counts`. To Review overlaps Open: it is the open requests that have a photo waiting (as in the prototype), so the Open count includes them |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests { stop_point_id, audience, school_rider_id, max_submissions }` | Ask for Photos (`404` for a point of an archived stop: an archived stop is out of the library) |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/close` | Close Request → the request |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/reopen` | Reopen a closed request → the request (`422` "Already at the max photos. Raise the max or reject some first") |
| `DELETE /stop_photo_requests/:id` | **Remove** a closed request with its photos (`204`). A photo already accepted stays the point's photo. Before 04/11/2026 this call closed the request: use `/close` for that |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/submissions` (multipart `photos[]`, `submitted_by_name`, `role: parent\|driver`, `street_view_url`) | Add Received Photos (office): up to 3 photos → `201` the request + `meta { added, closed }` |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/accept` | Accept a photo |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/reject` | Reject a photo |
| `PUT /stop_photo_requests/auto { driver, parent }` | Automatic requests on / off. Returns how many requests changed |

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 4, "stop_id": 12, "stop_point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "stop_name": "…", "audience": "both",
              "parent_of": null, "max_submissions": 4, "status": "open", "auto": false, "created_by": "…", "created_at": "…", "live": 2,
              "submissions": [ { "id": 7, "by": "Mrs Tan Mei Ling", "role": "parent", "status": "pending", "submitted_at": "…",
                                 "street_view_url": null, "source": "app", "n": null, "of": null, "annotations": null,
                                 "photo": { "url": "…", "thumb_url": "…" } } ] } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "open": 3, "review": 1, "closed": 2 }, "pending_photos": 2, "auto": { "driver": false, "parent": false } } }
```

- `meta.pending_photos` is the badge on the photo-requests button.
- `live` counts photos that are not rejected.
- A photo: `source` is `app` or `office` (Add Received Photos); `n` of `of` = "photo n of m" of the photos added together.

**Add Received Photos** (open requests only): the first 3 `photos[]` are added as pending photos, until the request's
max; when the max is reached the request closes. Toast: "N photo(s) received", plus ". Max reached, request closed" when
`meta.closed`. `422`: "This request is closed", "Enter who sent it", "Choose the photos". Defaults on the form (front end):
Sent By "Driver" for a driver request, else "Parent of <rider>" / "Parent"; Role from the audience.

**Ask for Photos:**

- `audience` is `parents` (parents at the stop), `driver`, `both`, or `parent` with `rid` (the `rid` of Stop Assignment, looked up among the schools that use the point's stop) or `school_rider_id` (one parent). Unknown `rid` → 404.
- `max_submissions` is 1–12; the default is 6.
- Each point has one open request: "BDSZ03-0001A already has an open photo request".

**Accept:**

- Optional multipart `photo` is the edited image, and `annotations` is the JSON of the arrows.
- The photo becomes the point's photo, credited "Name (role)". The original is kept.
- The point keeps its Street View link, or takes the photo's link when it has none.
- Any photo accepted earlier goes back to pending.

**Automatic requests:** points of stops that schools use and that have no photo get an open request (driver, parents or
both). When turned off, automatic requests nobody answered are removed.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 5. Photos and photo requests_

POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/submissions (multipart photos[] up to 3, submitted_by_name, role: parent|driver, street_view_url)

**A point's photo:**

```
POST /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo   (multipart: photo = the image to show, with arrows and crop applied by the FE;
                                           photo_original; photo_annotations = JSON of the arrows / crop; photo_credit)
DELETE /stops/:id/points/:point_id/photo
```

Both return the point. Use `photo_annotations` with `photo_original` to reopen the editor.

**Photo requests** ask parents or drivers for a photo through the Convoy App. Until the app sends them, the office adds
the photos it received (Add Received Photos).

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stop_photo_requests?status=open\|review\|closed\|all` | The requests with their photos; tabs Open / To Review (requests with photos to review) / Closed, counts in `meta.counts`. To Review overlaps Open: it is the open requests that have a photo waiting (as in the prototype), so the Open count includes them |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests { stop_point_id, audience, school_rider_id, max_submissions }` | Ask for Photos (`404` for a point of an archived stop: an archived stop is out of the library) |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/close` | Close Request → the request |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/reopen` | Reopen a closed request → the request (`422` "Already at the max photos. Raise the max or reject some first") |
| `DELETE /stop_photo_requests/:id` | **Remove** a closed request with its photos (`204`). A photo already accepted stays the point's photo. Before 04/11/2026 this call closed the request: use `/close` for that |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/:id/submissions` (multipart `photos[]`, `submitted_by_name`, `role: parent\|driver`, `street_view_url`) | Add Received Photos (office): up to 3 photos → `201` the request + `meta { added, closed }` |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/accept` | Accept a photo |
| `POST /stop_photo_requests/submissions/:id/reject` | Reject a photo |
| `PUT /stop_photo_requests/auto { driver, parent }` | Automatic requests on / off. Returns how many requests changed |

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 4, "stop_id": 12, "stop_point_id": 31, "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "stop_name": "…", "audience": "both",
              "parent_of": null, "max_submissions": 4, "status": "open", "auto": false, "created_by": "…", "created_at": "…", "live": 2,
              "submissions": [ { "id": 7, "by": "Mrs Tan Mei Ling", "role": "parent", "status": "pending", "submitted_at": "…",
                                 "street_view_url": null, "source": "app", "n": null, "of": null, "annotations": null,
                                 "photo": { "url": "…", "thumb_url": "…" } } ] } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "open": 3, "review": 1, "closed": 2 }, "pending_photos": 2, "auto": { "driver": false, "parent": false } } }
```

- `meta.pending_photos` is the badge on the photo-requests button.
- `live` counts photos that are not rejected.
- A photo: `source` is `app` or `office` (Add Received Photos); `n` of `of` = "photo n of m" of the photos added together.

**Add Received Photos** (open requests only): the first 3 `photos[]` are added as pending photos, until the request's
max; when the max is reached the request closes. Toast: "N photo(s) received", plus ". Max reached, request closed" when
`meta.closed`. `422`: "This request is closed", "Enter who sent it", "Choose the photos". Defaults on the form (front end):
Sent By "Driver" for a driver request, else "Parent of <rider>" / "Parent"; Role from the audience.

**Ask for Photos:**

- `audience` is `parents` (parents at the stop), `driver`, `both`, or `parent` with `rid` (the `rid` of Stop Assignment, looked up among the schools that use the point's stop) or `school_rider_id` (one parent). Unknown `rid` → 404.
- `max_submissions` is 1–12; the default is 6.
- Each point has one open request: "BDSZ03-0001A already has an open photo request".

**Accept:**

- Optional multipart `photo` is the edited image, and `annotations` is the JSON of the arrows.
- The photo becomes the point's photo, credited "Name (role)". The original is kept.
- The point keeps its Street View link, or takes the photo's link when it has none.
- Any photo accepted earlier goes back to pending.

**Automatic requests:** points of stops that schools use and that have no photo get an open request (driver, parents or
both). When turned off, automatic requests nobody answered are removed.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 5. Photos and photo requests_

get.description:
GET /stops/nearby?lat=&lng=&school_id= — library stops within 600 m that the school does not use yet.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /stops?school_id=&q=&status=&not_linked=1&page=&limit=` | The list. With `school_id`, the stops as that school sees them; without it, the whole company library |
| `GET /stops/:id?school_id=` | One stop with the schools that use it and the coverage table |
| `POST /stops` | Add a stop |
| `PATCH /stops/:id` | Change a stop |
| `DELETE /stops/:id` | Archive |
| `GET /stops/nearby?lat=&lng=&school_id=` | "Nearby in Library": stops within 600 m that the school does not use yet, nearest first, with `metres` |

List parameters:

- `q` matches the stop name, the Stop ID, a PUDO ID (such as `0001c`) or an old ID; not postal codes (the prototype's
  search box is "Search name, Stop ID, PUDO ID or old ID").
- Paged as every list ([README § Responses](../README.md#responses)): `meta { page, limit, count, pages }`;
  each row carries its `subzone { code, name, planning_area }` (so do `GET /schools/:id/stops` and the `PUT` answer); default 50, `limit` up to 500.
- `status` is `approved`, `school` or `pending`.
- `not_linked=1` (with `school_id`) gives the stops that school does not use yet ("Browse Library").

```json
{ "id": 12, "code": "BDSZ03-0001", "name": "Blk 101 Bedok North", "subzone_code": "BDSZ03",
  "subzone": { "code": "BDSZ03", "name": "Bedok North", "planning_area": "Bedok" },
  "library_status": "approved", "owner_school": null, "requested_by": null, "requested_at": null, "former_codes": [],
  "points": [ { "id": 31, "suffix": "A", "pudo_code": "BDSZ03-0001A", "description": "Bus bay beside Blk 101", "usage": "both",
                "sizes": ["S", "M", "L"], "primary": true, "lat": 1.3304, "lng": 103.9203, "subzone_code": "BDSZ03",
                "street_view_url": "https://www.google.com/maps/@…", "photo": { "url": "…", "thumb_url": "…", … } | null,
                "photo_original": {…} | null, "photo_annotations": [...] | null, "photo_credit": "Mrs Tan (parent)" | null } ],
  "used_by": 2, "linked": true, "needs_attention": false, "coverage_warnings": [], "archived": false }
```

- `linked` is only set when `school_id` is given.
- `used_by` is the number of schools using the stop: "used by N schools".
- `needs_attention` is true when the stop has no point, or the coverage has a gap ("Size gap" badge).

`GET /stops/:id` adds two fields:

```json
"coverage": [ { "usage": "pickup", "sizes": { "S": ["A"], "M": ["A"], "L": [] }, "any": true },
              { "usage": "dropoff", "sizes": { … }, "any": true } ],
"schools": [ { "id": 3, "name": "St. Stephen's School", "riders": 12 } ]
```

In `coverage`, each cell lists the point letters that serve that size; an empty list is a gap. `coverage_warnings` holds
messages such as "No point serves Large buses for pick-up".

**Add / change a stop:**

```
POST /stops   { stop: { name, points: [{ description, usage: pickup|dropoff|both, sizes: ["S","M","L"], primary, lat, lng, street_view_url }] },
                school_id, in_library }
PATCH /stops/:id { stop: { name, points: [{ id, … }] }, school_id, confirmed }
```

- Send the whole list of points. A point with `id` is changed. A point without `id` is new and gets the next free
  letter. A point left out is removed (retired).
- Exactly one point is primary. If none is marked, the first point is.
- `street_view_url` must be a Google Maps link.
- On the Library page, send no `school_id` (or `in_library: true`). The stop is then `approved`.
- From a school's screen, send `school_id` and `in_library: false`. The stop belongs to that school
  (`library_status: "school"`) and is linked to it. Then ask "Add to the Stop Library?" (§2).

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Enter a stop name" | No name |
| "Add at least one PUDO point" | No points |
| "Point A needs at least one bus size" | A point has no size |
| "Stops with postal codes or areas need both pick-up and drop-off points" | A school has a catchment on the stop |
| "No URA subzone found for Point A. Move it inside Singapore" | The new stop's primary point is outside every subzone |

**Changing a stop other schools use.** When points of a stop that other schools use are moved, added or removed, or
their use or sizes change, the API answers 422 with `code: "confirm_required"`:

```json
{ "error": { "code": "confirm_required", "message": "BDSZ03-0001 is used by other schools. Confirm to change it for them too",
             "details": { "schools": [ { "id": 5, "name": "Opera Estate Primary", "riders": 8 } ] } } }
```

Show the dialog with those schools and their riders, then send the same request again with `confirmed: true`. Every
school using the stop gets its "Stops changed since routing" time updated (`stops_changed_at`, §3).

**Archive:** `DELETE /stops/:id` works only when no school uses the stop ("Unlink BDSZ03-0001 from every school first"). It answers `200 { data: { unassigned: n } }`: riders still assigned to the stop's points (left by an older unlink) are unassigned in the same transaction.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-stops.md` § 1. Stops (Stop Library)_

get.description:
GET /academic_years/:academic_year_id/fares/copy?from_id= — another year's table as a draft (not saved, no ids).

There is one fare table per academic year. It needs that year's **Terms & Semesters locked** first.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares` | The table, its billing periods, the worked-out fares and the bus types |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/fares` | Save & Lock the whole table, as the wizard's Review step sends it (JSON) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/fares/preview` | A draft table worked out before saving: its bills, fares and the first failing check. Nothing is saved. |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares/copy?from_id=` | "Copy AY X Fares": another year's table as a draft, without ids. Nothing is saved. |

`GET` returns:

```json
{ "table": { …the table, same shape as the PATCH body below; tiers and surcharges also carry their "id"… } | null,
  "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" } | null, "calendar_locked": true,
  "periods": [ { "label": "Term 1", "short": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2026-01-02", "ends_on": "2026-03-13", "school_days": 50, "cca_days": 50 } ],
  "fares": [ …see §2… ],
  "bus_types": [ { "key": "SMALL_13", "label": "13-seater", "seats": 13, "student_seats": 12 } ],
  "plan_runs": { "LARGE_40": 3, "SMALL_13": 2 } }
```

- `bus_types[].student_seats` = `seats` less 1 when the school's Bus Attendants setting needs an attendant on that
  size (the attendant takes a seat). Bus Rates shows "45 seats, 44 for students" and the price per student seat.
- `plan_runs` counts the routes per bus type in the AM and PM route plans in use today (an AM and a PM run count as 2).
  Bus Rates "From Route Plans" shows "3 runs in the route plans" or "Not in the route plans". Routes without a bus
  type are left out.

The PATCH body is the whole table. Send only the parts that apply:

```json
{ "payer": "parents" | "school" | "bus",
  "bill_to": { "name": "SSS Finance", "contact": "…", "email": "fin@sss.edu.sg" },
  "basis": "distance" | "zone",
  "trip": "both" | "one" | "ampm",
  "cycle": "period" | "month", "months": [1, 2, 3],
  "distribution": "equal" | "prorated" | "bill" | "billpro" | "custom",
  "one_way": { "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 60 },
  "by_size": false, "size_columns": [ { "max_seats": 15 }, { "max_seats": null } ],
  "tiers": [ { "id": 31, "max_km": 3, "name": null, "sectors": ["45", "46"],
               "areas": [ { "latlngs": [[1.35, 103.94], [1.36, 103.95], [1.34, 103.96]], "exclude": false } ],
               "fare": 1680, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [],
               "small_fare": null, "express_fare": null, "cca_fare": null,
               "sizes": [ { "fare": 1800, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [] } ] } ],
  "surcharges": [ { "id": 7, "name": "Sentosa", "sectors": ["09"], "areas": [], "kind": "flat" | "pct" | "fixed", "amount": 200,
                    "one_way_kind": "same" | "pct" | "fixed", "one_way_value": null } ],
  "small": { "on": true, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 10, "seats": 15 },
  "express": { "on": false, "type": "pct", "value": null },
  "cca": { "on": true, "per": "trip" | "period", "price": "fixed" | "tier", "fixed": 8, "split": "equal" | "days", "with_services": false,
           "riders": { "non": { "on": false, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "fixed", "amount": null }, "am": {…}, "pm": {…} } },
  "bus_count": "plan" | "booked",
  "bus_rates": [ { "bus_type": "SMALL_13", "rate": 1500, "booked_runs": null } ] }
```

**Who pays (`payer`)**

| `payer` | Meaning | Extra fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parents` | Each family is billed | — |
| `school` | The school pays per rider | `bill_to` (name and email) |
| `bus` | The school pays per bus | `bill_to`, plus `bus_rates` (a rate per bill for each bus size) and `bus_count` (by the plan, or `booked` runs) |

The wizard's steps for `bus` are Who Pays, Billing, Bus Rates and Review.

**How the fares are set (`payer: parents` or `school`)**

| Field | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `basis` | `distance`: `tiers` by `max_km`, in increasing order; the last tier is open-ended. `zone`: each tier has a `name`, postal `sectors` (first 2 digits) and/or drawn `areas`; the first matching zone applies. |
| `trip` | `both`: one 2-way fare plus a 1-way rule. `one`: 1-way only. `ampm`: AM and PM fares, where 2-way = AM + PM. |
| `cycle` | `period`: one bill per term or semester. `month`: one bill per month listed in `months`, where 1 = January. |
| `distribution` | How the annual fare is spread over the bills (table below) |
| `one_way.type` | `pct`: % of the 2-way fare. `flat`: amount off the 2-way fare. `custom`: each tier's `one_way_fare`. |
| `by_size` | Adds price columns by bus size (`size_columns`). The first column uses the tier's own fares; each tier's `sizes[k]` holds the prices for column k + 2. |
| `small`, `express` | `pct` / `flat` extra on the standard fare, or `custom`, which uses each tier's `small_fare` / `express_fare` |
| `cca` | Optional CCA / ASA fares; see the wizard |

`distribution` values:

| `distribution` | Bill amounts |
| --- | --- |
| `equal` | The annual fare split evenly over the bills |
| `prorated` | The annual fare split by each bill's school days |
| `bill` | `fare` is the amount of every bill |
| `billpro` | `fare` per bill, scaled by the bill's school days against the average |
| `custom` | Each bill is typed in: `period_fares`, plus `period_pm_fares` when `trip` is `ampm` |

`sectors` may be sent as an array or as text such as `"45, 46"`.

**Drawn areas (`areas`).** Zones and location surcharges can have several outlines drawn on the map, like a stop's
catchment: `areas: [{ latlngs: [[lat, lng], …], exclude }]`. A home counts when it is inside an outline with
`exclude: false` and inside no outline with `exclude: true` (a cut-out). An area needs at least 3 corners ("Zone 1: area 1
needs at least 3 corners"); cut-outs alone do not count as a drawn area. The old single `area` field is gone: sending it

There is one fare table per academic year. It needs that year's **Terms & Semesters locked** first.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares` | The table, its billing periods, the worked-out fares and the bus types |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/fares` | Save & Lock the whole table, as the wizard's Review step sends it (JSON) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/fares/preview` | A draft table worked out before saving: its bills, fares and the first failing check. Nothing is saved. |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/fares/copy?from_id=` | "Copy AY X Fares": another year's table as a draft, without ids. Nothing is saved. |

`GET` returns:

```json
{ "table": { …the table, same shape as the PATCH body below; tiers and surcharges also carry their "id"… } | null,
  "locked": { "at": "…", "by": "…" } | null, "calendar_locked": true,
  "periods": [ { "label": "Term 1", "short": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2026-01-02", "ends_on": "2026-03-13", "school_days": 50, "cca_days": 50 } ],
  "fares": [ …see §2… ],
  "bus_types": [ { "key": "SMALL_13", "label": "13-seater", "seats": 13, "student_seats": 12 } ],
  "plan_runs": { "LARGE_40": 3, "SMALL_13": 2 } }
```

- `bus_types[].student_seats` = `seats` less 1 when the school's Bus Attendants setting needs an attendant on that
  size (the attendant takes a seat). Bus Rates shows "45 seats, 44 for students" and the price per student seat.
- `plan_runs` counts the routes per bus type in the AM and PM route plans in use today (an AM and a PM run count as 2).
  Bus Rates "From Route Plans" shows "3 runs in the route plans" or "Not in the route plans". Routes without a bus
  type are left out.

The PATCH body is the whole table. Send only the parts that apply:

```json

  "bill_to": { "name": "SSS Finance", "contact": "…", "email": "fin@sss.edu.sg" },
  "basis": "distance" | "zone",
  "trip": "both" | "one" | "ampm",
  "cycle": "period" | "month", "months": [1, 2, 3],
  "distribution": "equal" | "prorated" | "bill" | "billpro" | "custom",
  "one_way": { "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 60 },
  "by_size": false, "size_columns": [ { "max_seats": 15 }, { "max_seats": null } ],
  "tiers": [ { "id": 31, "max_km": 3, "name": null, "sectors": ["45", "46"],
               "areas": [ { "latlngs": [[1.35, 103.94], [1.36, 103.95], [1.34, 103.96]], "exclude": false } ],
               "fare": 1680, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [],
               "small_fare": null, "express_fare": null, "cca_fare": null,
               "sizes": [ { "fare": 1800, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [] } ] } ],
  "surcharges": [ { "id": 7, "name": "Sentosa", "sectors": ["09"], "areas": [], "kind": "flat" | "pct" | "fixed", "amount": 200,
                    "one_way_kind": "same" | "pct" | "fixed", "one_way_value": null } ],
  "small": { "on": true, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 10, "seats": 15 },
  "express": { "on": false, "type": "pct", "value": null },
  "cca": { "on": true, "per": "trip" | "period", "price": "fixed" | "tier", "fixed": 8, "split": "equal" | "days", "with_services": false,
           "riders": { "non": { "on": false, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "fixed", "amount": null }, "am": {…}, "pm": {…} } },
  "bus_count": "plan" | "booked",
```

```json
  "bill_to": { "name": "SSS Finance", "contact": "…", "email": "fin@sss.edu.sg" },
  "basis": "distance" | "zone",
  "trip": "both" | "one" | "ampm",
  "cycle": "period" | "month", "months": [1, 2, 3],
  "distribution": "equal" | "prorated" | "bill" | "billpro" | "custom",
  "one_way": { "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 60 },
  "by_size": false, "size_columns": [ { "max_seats": 15 }, { "max_seats": null } ],
  "tiers": [ { "id": 31, "max_km": 3, "name": null, "sectors": ["45", "46"],
               "areas": [ { "latlngs": [[1.35, 103.94], [1.36, 103.95], [1.34, 103.96]], "exclude": false } ],
               "fare": 1680, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [],
               "small_fare": null, "express_fare": null, "cca_fare": null,
               "sizes": [ { "fare": 1800, "pm_fare": null, "one_way_fare": null, "period_fares": [], "period_pm_fares": [] } ] } ],
  "surcharges": [ { "id": 7, "name": "Sentosa", "sectors": ["09"], "areas": [], "kind": "flat" | "pct" | "fixed", "amount": 200,
                    "one_way_kind": "same" | "pct" | "fixed", "one_way_value": null } ],
  "small": { "on": true, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "custom", "value": 10, "seats": 15 },
  "express": { "on": false, "type": "pct", "value": null },
  "cca": { "on": true, "per": "trip" | "period", "price": "fixed" | "tier", "fixed": 8, "split": "equal" | "days", "with_services": false,
           "riders": { "non": { "on": false, "type": "pct" | "flat" | "fixed", "amount": null }, "am": {…}, "pm": {…} } },
  "bus_count": "plan" | "booked",
  "bus_rates": [ { "bus_type": "SMALL_13", "rate": 1500, "booked_runs": null } ] }
```

**Who pays (`payer`)**

| `payer` | Meaning | Extra fields |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `parents` | Each family is billed | — |
| `school` | The school pays per rider | `bill_to` (name and email) |
| `bus` | The school pays per bus | `bill_to`, plus `bus_rates` (a rate per bill for each bus size) and `bus_count` (by the plan, or `booked` runs) |

The wizard's steps for `bus` are Who Pays, Billing, Bus Rates and Review.

**How the fares are set (`payer: parents` or `school`)**

| Field | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `basis` | `distance`: `tiers` by `max_km`, in increasing order; the last tier is open-ended. `zone`: each tier has a `name`, postal `sectors` (first 2 digits) and/or drawn `areas`; the first matching zone applies. |
| `trip` | `both`: one 2-way fare plus a 1-way rule. `one`: 1-way only. `ampm`: AM and PM fares, where 2-way = AM + PM. |
| `cycle` | `period`: one bill per term or semester. `month`: one bill per month listed in `months`, where 1 = January. |
| `distribution` | How the annual fare is spread over the bills (table below) |
| `one_way.type` | `pct`: % of the 2-way fare. `flat`: amount off the 2-way fare. `custom`: each tier's `one_way_fare`. |
| `by_size` | Adds price columns by bus size (`size_columns`). The first column uses the tier's own fares; each tier's `sizes[k]` holds the prices for column k + 2. |
| `small`, `express` | `pct` / `flat` extra on the standard fare, or `custom`, which uses each tier's `small_fare` / `express_fare` |
| `cca` | Optional CCA / ASA fares; see the wizard |

`distribution` values:

| `distribution` | Bill amounts |
| --- | --- |
| `equal` | The annual fare split evenly over the bills |
| `prorated` | The annual fare split by each bill's school days |
| `bill` | `fare` is the amount of every bill |
| `billpro` | `fare` per bill, scaled by the bill's school days against the average |
| `custom` | Each bill is typed in: `period_fares`, plus `period_pm_fares` when `trip` is `ampm` |

`sectors` may be sent as an array or as text such as `"45, 46"`.

**Drawn areas (`areas`).** Zones and location surcharges can have several outlines drawn on the map, like a stop's
catchment: `areas: [{ latlngs: [[lat, lng], …], exclude }]`. A home counts when it is inside an outline with
`exclude: false` and inside no outline with `exclude: true` (a cut-out). An area needs at least 3 corners ("Zone 1: area 1
needs at least 3 corners"); cut-outs alone do not count as a drawn area. The old single `area` field is gone: sending it
is a 422 "area is replaced by areas: [{ latlngs, exclude }]".

**Ids (`id`).** Send back each tier's and surcharge's `id` from `GET`. Save & Lock keeps those rows (and their ids) and
updates them; rows without an id (or with an id of another table) are added; rows left out are removed. Extra Charges
point at tier ids, so they keep working after unlock + save. A tier an Extra Charge targets cannot be removed: 422
"Tier 2 is used by the Extra Charge "Toll". Keep it, or remove it from that charge first" (zones use their name).
"Copy AY X Fares" returns the other year's table without ids, so saving it adds new rows.

**Checks (422).** The error messages are the wizard's, step by step. `error.details` names the wizard step to go back to:
`{ "step": 2, "step_name": "Fares" }`. `step` is the prototype's step index: 0 Who Pays, 1 Billing, 2 Fares (Bus Rates when
the school pays per bus), 3 Services, 4 CCA / ASA. Errors raised before the checks ("Before saving" below, areas,
removed tiers) have no `details`. Examples:

| Step | Example message |
| --- | --- |
| Who Pays | "Enter who the school bill goes to", "Enter a billing email for the school" |
| Billing | "Pick at least one billing month", "Enter the 1-way fare percentage", "The 1-way percentage cannot be more than 100" |
| Fares | "Tier 2 must end further out than tier 1", "Above 3 km: enter the 2-way fare", "Zone 1 needs a name" |
| Bus sizes | "Size column 2 must have a higher seat limit than the one before" |
| Surcharges | "Sentosa: enter the surcharge amount" |
| Services | "Small Bus: enter the extra percentage" |
| CCA / ASA | "CCA / ASA: enter the fare" |
| Bus Rates | "13-seater: enter a rate above 0", "Enter how many runs the school booked" |
| Before saving | "Save and lock the Terms & Semesters first", "Bus Fares is locked. Unlock to edit" |

**Preview of a draft (`POST /academic_years/:id/fares/preview`).** Send the wizard's draft (same body as `PATCH`, any
step,...

post.description:
POST /academic_years/:academic_year_id/extra_charges/:id/end { to_month } — last month to charge.

Extra Charges are added on top of a **locked** fare table, such as a fuel surcharge. Adding one does not unlock the table.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | This year's charges, then the ones carried over from earlier years |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | Add a charge |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Edit (Scheduled only) |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Delete (Scheduled only) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id/end { to_month }` | Set End (Active and not one-off): the last month charged |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/preview` | The next 4 bills before and after the draft charge |

The add and edit body is `{ name, kind: pct|amt|once, value, from_month: "2027-01", to_month, tier_ids: [], bus_types: [], note }`.

```json
{ "id": 4, "name": "Fuel Surcharge", "kind": "pct", "value": "5.00", "from_month": "2026-12", "to_month": null,
  "tier_ids": [], "bus_types": [], "note": "…", "state": "scheduled", "created_by": "Ops Admin", "created_at": "…",
  "carried_from": null, "can_edit": true, "can_delete": true, "can_end": false }
```

**How a charge works**

| `kind` | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `pct` | Adds a % of the fare to every bill |
| `amt` | Adds an amount to every bill |
| `once` | Adds an amount to the one bill raised in `from_month` |

- Every bill is raised in the month of its term start, or in its chosen month.
- `to_month: null` means no end. Such a charge carries into later academic years, where it shows with `carried_from` set
  to the year it came from. It is read only there.
- `tier_ids` lists the tiers / zones it applies to (ids from `table.tiers[].id`); when the school pays per bus,
  `bus_types` lists the bus sizes instead (sizes with a rate). Both empty = all riders. `targets` is gone: sending it is
  a 422 "targets is replaced by tier_ids and bus_types".
- The checks follow the form, in this order: "Give the charge a name", "Enter an amount above 0", "Percentage must be 100
  or less", "Pick the start month", "Bills before this month are already raised. Pick this month or later", "No bill is
  raised in that month" (one-off charge), "End month must be on or after the start month". Then the targets: "Pick
  tiers of this year's Bus Fares" (or zones), "Pick bus sizes only when the school pays per bus", "The school pays per
  bus. Pick bus sizes, not tiers", "Pick bus sizes the fares have a rate for".

**States and messages**

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `state` | `scheduled` (not started), `active`, or `ended` |
| `meta.warning` (on save, not one-off) | "No AY 2027 bills fall between February 2027 and May 2027", or with no end "No AY 2027 bills fall from February 2027 to the end of the year. It starts on AY bills of later years" |

The preview body is the draft charge. Add `id` when editing, so the old version of that charge is left out. It shows the
first picked tier / bus size (or the first of the table). The response:

```json
{ "data": [ { "bill": "Term 1", "before": "420.00", "after": "441.00", "change": "21.00" } ],
  "meta": { "example": "0 to 3 km, 2-way rider" } }
```

`meta.example` is the line above the table ("Example: 0 to 3 km, 2-way rider").

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-money.md` § 3. Extra Charges_

Extra Charges are added on top of a **locked** fare table, such as a fuel surcharge. Adding one does not unlock the table.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | This year's charges, then the ones carried over from earlier years |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges` | Add a charge |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Edit (Scheduled only) |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id` | Delete (Scheduled only) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/:charge_id/end { to_month }` | Set End (Active and not one-off): the last month charged |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/extra_charges/preview` | The next 4 bills before and after the draft charge |

The add and edit body is `{ name, kind: pct|amt|once, value, from_month: "2027-01", to_month, tier_ids: [], bus_types: [], note }`.

```json
{ "id": 4, "name": "Fuel Surcharge", "kind": "pct", "value": "5.00", "from_month": "2026-12", "to_month": null,
  "tier_ids": [], "bus_types": [], "note": "…", "state": "scheduled", "created_by": "Ops Admin", "created_at": "…",
```

put.description:
PUT /academic_years/:academic_year_id/sessions { sessions: [{ name, direction, cca, service, max_journey_minutes, days,
  arrive_from, arrive_to, dismissal, depart, notes, variants: [{ days, arrive_from, arrive_to, dismissal, depart }] }] }

Bus Sessions belong to an academic year and need that year's calendar to be locked.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/sessions` | `data` = the sessions; `meta.locked` and `meta.calendar_locked` |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/sessions/copy?from_id=` | "Copy AY X Sessions": another year's sessions as a draft (not saved); days that are not operating days are dropped |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/sessions { sessions: [...] }` | Save & Lock (send JSON) |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "sessions" }` | Unlock |

```json
{ "position": 2, "name": "PM Departure", "direction": "to_home", "cca": false, "service": "d2d", "max_journey_minutes": 60,
  "days": [1,2,3,4,5], "arrive_from": "14:00", "arrive_to": "15:00", "dismissal": "13:30", "depart": "13:45", "notes": null,
  "variants": [ { "days": [3], "arrive_from": "12:30", "arrive_to": "13:30", "dismissal": "12:00", "depart": "12:15" } ] }
```

The add buttons create these defaults:

| Button | `direction` | `service` | `cca` | Default name |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Add To School | `to_school` | `d2d` | false | "AM Arrival" |
| Add To Home | `to_home` | `d2d` | false | "PM Departure" |
| Add CCA/ASA | `to_home` | `p2p` | true | — |

`max_journey_minutes` defaults to 60.

Rules (422 messages name the session):

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Save and lock the Terms & Semesters first" | The year's calendar is not locked |
| "Add at least one session" | Empty list |
| "Session names must be different" | Duplicate names |
| "pick at least one day" / "pick operating days only" | Bad `days` |
| "set the arrival window" / "the arrival window must end after it starts" | Bad arrival window |
| "set the dismissal and departure times" | To-home session without them |
| "departure must be at or after dismissal" | `depart` before `dismissal` |
| "arrival home cannot start before departure" | `arrive_from` before `depart` |
| "Different Timing N: pick days the session runs" | Variant uses days outside the session |
| "Different Timing N: a day is in two timings" | Two variants share a day |

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 6. Bus Sessions_

post.description:
POST /academic_years/:academic_year_id/registration/schedule { …settings }

There is one registration per school academic year.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /academic_years/:id/registration` | The settings. Before a save, these are the defaults (`saved: false`) |
| `PATCH /academic_years/:id/registration` | Save Draft, or Save Changes once scheduled |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/registration/schedule` | Save and schedule. Takes the same body |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/registration/unschedule` | Back to draft: messages stop and the form closes to parents |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/registration/release` | Release Now for a message sent by hand: `{ key: "wel" }` |

**Body fields (all optional).**

- **Dates.** `renew_from`, `renew_to` (renewals only), `general_from`, `general_to` (everyone), `service_starts_on`.
- **Timings.** `confirm_hours` (to pay after acceptance), `ack_days`, `plan_weeks` (mid-year reply times).
- **Who can apply.** `levels[]` (School Levels names; empty means all), `sessions[]` (`AM`, `PM`, `CCA`).
- **Graduating message.** `grad_on`, `grad_message`, `grad_link`.
- **Auto-accept rules.**
  - Renewals: `auto_renew`, with the checks `renew_check_address`, `renew_check_session`, `renew_check_debt`.
  - New families nearby: `auto_near`, `near_km`, `near_needs_cover`.
  - Siblings: `auto_siblings`, `siblings_need_cover`.
  - When to run: `run_mode` (`arrive` or `daily`), `run_at` (`"HH:MM"`).
  - Seats and waitlist: `seats_buffer`, `waitlist_auto`.
- **Fees.** `show_fare`, `extra_terms`.
- **Form questions.** `asks[]`, from `cls sidn dob med photo emerg cca`.
- **Messages.** `messages[]`: `{ key, enabled, email, whatsapp, app, offset_days, offset_hours, subject, body, whatsapp_body, scheduled }`.

**Defaults.** These count from the year's first school day S:

- Renewals: S−122 to S−79.
- Everyone: S−78 to S+242.
- Confirm hours: 48. Mid-year reply times: 3 and 3. Sessions: AM, PM, CCA.

**Errors (422).**

- The Convoy OS checks: `Enter every date in Schedule`, `The early window must end after it starts`,
  `The general window must open after the early window closes`, `Pick at least one session`, and so on.
- Schedule also needs Terms & Semesters, Bus Sessions and Bus Fares locked, and a Payment & Refund Policy in use.
  Otherwise it returns `code: "not_ready"`, `details.missing`, and the message `Finish Bus Fares, … before scheduling`.

**Response.** It includes:

- `status` (`draft` or `scheduled`) and `state`: `draft`, `upcoming`, `renewals_open`, `general_upcoming`, `open` or `closed`.
- `ready[]`: the steps Schedule needs, `[{ "id": "calendar", "label": "Terms & Semesters", "ok": true }, { "id": "sessions", "label": "Bus Sessions", "ok": true },
  { "id": "fares", "label": "Bus Fares", "ok": false }, { "id": "policy", "label": "Payment & Refund Policy", "ok": true }]`.
- `final_levels`: names of the school's graduating levels (e.g. `["P6"]`), `school_levels`: every level name in order
  (`levels[]` in the body takes these names).
- `policy`: the version, the registration fee, the deposit and the agreement text.
- `messages[]`, with these fields per message:
  - `name`, `audience`.
  - `anchor`: one of `eF`, `eT`, `gF` or `start`.
  - `event`.
  - `adjustable`, `manual`.
  - `sends_on`: the date it goes at 09:00. It is null for messages that follow an event, or that wait for Release Now.

**Messages.** There are 12, in this order: `inv`, `grad`, `rem`, `last`, `open`, `recv`, `offer`, `crem`, `wl`, `lapse`,
`rej`, `wel`. Their texts start from `config/presets/registration_messages.yml`. Timing rules:

- Only `adjustable` timings can change.
- Days keep the preset's side: before or after its anchor.
- `wel` waits for Release Now unless `scheduled: true`.
- Messages are recorded only. Nothing is sent yet.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-parents.md` § 2. Bus Service Registration_

put.description:
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure, period_count, cca_same_as_terms,
  terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }

An academic year runs for 12 months from its start month.

- Its `key` is `"2026"` when it starts in January, otherwise `"2026/27"`.
- Its calendar has operating days and either 2 Semesters or 3–4 Terms.
- Each term has a CCA / ASA period: the term's own dates when `cca_same_as_terms`, otherwise its own dates.
- A **school day** is an operating day, inside a term, and not a holiday.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/academic_years` | The years, oldest first (the year selector) |
| `POST /schools/:id/academic_years { start_year, start_month, copy_from_id }` | New Academic Year (see below) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id` | One year with its terms, holidays and special days |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

`GET /academic_years/:id`:

```json
{ "id": 5, "key": "2027", "start_year": 2027, "start_month": 1, "starts_on": "2027-01-01", "ends_on": "2027-12-31",
  "structure": "term", "period_count": 4, "period_label": "Term", "operating_days": [1,2,3,4,5], "cca_same_as_terms": true,
  "started": false, "calendar_locked": { "at": "…", "by": "Ops Admin" },
  "terms": [ { "position": 1, "label": "Term 1", "starts_on": "2027-01-04", "ends_on": "2027-03-12", "school_days": 50,
               "cca_starts_on": "2027-01-04", "cca_ends_on": "2027-03-12" } ],
  "school_days": 200,
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "public_holiday_id": 12, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_

get.description:
GET /academic_years/:id/public_holidays — Import Public Holidays: the company's public holidays inside the year
that are not on its list yet (the screen adds them to the draft).

This page is always editable; the calendar lock does not apply. It saves the whole list, like the prototype's Save
Changes.

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/holidays { holidays: [{ name, starts_on, ends_on, public_holiday_id }],
                                   special_days: [{ date, kind, time, description }] }
```

- Send the list back as you got it: each holiday keeps its `public_holiday_id` (null for the school's own).
- Holidays need a `name` and `starts_on`. `ends_on` defaults to `starts_on` and must not be before it.
- Special day `kind` is `early_dismissal`, `late_dismissal`, `early_arrival`, `late_arrival` or `other`. `time` is
  "HH:MM".
- The response is the year (§3), which includes "N operating days off" as `operating_days_off`.
- Errors name the row, e.g. "Holiday 1: Ends on must be on or after the start".

**Import Singapore Public Holidays:** `GET /academic_years/:id/public_holidays` returns the company's public holidays
inside the year (Settings › Calendars) that are not on the list yet:

```json
[ { "public_holiday_id": 12, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06" } ]
```

Add them to the draft, then save.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 4. Holidays & Special Days_

`academic_years#public_holidays`

GET /academic_years/:id/setup — the Year Setup steps (done = locked) for the strip and the Summary.

`GET /academic_years/:id/setup`:

```json
{ "year": "2026", "done": 4, "total": 7, "complete": false,
  "steps": [ { "number": 1, "key": "levels", "label": "School Levels", "scope": "school", "available": true, "done": true, "locked_at": "…", "locked_by": "…" },
             { "number": 4, "key": "fares", "label": "Bus Fares", "scope": "year", "available": true, "done": false, "locked_at": null, "locked_by": null },
             { "number": 8, "key": "holidays", "label": "Holidays & Special Days", "scope": "year", "available": true, "done": null, "always_editable": true } ] }
```

- Show "`done` of `total` done" on the strip.
- Steps 1–7 count in `done` / `total` (7). Holidays & Special Days is step `number: 8` with `done: null` and
  `always_editable: true`: show it on the strip but leave it out of "`done` of `total`".
- Every step is `available: true` now (`available: false` would mark a step still to come).
- The Summary page reads each step's own endpoint: §3, §5, §6 and §7.

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 8. Setup strip and Summary_

```json
  "holidays": [ { "id": 1, "name": "Chinese New Year", "starts_on": "2027-02-06", "ends_on": "2027-02-06", "public_holiday": true, "public_holiday_id": 12, "operating_days_off": 0 } ],
  "operating_days_off": 20,
  "special_days": [ { "id": 3, "date": "2027-03-05", "kind": "early_dismissal", "time": "11:30", "description": "Sports Day" } ] }
```

- `school_days` under each term counts operating days in the term that are not holidays.
- `calendar_locked: null` means the step is not done.

**Save Calendar:**

```
PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar { operating_days: [1..7], structure: "semester"|"term", period_count: 2|3|4,
                                   cca_same_as_terms, terms: [{ starts_on, ends_on, cca_starts_on, cca_ends_on }] }
```

Send JSON. Error messages:

| Error (422) | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| "Pick at least one operating day" | No operating days |
| "Period count must be 2" (or "3 or 4") | `period_count` does not fit `structure` |
| "Term 1 needs a start and an end" | Missing date |
| "Term 2 must start after Term 1 ends" | Terms out of order or overlapping |
| "Term 4 must be inside AY 2027 (1 Jan 2027 to 31 Dec 2027)" | Term outside the year |
| "Term 1 CCA / ASA needs a start and an end" | Missing CCA date (when not the same as the terms) |
| "Terms & Semesters is locked. Unlock to edit" | Calendar is locked |

**Delete Year:**

- Only before the year starts (`started: false`), and only for Admins.
- The FE asks the user to type the key first.
- It removes the whole year: calendar, holidays, sessions and locks.
- 422 "AY 2026 has started and cannot be deleted".

The School Bus runs of the school follow the calendar. They are re-synced in the background after any save (see §9).

_Source: `convoy-os/school-bus-setup.md` § 3. Terms & Semesters (academic years)_

delete.description:
An academic year runs for 12 months from its start month.

- Its `key` is `"2026"` when it starts in January, otherwise `"2026/27"`.
- Its calendar has operating days and either 2 Semesters or 3–4 Terms.
- Each term has a CCA / ASA period: the term's own dates when `cca_same_as_terms`, otherwise its own dates.
- A **school day** is an operating day, inside a term, and not a holiday.

| Call | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /schools/:id/academic_years` | The years, oldest first (the year selector) |
| `POST /schools/:id/academic_years { start_year, start_month, copy_from_id }` | New Academic Year (see below) |
| `GET /academic_years/:id` | One year with its terms, holidays and special days |
| `PUT /academic_years/:id/calendar` | Save Calendar: validates, saves and **locks** |
| `POST /academic_years/:id/unlock { section: "calendar" }` | Unlock to Edit |
| `DELETE /academic_years/:id` | Delete Year |

**New Academic Year:**

- With `copy_from_id`, it copies the operating days, structure and CCA setting of that year, but not its dates.
- Otherwise it starts with Mon–Fri and 2 Semesters.
- The empty terms are created.
- 422 "This overlaps AY 2027" when the 12 months overlap another year.

get.description:
GET /ops_control?tab=needs_action|all|not_started|running|ended&client_id=&q=&sort=asc|desc

`GET /ops_control?tab=needs_action&client_id=&q=&sort=asc`

| Param | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `tab` | `needs_action` (default: trips with an alert of severity 1 At Risk or 2 Action Now, i.e. the row's `severity > 0`), `all`, `not_started`, `running`, `ended` |
| `client_id` | a client from `data.clients` |
| `q` | plate, driver, trip title, TID or client |
| `sort` | `asc` (earliest first pick-up first, default) or `desc` |

```json
{ "data": {
    "kpis": { "next_2_hours": 3, "window_until": "2026-11-02T10:00:00+08:00", "running": 3, "action_now": 3, "unacknowledged": 3,
              "at_risk": 1, "on_time_today": 50, "on_time_count": 1, "started_today": 2, "late_today": 1 },
    "banner": { "count": 3, "more": 0,
                "trips": [ { "occurrence_id": 40, "first_pickup_at": "2026-11-02T07:30:00+08:00", "plate": "SBA0004D",
                             "message": "No GPS for 7 min", "title": "WEN Shuttle", "trip_label": "TID000004", "client": "Google",
                             "route": "Boon Lay MRT to Mapletree Business City", "raised_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00",
                             "escalated": false, "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+6591234471" } } ] },
    "tab": "needs_action",
    "counts": { "needs_action": 4, "all": 5, "not_started": 2, "running": 3, "ended": 0 },
    "clients": [ { "id": 3, "name": "Google" } ],
    "rows": [ {
      "id": 37, "key": "t12|2026-11-02|0|1|1", "date": "2026-11-02", "trip_label": "TID000001", "title": "WEN Shuttle",
      "client": { "id": 3, "name": "Google" }, "route": "Boon Lay MRT to Mapletree Business City",
      "vehicle_id": 48, "plate": "SBA0001A", "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+6591234471" },
      "first_pickup_at": "2026-11-02T08:10:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-11-02T10:00:00+08:00", "timeline_from": "2026-11-02T07:55:00+08:00",
      "state": "action_now", "severity": 2, "arrived_at": null,
      "app": { "status": "not_logged_in", "started_at": null, "ended_at": null, "signed_in_at": null, "last_seen_at": "2026-11-01T18:30:00+08:00" },
      "gps": { "status": "to_first_pickup", "last_ping_at": "2026-11-02T07:59:50+08:00", "distance_m": 300, "stops_reached": 0, "stops": 2,
              "speed_kmh": 24.0, "moving": true },
      "eta": { "at": null, "late_minutes": null },
      "alerts": [ { "id": 21, "kind": "login", "severity": 2, "message": "Driver not logged in to the Convoy Driver app",
                    "raised_at": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00", "acknowledged_at": null, "acknowledged_by": null, "escalated": false },
                  { "id": 22, "kind": "start", "severity": 1,
                    "message": "Trip not started. First pick-up in 10 min. Driver is 300 m away but has not started", "…": "…" } ],
      "can_acknowledge": true, "acknowledged": null } ] },
  "meta": { "now": "2026-11-02T08:00:00+08:00", "duty": "Nur Aisyah",
            "rules": { "login_minutes": [20, 10], "start_minutes": [15, 5], "eta_late_minutes": [2, 5], "miss_after_minutes": 2,
                       "late_after_minutes": 2, "gps_minutes": [3, 6], "escalate_after_minutes": 3,
                       "window_ahead_minutes": 120, "window_behind_minutes": 15 } } }
```

**Which runs are listed:** runs with a bus, not cancelled, whose first pick-up is up to 2 hours from now and that ended
less than 15 minutes ago. A run without a bus belongs to the Scheduler's Unassigned list.

**KPIs** (cover all runs, not filtered):

| Tile | Field |
| --- | --- |
| Trips in Next 2 Hours | `next_2_hours` ("First pick-up before `window_until`") |
| Running Now | `running` |
| Action Now | `action_now`, with "`unacknowledged` alerts not acknowledged" or "All acknowledged" |
| At Risk | `at_risk` |
| On-Time Starts Today | `on_time_today` % (`null` → N/A); "`on_time_count` of `started_today` at first pick-up on time" |
| Late Starts Today | `late_today`: more than 2 min late, or not at the first pick-up at all |

**Banner:** "`count` trips need action now". It lists `trips` (up to 3) with Call (`tel:` the driver's phone) and
Acknowledge. Add "+`more` more in the table below" when `more` > 0. `escalated: true` means it went to the Ops Manager.

**Tabs:** use `counts`. They follow the client and search filters, as in the prototype.

**Row fields:**

- `state` drives the status chip and row colour:

  | `state` | Chip | Tone |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `action_now` | Action Now | danger |
  | `at_risk` | At Risk | warning |
  | `on_route` | On Route | success |
  | `on_the_way` | On the Way | success |
  | `ready` | Ready (logged in, not started) | info |
  | `scheduled` | Scheduled | info |
  | `completed` | Completed (row faded) | neutral |

- Time and countdown:
  - Show `first_pickup_at`.
  - Countdown before the pick-up: "in N min". After it: "N min overdue".
  - Once arrived (`arrived_at` set): "Arrived on time", or "Arrived N min late" when more than 2 min late.
- `app.status` (Driver App column):

  | `app.status` | Label and sub-line |
  | --- | --- |
  | `not_logged_in` | Not Logged In, "Last seen" `last_seen_at`. Red within 20 min of the pick-up. |
  | `not_started` | Not Started |
  | `started` | Started at `started_at` (the driver pressed Start; not at the first pick-up yet) |
  | `running` | Running, "Started" `started_at` (reached the first pick-up: the trip is under way) |
  | `ended` | Trip Ended |
  | `no_account` | No App: the driver was typed in, with no app account |

- `gps.status` (GPS column):

  | `gps.status` | Label and sub-line |
  | --- | --- |
  | `to_first_pickup` | `distance_m` to the first pick-up (show km above 1000), plus how long ago `last_ping_at` was |
  | `on_route` | Stop `stops_reached` of `stops` |
  | `no_signal` | No signal, "Last ping N min ago" |
  | `at_drop_off` | At drop-off |

  `gps.speed_kmh` (last report) and `gps.moving` (over 3 km/h; `null` with no speed reported) → "Moving" / "Not moving" on the
  `to_first_pickup` sub-line.

- `eta` (ETA column):
  - `eta.at` is set once the driver has started.
  - It is a straight line at 30 km/h from the last position.
  - Show `+late_minutes min` when more than 2, otherwise "On time".
  - Not started shows N/A; arrived shows "At first pick-up".
- Timeline bar:
  - The bar runs from `timeline_from` (15 min before the first pick-up) to `ends_at`.
  - The marker is at `first_pickup_at`.
  - Draw the scale from now − 15 min to now + 2 h; the "now" line uses `meta.now`.
- Issue column:
  - Show `alerts[0].message`, and "(+N more)" when there are more alerts.
  - `alerts` is ordered most severe first. Their messages are live: the minutes update on every load.
- Acknowledge:
  - Show the button when `can_acknowledge` is true.
  - Once every open alert is acknowledged, `acknowledged` = `{ at, by }`. Show "Acknowledged HH:MM by Name".
- Call: `tel:` + `driver.phone`.

_Source: `convoy-os/ops-control.md` § 1. The board_

GET /ops_control/log — alerts raised today, newest first (60).

`GET /ops_control/log` returns the alerts raised today, newest first (60):

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 21, "occurrence_id": 37, "kind": "login", "severity": 2, "message": "Driver not logged in to the Convoy Driver app",
              "raised_at": "…", "plate": "SBA0001A", "title": "WEN Shuttle", "trip_label": "TID000001", "client": "Google",
              "status": "acknowledged", "acknowledged_at": "…", "acknowledged_by": "Nur Aisyah", "escalated_at": null, "cleared_at": null } ],
  "meta": { "count": 1 } }
```

- `message` is the text at the time the alert was raised.
- `status` maps to these chips: `open` (danger / warning), `acknowledged` (info), `escalated` (danger), `cleared`
  (success).
- The sub-line is the trip and client, plus "Acknowledged HH:MM by Name".
- The count reads "`meta.count` alerts today".

_Source: `convoy-os/ops-control.md` § 4. Alert Log_

post.description:
POST /ops_control/runs/:id/acknowledge

`POST /ops_control/runs/:id/acknowledge` (`:id` = the row `id` or the banner `occurrence_id`) returns:

```json
{ "acknowledged": 2, "at": "2026-11-02T08:04:00+08:00", "by": "Nur Aisyah" }
```

- It acknowledges every open alert of the run, as the signed-in user (the person on duty, `meta.duty`).
- It stops the alarm and the escalation. The trip **stays flagged** until the problem clears.
- Returns 422 "Nothing to acknowledge on this trip" when nothing is open and unacknowledged.
- Reload the board afterwards.

_Source: `convoy-os/ops-control.md` § 3. Acknowledge_

get.description:
GET /live_map?q=&state=on_trip|available|offline&team_id=

`GET /live_map?q=&state=&team_id=` returns the Fleet panel, the markers and the counts:

```json
{ "data": [
    { "id": 4, "plate": "SBA3546A", "make": "Mitsubishi", "model": "Rosa", "seats": 29, "ownership": "own", "operator": null,
      "team": { "id": 1, "name": "East", "color": "#008C95" },
      "driver": { "name": "Tan Wei Ming", "phone": "+65 9123 4471" },
      "state": "on_trip", "online": true, "on_map": true,
      "position": { "lat": 1.2801, "lng": 103.8102, "speed_kmh": 38, "heading": 90, "recorded_at": "2026-11-02T08:19:55+08:00" },
      "last_reported_at": "2026-11-02T08:19:55+08:00", "road": null,
      "device": { "kind": "gps_tracker", "name": "OTW GPS T-8 tracker" },
      "run": { "id": 492, "trip_label": "TID103716-3", "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific", "school": null,
               "date": "2026-11-02", "key": "t8|2026-11-02|2|1|1", "kind": "corporate_shuttle", "kind_name": "Corporate Shuttle",
               "trip_id": 8, "school_route_id": null,
               "starts_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00", "ends_at": "2026-11-02T08:30:00+08:00",
               "points": 3, "points_done": 1,
               "next_stop": { "position": 1, "number": 2, "last": false, "name": "Alexandra Road (Opp Blk 1)",
                              "planned_at": "2026-11-02T08:22:00+08:00", "at_stop": false, "arrived_at": null,
                              "eta_at": "2026-11-02T08:24:00+08:00", "late_minutes": 2 } },
      "next_run": { "id": 494, "trip_label": "TID103716-5", "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific",
                    "starts_at": "2026-11-02T08:45:00+08:00" },
      "last_run": null } ],
  "meta": { "counts": { "on_trip": 6, "available": 5, "offline": 2 }, "now": "2026-11-02T08:20:00+08:00",
            "teams": [ { "id": 1, "name": "East", "color": "#008C95" } ], "offline_after_minutes": 15 } }
```

- Every kept bus is listed (own, managed and external), sorted by plate. `q` matches the plate or the driver's name;
  `state` and `team_id` filter. `meta.counts` covers all buses and is not filtered, which suits the On Trip / Available /
  Offline chips. Group by team on the FE with `team` (no team = "No Team", grey).
- `state`:
  - `on_trip`: the bus has a run that has started and not ended.
  - `available`: the device reported in the last `offline_after_minutes`.
  - `offline`: no report for that long, or no device at all.
  
  A bus on a trip whose device went quiet keeps `on_trip` with `online: false`.
- An offline bus stays on the map at its last position (grey marker), however long ago that was. `on_map: false` only
  when the bus has never reported (`position: null`); the row shows "Not on map". `position` is the last report. `speed_kmh` is 0 when offline.
- `driver`: the run's driver, or the bus's default driver today.
- Row text:
  - **On a trip:** `run.client | run.title | to Point {next_stop.number} of {run.points}`. The right side shows
    `ETA {next_stop.eta_at}`, or `Arrived {arrived_at}` when `next_stop.at_stop` is true (the chip then reads "Arrived";
    otherwise "On the way"). "Last Point" when `next_stop.last`.
  - **Available:** "Next trip starts {next_run.starts_at}", or `{last_run.title} | ended {last_run.ended_at}`.
    `next_run`: `{ id, trip_label, title, client, school, starts_at }` (`school` = the school of a School Bus route, else `null`:
    "School Route | <school>"); `last_run` (only when the bus has no run now; the last run of
    the day that ended): `{ id, trip_label, title, client, school, ended_at }` (`ended_at` = when it ended, else its planned end), e.g.
    `{ "id": 812, "trip_label": "T-0042-AM", "title": "Labrador Park → Google Mapletree", "client": "Google Asia Pacific", "ended_at": "2026-11-02T09:05:00+08:00" }`.
  - **Offline:** "Since {last_reported_at}" plus how long ago.
- `eta_at` is estimated as a straight line at 30 km/h from the last position. It is the planned time when there is no
  fresh position. `late_minutes` = ETA (or arrival) minus the planned time, never below 0.
- `road` is always `null` for now (road names need a map service). Hide the Road line.

_Source: `convoy-os/live-map.md` § 1. The board_

get.description:
GET /live_map/vehicles/:id

`GET /live_map/vehicles/:id` is used when a bus is clicked (the Vehicle and Device window and the trip drawer). It
returns the same row plus:

```json
{ "device": { "id": 4, "kind": "gps_tracker", "name": "OTW GPS T-8 tracker", "sharing_enabled": true,
              "report_interval_seconds": 10, "battery_pct": 78, "gps_signal": "good", "gsm_bars": 2 },
  "run": { "…": "as in the board",
           "on_board": 6, "eta_last": "2026-11-02T08:32:00+08:00",
           "stops": [ { "position": 0, "name": "Labrador Park MRT Exit A", "use": "pu", "lat": 1.2722, "lng": 103.8025,
                        "planned_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00", "arrived_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:00+08:00",
                        "departed_at": "2026-11-02T08:15:40+08:00", "skipped": false, "state": "done",
                        "students": [ { "key": "…", "name": "Aiden Tan", "class_name": "P3A", "status": "boarded",
                                        "boarded_at": "…", "alighted_at": null } ] } ] } }
```

- Vehicle and Device rows:

  | Row | Source |
  | --- | --- |
  | Vehicle | `plate`, `make` / `model` |
  | Current Driver | `driver.name` |
  | Speed | `position.speed_kmh`; N/A when offline |
  | Current Trip | `run.title`, `run.trip_label`, `run.client` |
  | Timestamp / Last Online | `last_reported_at` |
  | Device | `device.name` |
  | GPS Signal | `device.gps_signal`: good / fair / poor / none ("No fix" when none) |
  | GSM Signal | `device.gsm_bars` of 4 |
  | Battery Level | `device.battery_pct` ("at last report" when offline) |

- Location Sharing is "Enabled" when `device.sharing_enabled` and the bus is online. The note under it reads "GPS tracker
  reporting every {report_interval_seconds} s" for `gps_tracker`, or "Driver app sharing in the background" for
  `driver_app`. The **Check** button has no API yet (it needs the driver app). Hide it, or refetch this endpoint.
- Trip drawer:
  - Points `points_done` of `points`, `on_board` (boarded minus alighted so far), ETA Last `eta_last`.
  - Stops in travel order. `state` is `done` (reached or skipped), `current` (heading there) or `upcoming`. Show
    `arrived_at` for done stops and `planned_at` for the rest.
  - `students` is filled for School Run trips and School Bus routes (matched by stop name); School Bus students add `address`
    (home; show the part before the first comma) and `class_name` is the level. `status` is `boarded` / `alighted` / `not_boarded`
    / `not_boarding` / `expected`. The label depends on the stop:
    - at a pick-up that is done: Picked up / Absent (`not_boarded`, `not_boarding`)
    - at the current stop: Waiting
    - otherwise: Not yet
    - at the last stop: Dropped off / On board
- Draw the route line through the stops' `lat` / `lng` (the API has no road geometry).
- `run` is `null` when the bus is not on a trip. In that case show "No trip running now" with the available / offline
  text from section 1.

_Source: `convoy-os/live-map.md` § 2. One bus_

`reports#options`

GET /reports/shuttle?trip_id=&period=m|2026-10

`GET /reports/shuttle?trip_id=12&period=m|2026-10` (no period = last month) →

```json
{ "trip": { "id": 12, "title": "MBC Campus Shuttle", "client": "Google Asia Pacific", "days_text": "Mon to Fri", "plate": "PC7475L" },
  "period": { "from": "2026-10-01", "to": "2026-10-31", "label": "October 2026",
              "last_year": { "from": "2025-10-01", "to": "2025-10-31", "label": "October 2025" } },
  "on_time_allowance": 3, "early_minutes": 5, "has_data": true,
  "kpis": { "utilisation": 54.1, "utilisation_change": -0.1, "riders": 2437, "riders_change": 416, "avg_per_day": 110.8,
            "utilisation_change_ly": 3.2, "riders_change_ly": 512, "on_time": 81.3, "on_time_change": -1.6, "on_time_change_ly": 0.4,
            "late": 41, "left_early": 6, "service_days": 22, "runs": 196, "runs_a_day": 9, "seats": 23 },
  "timings": [ { "dep": "07:30", "direction": 1, "direction_label": "To MBC Tower 1", "utilisation": 71.2, "riders": 344, "avg": 15.6, "max": 21, "tag": "Busiest" } ],
  "stop_activity": [ { "direction": 1, "label": "To MBC Tower 1", "stops": [ { "name": "Labrador MRT", "boarded": 812, "pct": 60.2 } ] } ],
  "trend": [ { "month": "2026-10", "riders": 2437, "utilisation": 54.1, "on_time": 81.3, "in_period": true } ] }
```

- Utilisation = riders ÷ seats offered (each run's bus seats). Percentages to one decimal; `*_change` = against the period
  before of the same length (points for percentages, riders for riders); `null` when either has no data. `*_change_ly` = against
  the same period last year (`period.last_year`); `null` for a year period or with no data a year before (hide the second line).
- Chips: Days `trip.days_text`, Bus `trip.plate` (the bus of the latest run; `null` when none) + `kpis.seats` seats.
  Service Days sub-line: "`days_text` | `runs_a_day` runs a day"; On-Time sub-line: "`late` late | `left_early` left early" (stops).
- On time = a stop reached from `early_minutes` (5) before the timetable to `on_time_allowance` minutes after it.
  Early (more than 5 minutes before) still counts on time; **Left Early** (left a pick-up before the timetable) and Late count
  against; skipped stops are left out. Change the allowance with `PATCH /clients/:id { client: { on_time_allowance } }` (0–15, −1 / +1); any company user may (no extra permission, as in the prototype), a Convoy Admin gets `403`.
- `timings`: Utilisation by Shuttle Timing, busiest first (`tag` Busiest / Quietest). `stop_activity`: boardings per pick-up per
  direction (routes with 3 or more stops; the destination is left out). `trend`: the 12 months to the period's end (`in_period` = shaded).

_Source: `convoy-os/reports.md` § 2. The report_

`reports#shuttle`

GET /reports/shuttle/grid?trip_id=&month=2026-10

`GET /reports/shuttle/grid?trip_id=12&month=2026-10` → Riders per Timing per Day and the On Time Report of one month:

```json
{ "month": "2026-10", "dates": ["2026-10-01", "…"],
  "rows": [ { "timing": { "key": "1-0", "direction": 1, "position": 0, "dep": "07:30" },
              "cells": [ { "date": "2026-10-01", "occurrence_id": 5512, "riders": 16, "amended": false }, null ],
              "total": 344, "avg": 15.6, "max": 21, "util": 71.2,
              "stops": [ { "name": "Labrador MRT", "planned": "07:30" } ],
              "on_time": [ { "date": "2026-10-01", "occurrence_id": 5512,
                             "stops": [ { "status": "ok", "arrived": "07:29", "amended": false } ] } ] } ],
  "on_time": { "ok": 640, "early": 21, "late": 118, "edep": 3, "skip": 9, "pct": 84.5 },
  "worst_timing": "17:30", "worst_day": "2026-10-14" }
```

- `cells` / `on_time` follow `dates` (a `null` = the timing did not run that day). Stop `status`: `ok` (On Time), `early`
  (Early, pale green), `late`, `edep` (Left Early), `skip` (Skipped); `amended` = changed by Correct Record (badge).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /finance/settings` |
| Save / Save & Lock | `PATCH /finance/settings { settings: {...}, lock: false }` |
| Lock / Unlock (Admin) | `POST /finance/settings/lock`, `POST /finance/settings/unlock` |

Fields (save body = response):

| Card | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| GST | `gst_on`, `gst_rate` (default 9), `gst_mode` (`excl` Fares Are Before GST / `incl` Fares Include GST), `gst_reg_no` |
| Payment Details | `bank_id` (`GET /banks`), `account_number`, `account_name`, `paynow`, `payment_note` |
| Operator Pay Run Approval | `approval` (`single` One Person / `maker` Maker-Checker), `approvers [{ user_id, can_prepare, can_approve }]` (response adds `name`, `email`, `active`) |
| On Documents | `brand_name`, `brand_uen`, `brand_address`, `brand_phone`, `brand_email`, `brand_note` (+ the company logo) |
| Document Numbers | `prefix_inv`, `prefix_cn`, `prefix_dn`, `prefix_rcp`, `prefix_pv`, `prefix_pn`, `prefix_pb` (upper-cased, A–Z 0–9, up to 6); `doc_types` (read only) = the label of each prefix |

Also: `locked`, `locked_at`, `locked_by`, `active_users`, `maker_checker_warning` ("Maker-checker is on, but only 1 active
user is left, so no pay run can be approved. Switch to One Person"). Disable Maker-Checker when `active_users < 2`
("Needs at least two active users…"). GST examples on the mode cards are worked out on the front end from the rate.

`doc_types`: `{ "inv": "Invoice", "cn": "Credit Note", "dn": "Debit Note", "rcp": "Receipt", "pv": "Payment Voucher", "pn": "Payment Notice", "pb": "Payment Batch" }`
(the key is the `prefix_<key>` field).

**Partial save is allowed**: `settings` may hold one card only (e.g. Payment Details alone:
`{ settings: { bank_id, account_number, account_name, paynow, payment_note } }`); fields left out stay as they are, and
approvers change only when `approvers` is sent.

`422`: "Finance Settings are locked. Unlock to change them", "Enter a GST rate between 0 and 100", "Every document type needs a
prefix", "Each document type needs its own prefix", "Enter the account number", "Add at least one approver for operator pay
runs", "Maker-checker needs at least two active users. Add another user first", "Maker-checker needs at least two people: add
a second approver or a preparer", "Some approvers are not users of this company".

`client_invoices#ad_hoc`

GET /finance/invoices/summary?month= — KPIs and aging.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| KPIs and Aging card | `GET /finance/invoices/summary?month=2026-11` |
| Clients card (balance by billing entity) | `GET /finance/invoices/clients` → `[{ client_id, client_site_id, name, balance, invoices, overdue }]` (`overdue` = invoices past due with a balance: "N overdue") |
| Statement (print) | `GET /finance/invoices/statement?client_id=&client_site_id=` → `{ rows, balance, aging }` |
| Record Payment | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Credit Note | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/credit_note { amount, reason }` |
| Email | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/send { to: [], cc: [] }` (recorded only) |

Statement row: `{ date, type: invoice | payment | credit_note, number, text, charge, credit, balance }` (every amount a string;
`text` = "Invoice INV-…", "Payment for INV-…, <reference>", "Credit note CN-…"; payments add `method`, credit notes `reason`).

All three need an issued invoice (`422` "Only an issued invoice can take this") and return the invoice.

- **Payments**: `method` one of `Bank Transfer`, `PayNow`, `GIRO`, `Cheque`, `Cash`; `paid_on` defaults to today, `amount` to the balance on the
  front end. `422` "Enter the amount received", "More than the balance of S$x", "Pick how it was paid".
  Shown as "<paid_on> | <method> <reference>".
- **Credit note**: a document of its own (`kind: credit_note`, `CN-2026-000001`, no GST breakdown) that reduces the invoice's balance.
  `422` "Enter the credit amount", "More than the balance of S$x", "Enter the reason". Listed in the Credit Notes tab and in the invoice's `credit_notes`.
- **Email**: no email is sent yet; `to` / `cc` default to the billing people (To / CC). `422` "Add who the invoice goes To in Billing Details".
  `sends [{ at, to, cc, by }]` → "Emailed to <to> on <date> (recorded)".
- Invoice amounts: `paid`, `credited`, `balance` = total − paid − credit notes (not below 0).

Summary: `{ owed, owed_count, overdue, overdue_count, invoiced, collected, month, aging [{ key, label, amount, count }] }` — Owed to You
(open balances; "`owed_count` unpaid invoices"), Overdue ("`overdue_count` past the due date"),

get.description:
GET /finance/operator_pay/requests

Everything the company owes operators. Finance approves requests and sets the pay date; approvals with the same pay date
pool into one batch, which makes one bank file and one payment notice per operator. Approving, changing pay dates and
recording payments need an approver of Finance Settings (`422` "Only approvers in Finance Settings can approve requests,
set pay dates and record payments"); when no approver is set, anyone with `finance` can.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Payment Requests tab, KPIs | `GET /finance/operator_pay/requests` |
| Set a run's cost | `PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref, amount }` (`422` "Enter a cost of 0 or more"); empty `amount` removes the cost set by hand (back to the worked-out cost, or "Set the cost") |
| Add Item for <operator> | `POST /finance/operator_pay/items { operator_id, sign: pay \| deduct, description, item_on, amount }` |
| Delete an item | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/items/:id` |
| Approve and Set Pay Date | `POST /finance/operator_pay/approve { refs: [], pay_date }` or `{ refs: [], batch_id }` (Or add to an open batch) |
| Ad Hoc Payment / Pay Now | `POST /finance/operator_pay/ad_hoc { operator_id, pay_date, refs: [], extra: { description, amount } }` |
| Batches tab | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches` |
| A batch | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Change Pay Date (pool into another batch) | `PATCH /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id { pay_date, merge: true }` |
| Cancel Batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Pay (one operator) | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/payments { batch_operator_id, paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Mark All Paid | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/mark_paid { paid_on, reference }` (`422` "Pick the date paid") |
| Take out of batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/operators/:batch_operator_id` → the batch, or `204` when it had no other operator (the batch is gone). Confirm first: "Take <Operator> out of <PB-no>? Its items go back to Payment Requests" |
| Make Bank File | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file { transfer_type: FAST \| GIRO }` → the batch + `csv`, `filename` |
| Download Again | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv` (CSV file) |

The bank CSV lists only operators with something left to pay; Payment Type is `PayNow` for PayNow UEN, else the transfer type.

_Source: `convoy-os/finance.md` § 4. Operator Payments_
